reviews.comment: Good lecturer with interesting materials, but it was a bit hard to deal with him as a person. He (and TAs) grades only based on your answers and don't give any helpful feedback. Short syllabus, great lecture notes, he knows his field cold. Logistical nightmares - no final exam scores released, intentional withholding of all solutions to HW/exams, completely inaccessible outside of class, dismissive and disrespectful to students who ask questions, handwavy about answers. Good topic, but would never work with him.

Wow, this guy has absolutely no respect for his students. No correct answers were given all semester (no solutions of any kind) and talking about homework assignments even past the due date is banned. He blatantly violates academic policy and only rectifies it on a student-by-student basis when directly confronted. Do not take this class to learn.

No syllabus/calendar provided. The instructor treats students with unwarranted inflexibility (even in Spring 2020) and disrespect (sometimes laughs at students' questions). Actively delayed final grading to prevent students from checking final grade in time to opt for Covid-19 Pass/Fail option. Just horrible to interact with.

reviews.comment: Their grading policy was the "student will be evaluated on their final answer", meaning you will only get credit if your final answer is correct no matter whether your procedure is right or wrong. reviews.comment: Easy class. Homeworks have bad document styles, hard to notice what should be reported on the final submission. Review some matrix operations + matrix calculus then this class should be easy.

He tries to create this sense of inferiority around him about being extremely inflexible (and yes, even in Spring 2020). reviews.comment: Class wasn't bad in the start of the semester, but Domke made it clear that it would be difficult. Which is fine. reviews.comment: great lecturer. very clear about each topic. he will try his best to help you understand the materials. exam is pretty easy.

Awesome professor! Explains things very clearly and keeps the content interesting. Very good at explaining the big picture. The only complaint I have is that it can be a little hard to follow along what hes writing on the board sometimes because his handwriting is kinda small.

Deletes reviews.

great guy, super funny, good lectures. only a couple of assignment, lots of extra credit. only hard part is exams, you def have to go to lecture or watch recordings to do well on exams. scan the textbook before exams cause there are always a couple questions from the textbook that he doesn't talk about in lecture

Recorded lectures are engaging, but they are several years old and in dire need of an update. Canvas shell is sloppily organized. There is no interaction between classmates. Professor is kind and caring but I ultimately did not enjoy the course. Find another professor/course or take this one in person.

This was a good class, there was one homework assignment every week. The only bad part about this class is that he doesn't post the study guide until 2-3 days before the exam, so you have to make your own. Attendance is not required but all you need to do to get a good grade is to pay attention in lecture.

Absolutely loved the class! The exams were very manageable. One of the coolest professors I've had. He knows his stuff and how to teach. Yeah, #dilf.

Wasn't a fan of the “which video we didn't watch in class?” exam questions (memes with babies and toddlers). No idea how we were supposed to not mix up videos we saw in class and on social media.

reviews.comment: Clearly passionate about the topic and an engaging and humorous lecturer. Exams aren't hard at all if you read the slides. Go to class :)
Interseting homeworks! Exams can be tricky but as long as you go to class or watch lectures you will be fine. also #dilf

By far the best professor I've had at umass. I haven't taken any other psych classes here and was so impressed with his competency as a lecturer and genuine care for students. He should be teaching OTHER professers how to teach. Very manegable to get an A just go to lecture. I never read the textbook

I Love this guy. Yeah, his tests can be hard, but he drops the worst grade and the final is optional. The homework is very fun to do (in my opinion) and it's worth a good chunk of your grade!! Almost guaranteed a 10/10 if you do it correctly and answer honestly. His lectures are long, but he records them and I watch at home. He's very fun to watch.
Exams are a little tricky, but he is genuinely one of the best profs in the psych department. Highly recommend

I'm taking him right now for Psych 350, and boy you better watch out. He doesn't joke around with his test. I had too many pages of notes during lecture. You have to listen to everything he says. The tests are HARD. You will most likely need to take the optional final. Questions are confusing and studying everyday for 5 hours won't help at all.

Erik is a nice guy,  but his exams are insane. Instead of comprehending content, you need to memorize which silly 10-second video he played in class. VERY lecture-heavy, be prepared to take notes on everything he says because it's all fair game for exams. I want to love him, but he is doing too much for a psych class.

he talks a lot with minimal information on the slide so you have to really pay attention to what hes saying. his tests are tricky and are worth a huge percentage of your grade. hes a good teacher and very knowledgeable, you just have to study every detail of everything he says because his test questions are incredibly specific. hes very nice tho

This guy can kick rocks. Lecture is so boring it's hard to stay awake, notes need to be taken on EVERYTHING (like “what videos were watched in class”), exams are soooo hard for no reason, and I feel like he just makes stuff up something's because half the junk about babies just seems wrong.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: One of the best professors I've had. Truly cares about the material and your success in the course, and lectures in a way that feels engaging for the whole class. Textbook doesn't seem necessary at times, but it's needed for the major exams. Homework connects material with contemporary examples to aid understanding. Great class, great professor!

Professor Cheries is a great lecturer. He does a great job of incorporating current info, he also loops in the homework assignment responses as a way to keep us connected in such a big class. I've taken 2 classes with him and I loved both, If you're a psych student or even if you are not, take his classes he is a great teacher. He actually teaches!
Amazing professor and a great course. He cares so much about his students and it shows.
I love Cheries. Best lectures in the psych department, and his exams are 95% lecture-based and easy if you review the lecture material. His lectures are so funny and entertaining.

He is an amazing professor and you can tell that he really cares about his students doing well. I would 100% rec taking this class. Also, it's just interesting as a whole and he does a great job at keeping it fun for the students.

Easily the best lecturer I've had so far at Umass. Unless you like your lectures dry please take a class with this man, you will not regret it. I'm on my second course with him and I have zero regrets. His tests can be a bit tricky but if you take good notes and focus on what's on the study guide you won't have problems.

Professor Cheries makes this class really engaging. Exams can be tricky, but going to lecture and using resources like unstuck AI help a lot. He cares about student success - take this course if you can!

One of the best professors I've had; Erik is an amazing lecturer and incredibly knowledgeable about what he teaches. Exams were difficult, but you won't have trouble if you know the material. Go to review sessions, the TAs are always there to answer any questions! Wonderful teacher, funny, engaging, I learned so much in this class.
this man is so fine.

I love this man - his exams are a little bit tricky but I seriously loved this class. He is so funny and makes lecture very interesting. Echo 360 available if you don't want to go. 3% of SONA also available. Study hard for exams and you're good. I would recommend taking at least one of his courses in your time here.

I don't think another 5.0 for Cheries is gonna help, but regardless, take Cheries. His lectures were engaging and he genuinely wants everyone in his class to succeed. TA's are helpful, and there are many resources available. Just study for the tests, they're really the only "hard" part, but you'll want to do well anyways.

Such a nice and caring professor! Interesting class, exams are 70% of grade, weekly HW assignment. In person exams, not bad if you study, drops lowest. EC with SONA up to 3%. Taking him again for 391 seminar. Textbook helps explain concepts, he explains more then what is on slides so pay attention and you'll be good!

He's really passionate about this subject which makes the lectures are engaging. Tests are in person with no notes, I didn't find them to be too hard, but you definitely have to study for them and read the textbook. Homework is very interesting and mostly easy. He also provides multiple options for extra credit. Great class overall!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor Cheries is amazing! His lectures are honestly great, the homework each week is very insightful and easy to complete. The exams are a bit tough but everything covered is in the lecture slides / textbook. Attendance not mandatory but I would recommend going :)
Only non-mandatory class I would sometimes go to simply because it was that enjoyable. Forensic and developmental. Jolly fellow.

Professor Cheries gives amazing lectures. However, he is hard to reach. He takes many days to respond to emails if he responds at all. Additionally, the exams are very difficult. They are in person and you are not able to use any notes or a flash card. I highly recommend reading the textbook when studying for exams.

I didn't think I would like Forensic Psychology but this class is a hidden gem. Yes, his exams are a little on the difficult side but his office hours are super helpful! He makes it known that he and the TA's want you to pass. Take this class and take it with him!!! Don't be intimidated about the exams, the class is worth it

He is an amazing professor, and very passionate about what he teaches. The tests are very difficult, they are in person no notes and he is very tricky with his wording. There are weekly hw assignments that take about an hour (not too bad). His attendance is  not mandatory but I recommend going as he puts on videos that are on the test in class.

As someone who is a bad test taker, the tests are hard! I studied a lot and got a B. He's a nice and funny guy. Tests make up most of your grade and then he has occasional assignments that are easy. You can do SONA studies for EC. Interesting content covered! Tests are in person with no notes.

The exams can be a little harder than you expect, but imo they are just right in the amount of stuff you should be studying/learning from the course. Homework is simple weekly online assignments. Definitely either show up to lecture or watch the lectures online. You dont need to read the textbook if you're good at psych but it'll definitely help!

i love erik, but boy would i love him more if he didn't make the tests so incredibly hard. hes super passionate about the subject and is eager to have his students succeed. was also super helpful and provided accommodations when needed. attending lectures is key as he discusses a lot of studies which he may ask qs on in tests. 10/10!

Great professor! You can tell he is passionate about what he teaches. I am going to try to get him again in future psych classes. I never felt overwhelmed or stressed by his class. Everything you learn is very interesting and the test are not hard as long as you study!
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I have never had such a passionate & amazing professor. His slides are very engaging & visually appealing, even including in-depth transitions. It's important to listen & attend lectures as he says things that aren't covered in the slides. The exams are rather difficult but it is a COLLEGE exam so its makes sense. HW are simple & intersting

prof cheries is super nice, passionate about what he does, and a great lecturer. i found the content in this class so interesting and I really like the way he presented it (even the textbook was interesting to read and not too complicated). that being said, the class is test heavy and the exams are incredibly difficult. still worth it though IMO!

I had him for developmental and was SO excited I got to be in a class with him again. He's a great professor, cares about his students, and breaks up some hard content with humor to make it less heavy. His tests are decently hard, but the assignments he assigns can 100% help boost your grade and he makes them fun to do. Take this class if you can!

Professor Cheries is the best prof I have had! Psych 321- Forensic is the most interesting class ever, he makes you want to do the assignments and attend lectures. He is so passionate about what he teaches, and wants everyone to do well. The exams are 70% of your grade so you need to study! The other 30% is one easy weekly assignment. Love him!!!

literally the goat. incredible lectures, exams can be difficult but as long as you study and go to the review sessions offered before the exam, you should be fine. Exams count for a lot, but he makes you want to work hard on them. love professor cheries he is awesome

I loved this class, it's a great seminar to take if you are a Psych major and need the seminar requirement. You learn a lot about where our skills and beliefs originate, as well as animal behavior. The exams are very hard and require a LOT of studying, and attendance is necessary to get a good grade on the exams. Definitely worth taking!

reviews.comment: One of my favorite professors! He makes the lectures so interesting and fun. Exams require a lot of studying, but thats a small price to pay cause his classes are one of the best!

Professor Cheries is so passionate about what he teaches and you can tell he loves being a professor. The lectures in this class are really engaging and cover very interesting topics such as the origins of perception and social psychology. Exams are quite hard and there are regular readings/responses, but the class is worth it. Would def recommend!
Very engaging lectures but challenging exams
Hes adorable, I enjoyed learning from him thoughrougly.

reviews.comment:
ONE OF MY FAV PROFESSORS - this class is so interesting - he is so reasonable with his workload - small weekly assignments, AMAZING LECTURES, 3 in person exams but final exam optional - they are not hard if you study. Attendence not mandatory and lectures posted online. 
He is so sweet and his lectures are so engaging - TAKE THIS CLASS

Professor Cheries is genuinely the greatest professor I've gotten the pleasure of having. He is one of those teachers who genuinely cares about all his students, and genuinely wants you to learn about the material which he is extremely passionate about. If you attend lectures, take notes on their content, and study, you should ace his three exams.

Prof Cheries was honestly the best teacher I've had during college. His lectures were at 9 thrice a week but I made sure to attend all of them. Lectures are fun and interesting and the homework even more so. Prof Cheries single-handedly made me want to change my major to psychology!

I really enjoyed this class with Cheries. He makes his lectures interactive and engaging and the material was so interesting that it actually made me want to go to class. Def need to go to the class to take good notes for the exams. They're not open note and in person but pretty straightforward if you study.

Erik Cheries is a fantastic professor and I love him. His lectures are super interesting all though he does move fast. But he posts all slides online. His tests are more difficult but not too bad and the TAs have review sessions before the exams. He only assigns one assignment a week and they are fairly easy to complete but sometimes time consuming

Professor Cheries is such a great guy. I enjoyed going to class as he always made it fun and interesting. Exams are not bad as long as you put in the work to study. There is usually a short HW due every Wednesday and 3 exams total. Final is optional cause he drops your lowest exam grade. Loved Psych 350 and learned a lot!

I LOVE Erik. You can tell he cares about his students but his tests on the other hand are very tricky, you need to study a lot and his questions can be dirty sometimes. He's totally worth it though. His hws are once a week and super easy. Quinnehtukqut is honestly the BEST ta to exist.

I LOVE Erik, honestly the best professor I had this semester. He is by far the funniest professor. His tests are hard if you don't take ur time on them because the wording is super tricky. Quinnehtukqut, my favorite TA to exist. He is super helpful as well as Erik. You just need to be careful, again, about his test. Hw- easy once a week.

Prof Cheries was great! His lectures were super interesting and he is clearly very into the subject matter. Tests were definitely difficult, but very doable if you take the time to study. You can tell that he wants his students to succeed. Loved the class.

I LOVE Erik. This was my favorite class, amazing lectures. He is a very talented professor and keeps you interested. Extra credit was offered so this class is an easy A as long as you do your part (homework, studying, etc.) Class was recorded but I never wanted to miss it. Highly recommend Erik, no matter the course you're taking.

reviews.comment: cheries is the best prof at umass in my opinion. he is just so good at getting everyone interested in what he is teaching. lectures are not boring, shows so many videos and examples for what he talks about. definitely take this class with him.

Professor Cheries was one of my favorite professors! His lectures were absolutely awesome and it was the only class I've ever actually wanted to go to. I learned a lot from the class and found it fun, interactive, and informative.

Professor Cheries is by far the best professor here! I was not looking forward to taking developmental psych but his amusing lectures and passion for the subject made it my favorite class. Attendance was not mandatory as lectures were posted after class, but I chose to go to every lecture because he made it so fun!

Professor Cheries is one of the nicest, more accommodating professors I've ever had at UMass. Attendance optional (live lectures uploaded right after class), reasonable, quick and interested homework each week. Exams at 70% of the grade, but they are super reasonable if you watch all the lectures, and the final is optional and can replace lowest!

Professor Cheries is one of the best professors I had. The material could be dark but his lectures are so entertaining. He has a great way of explaining things. This is a really fun class and an easy A. I took it online but I wish that I took it in person cuz its probably more engaging.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Prof Cheries is a fantastic professor! He is so passionate about the subject and super accessible outside of class. Hands down one of the best classes at UMass !!!
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Cheries is by far the best teacher I've had at UMass. He puts a lot of effort into each lecture to make it entertaining and easy to learn. He obviously cares about his students and wants them to succeed. The exams aren't bad if you attend the lectures and do the homework assignments. He's the best!

Professor Cheries is well spoken and puts effort into the material he teaches. Lectures were great, assignments were an easy 100 and exams were a guaranteed 95 if you actually watched did the assigned work. Closed book, which was actually reinforced even though it was an online course.

Prof Cheries gives so much work! Even in an async class, he gives us 3-4 hours of lecture every week along with an assignment due every week. Exams are tough, 40-50 questions, closed notes. Overall, loads of work but if you work hard you can get an A.

Professor Cheries is the best professor I've had at umass! The class is asynchronous but he provides amazing lectures and explains all of the concepts so well. Not too many assignments at all and what he's given us has been interesting and worthwhile. The exams aren't bad, and we have the option to not take the final if we're happy with our grade!

great professor v funny and promotes discussion. class is very easy just read 1-2 nytimes articles a week, short reply in a forum, and discuss in class. super easy and it's fun talking about relevant news with classmates. def would take again. no final exam.

Erik is the most honest teacher or professor I have ever had. He was amazing at promoting dialogue and making sure all relevant perspectives were introduced. Extremely funny and very thoughtful. 100% would take again.

Professor Cheries was honestly one of the best professors Ive had. He made his classes entertaining, explained in great detail, and added amazing videos for his topics. If youre planning or you have to take Psych350 then take him!!! He is the best!!!
I took devlelopmental and forensic psychology with him, he does easy interesting homework once a week or less. Funny guy he's cool

I LOVE Professor Cheries. I had him for forensics and he's knowledgeable yet respectful for such a heavy topic, and he's also engaging and just fun to listen to. He started every class by playing a crime-related song, and it was something I looked forward to. I hate remote learning because his lectures were so interesting.

Erik is one of the best professors at Umass. He makes lectures so interesting and engaging. I have never once WANTED to go to an hour long lecture before this, but his forensic psychology is so awesome. He is the best and you NEED to take his class before you graduate. Reasonable tests and assignments and he is super friendly and accessible!

Prof Cheries is the most impressive speaker I have had at UMass. He is engaging, personable, crazy smart, and hilarious so I actually looked forward to going to class. His exams were somewhat difficult but if you attend most of the lectures/semi read the textbook you will be fine. big fan of the class highly recommend

I love Professor Cheries. Without a doubt my favourite professor here at UMASS. He made class so interesting and really inspired me to continue psychology. His exams are also very fair. Not to mention, he is so handsome! Too bad i didnt get a chance to take any of his other classes.

Erik Cheries is one of the best psych professors. He makes the material easy to understand and he definitely knows what he taking about. He has the class do online Moodle assignments covering topic such as gender roles, attachment, and cognitive development. If you have a chance to take him, DO IT.
I LOVE ERIK. He is literally the best and for him teaching this class the first time wow 10/10 loved it thanks
Erik is the best professor I have had at UMass. His lectures are super interesting and he's very funny. Don't worry too much if you don't do well on an exam because homework can bring your grade up!

Prof. Cheries is one of the best professors in the psych department. He is very knowledgeable and makes the info fun and easy to learn. Your grade consists of 3 exams and online assignments about every other week. Exams aren't too hard as long as you study. Final is optional, but can replace an exam score. I would definitely take this class again

He is the best professor in the department and potentially at the school. lectures are beyond engaging. I trek in the snow for those lectures and its worth it every time. is exams are fair and critical knowledge of the topic not trivial memorization. definitely take a class with him if possible.

Cheries is a great guy and it's obvious he loves the material he teaches and wants his students to love it too. Shows funny videos a lot and makes jokes. Some exam questions can be very specific though which has thrown a lot of people off. But he's accommodating and wants to help everyone understand the material and get a good grade.

one of the best professors I have had at UMass. This class convinced me to be a psychology major. He makes the class extremely enjoyable and is always willing to help anyone. 3 non cumulative exams and one optional final as well as 10 homework assignments throughout the semester. Amazing class

Erik is by far my favorite professor I have had at UMass, and I am not a Psych major. He is so genuine, makes class so fun, and is so passionate about developmental psych. 3 exams, 70% of your grade, and 9 homework assignments worth 30%. The exams are generally straight from lecture. Doesn't require much effort, but you'll want to put the effort in
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I LOVED Erik's class so much, he is very relatable and his lectures are quite interesting. If you want a good grade in the class, skipping the lectures are an impossibility since the tests are very lecture-based. You'll want to go to them though! He's readily available over email or his office hours and he is very kind and understanding.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Great teacher, do the study guides, go to the review sessions if possible and reach out if you have any questions. Tests are straightforward and based on lecture and the lecture is always interesting.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Prof Cheries is so cute and passionate about the class. His tests aren't bad if you study the slides beforehand, and if you do well on the three tests during the semester, you don't have to take the final. There are "hot topic" assignments which are interesting and easy and a good extra grade boost. Also you can do SONA extra credit to help too
reviews.rating_tags: TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Erik is super genuine and funny! Although attendance was not mandatory, I went to every class because lectures were so interesting. He shows lots of videos which makes the class go by quickly and the exams are pretty easy!

Best professor at UMass. His lectures are something to look forward to every day. They are pretty entertaining and interesting. He is super helpful. The exams aren't hard if you review the slides and go to class.

I look forward to going to this class! Super nice guy and very genuine. He makes the class feel like a small 20 person class just by the way he talks to us. He really cares about how students do and his lectures are always very fun and interesting.

He's a great professor. Probably one of the best I have had at UMass. He really did take student feedback seriously and was very accommodating. There's three exams in class and the final is optional (really just to boost your grade).
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Tests? Not many

reviews.comment: Attendance is not mandatory but participation is graded. No textbook but there are reading assignments for most classes. Clear guidelines and extra credit provided. Always there to help, great professor overall.

Great guy/professor overall. The class was a little boring, but he incorporated some interesting videos and reading assignments that made it better. Some of the homework readings are difficult to understand, but if you put in the effort you'll get full credit. Very available and eager to help students succeed and always answers emails promptly.

Lecture heavy, most of them are good, occasionally boring - Graded on 3/4 tests (average difficulty) and 9/10 homework assignments (easy but tedious), drops the lowest one - If you do good on first 3 tests, don't need to take the final - Lots of foundational psych stuff, if you even took HS psych it'll be a lot of review.

There are only two components to the class, exams (of which there are 3) and homework assignments (there are 10 over the semester). This can be challenging if you don't do well on an exam, or miss a homework assignment because each one is a big part of the grade. Also, his lectures are kind of boring at times.

Before this class I was not interested in developmental psych but I took this as a requirement and my outlook has changed! Professor Cheries makes the material interesting through his hands-on knowledge of the subject and clear passion. His tests are not difficult but be ready to understand the results of many psych experiments.

Really great professor - can see he genuinely wants students to enjoy what he teaches and do well in the class. Content maybe a little too basic, but he has to cater for all abilities. Online assignments are interesting and opinion-based so no right or wrongs. Can earn extra credit also!!

I have taken several courses with Dr. Cheries, and he is definitely one of the best professors I've had. He is passionate about teaching and truly wants his students to succeed. Sure, exams and papers are tough but if you ask questions and attend class, they are much more manageable. The content is interesting, he has a good sense of humor.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I loved this class. Great professor, super funny. I highly recommend taking it. If you take notes you'll do great on the tests. His questions are straight forward and based off what he says in class. One of my favorite professors so far at umass.

Amazing professor. Best one I've ever had. He genuinely wants everyone to do well and get a good grade. He is very passionate about what he is teaching and makes the lectures really fun and interesting.

Great classes, and a good guy, but he's all over the place. Papers have little to no given guidelines; exams are insanely specific, even when he says they're not. It's an interesting class, but has been the hardest yet to do well in due to this. He cares, but his actions with what he actually provides you doesn't exactly support his intentions.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: I really enjoy Erik's class! The homework assignments are very easy and the exams are fair. His lectures are pretty interesting and he shows a lot of baby videos. He is also a funny guy and tries to make jokes during lecture. This class ended up being better and more interesting than I expected it to be. My mind gets blown pretty frequently
Really good professor! He genuinely loves what he teaches and helping students succeed! I took this class for fun and do not regret it, the topic is so interesting!
Erik is awesome. Take his class and you won't be disappointed.

Cheries is a great professor. He is very passionate about the material he teaches and really wants his students to spark interest in subject and do their best. His lecture slides are sometimes unclear, but if you ask for clarification he will definitely help. Final is optional. Great class.
The class is interesting and he's a great teacher, but the exams are tough. You have to put in more time than you think and questions are worded in a tricky way.

Pretty straightforward guy. Lectures do get a little boring if you're not super interested in the material. Exams are all multiple choice and doable plus he offers multiple avenues of extra credit. Moodle assignments are a piece of cake.

His exams are straight forward, based mainly on his lectures. So although attendance is not mandatory, it's extremely helpful to go to class and take additional notes on his lectures. No need to copy the lecture word for word. He takes the best 3 exams out of 4!
Excellent professor. Appropriately funny, Friendly guy, Easy to approach, Straightforward material and Straightforward tests.
A great professor.  Erik is so helpful and his lectures are engaging and fun!  Exams are pretty straightforward and the final is optional.  He is so cute and really easy to listen to!

His teaching is clear and he keeps students engaged. I love the powerpoints, the homework assignments are interesting, the grading is more then fair. Oh and LADIES, he is so handsome. Guys, don't worry he's really chill too. Great class and a fabulous teacher who really cares and inspires you to learn more!
He's nice, very approachable and helpful! Many cute baby videos! Exams are not hard as long as you study your notes and the study guide. Don't need the textbook. Definitely my favorite class!
really awesome teacher. teaches very clearly and has a nice sense of humor. definitely recommend.

He's so helpful it's outrageous.  Funny and adorable, makes sure that the power points aren't boring as death, and includes lots of videos.  Tests are easy, because he teaches well--clear and concise.  Recommended!

One of the best professors at UMass. Really cares about his work and his teaching, and is a great lecturer. Shows a lot of baby study videos which are cute and also informative. Exams aren't hard if you study, and the assignments are not hard at all and you always get a 100. It's no surprise this class fills Bartlett 65 to its max capacity.

Erik stands out from other professors in the Psych department. He's genuinely concerned with his students welfare in his class. In fact, he often reiterates this point, making sure everyone's aware of the resources available to them. He's approachable, and very helpful!

Love! drops lowest test. all hw assignments are an automatic 100 if u do them which is worth 30 percent of the grade. Dont buy the book; I didnt and still got an A. He puts his slides online so in class write down everything he says not whats on the slides so you can go back and remember what the slides are about. so many cute baby videos!!!
Really awesome guy. Wants everyone to do well. Lectures usually pretty interesting. Exams can be a little tricky though, and the focus is mostly on one age range

He's so cute and funny. He cares a lot about his students, but I didn't find the tests easy. You really should read his review sheets, go to all exams. I wouldn't bother buying the book, I opened it maybe once. But overall, great class. Kept us engaged with funny videos and just overall a really cool and intelligent young guy.

great lecturer and wicked helpful prof. REALLY cares about his students doing well. met with students for 4 hours straight before our last exam! scales his tests and gives a ton of extra credit. you'd have to be asleep to do bad in this class...

my favorite teacher here so far! I just took his final and it was an absolute gift. He really rewards students who bother to study and meet with him to go over their old exams. Don't let the slackers scare you!
His exams were wicked hard almost the whole class got a c or below on the first two exams. He is very helpful when you went to his office hours. Exams sucked. Not as easy of a class as I thought

Prof. Cheries is such a funny and intelligent teacher.. Though the content of the actual class wasn't specifically interesting to me he always found ways to make the class interesting and funny. He gives opportunity for extra credit as well if you want to boost your grade. I highly recommend taking a class with him.
Very passionate about the subject and dedicated to helping his students learn. Plus-he's incredibly handsome. Come to class, remember to do the assignments, and you'll be fine.

Professor is great and very passionate about the material. He tries to make the class entertaining and the material easy to understand. Easy class if you go to class and do the short assignments. The material is not super interesting, but the professor tries to make it engaging.

This prof is young and cracks jokes during class. The material is sometimes not the most interesting stuff but he makes it fun with videos of cute babies! The tests are hard. You should go to class and study if you want to do well.

He loves babies! His lectures are straightforward, he uses lots of examples and videos and most of them have to do with babies. Personally I would have preferred to learn about a wider age of children but if cute videos about babies is your thing, this is the class for you!
Prof. Cheries is awesome! He's so nice, loves what he does and is willing to help anyone who asks for it. Take this class!

I had him for my "Origins of Knowledge" class, which was a Psychology advanced-level undergraduate seminar. The materials that we learned were really interesting. The best part was the slides that he prepared for his lectures (and also the lectures itself) as just by attending the lectures, you would be more than half-prepared for the exams !

Great professor with a  sense of humor. Learned a lot and looked forward to going to class. I believe he genuinely enjoys teaching. Fun use of video during lectures and very helpful if you have questions about the material. Highly recommend.

Good professor who seems really nice. Fair tests and interesting material. The only downside is that for those of us who do not take notes very quickly, he moves through his PowerPoint slides VERY quickly. It got really frustrating sometimes. Don't mean to be the Debbie Downer here cause I liked him otherwise.
Fabulous professor.  Show up, pay attention, take notes, review them before the exam, and you'll get an A.  He manages to make even fairly dull and pedantic material seem interesting.

Best professor ever! Lectures are always interesting, and often include video clips and pictures. Exams are based on the lectures, so if you attend class you can do well. He also has a sense of humor which is nice (Baby Radio and Developmental Moment of Zen!). I would definately recommend this class!

awesome class. definitely take it, prof cheries is the man. he's also nice to look at...and has a nice soothing voice too ;) subject matter is interesting and not difficult, DON'T BUY THE TEXTBOOK, go to class and you'll be good. 3 exams and an optional final, one dropped, all mult choice. also he was in the UMMB and thats awesome,he has bando love

Great professor. Going to lecture is actually an enjoyable part of my day because Prof. Cheries is very good at explaining concepts and he's nice to listen to. And to look at ;) Not hard, just go to class. You don't really need the textbook, even though he assigns readings. 3 Exams in the semester plus an optional final and lowest grade dropped

Without a doubt my favorite teacher here. Lectures are very clear, include video examples of experiments, he's very approachable, and answers questions well. Really nice and funny guy, I genuinely enjoyed going to class. Lectures are all online, SONA for extra credit, very accurate exam review sheets-only complaint is your grade is entirely exams

You will literally not pass because she is no help and you can ask clarifying questions and get no where. Her lectures are not engaging and boring/not helpful. She grades super harshly even if you answer her questions directly because she expects you to include examples even though in emails she said its not necessary. Bad study guides. Praying 4 u
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Exams are worth 75% of your grade, and they are brutal! If you put in the work, you will do fine. Oh btw, exams are all short answer and she is a very tough grader :))

Professor Dasgupta is a caring person who will always try and help her students as much as she can. If you put effort and try in this class, you WILL be fine. The exams are difficult, but she gives plenty of partial credit and provides ample study guides ahead of tests. While the weight of the tests is scary, you need to keep in mind it's honors.

There are 3 exams worth a total of 75% of our grade with the remaining 25 being HW and participation. This is an improvement from what previously was 90% for all three exams. This is unacceptable. Full stop. These exams are DIFFICULT. The lectures themselves are great, and she is a fantastic person and teacher, her grade makeup is just very bad.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: 3 written response tests worth 90% of grade total and a very tough grader (little partial credit). Great lecturer and very interesting subject material with lots of feedback but very difficult to leave with a good grade. I would not recommend if you don't want to bomb your major GPA
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She's a superb teacher and is accomplished in and passionate about social psych. The exams are lengthy and kinda hard but if you take notes in lectures and follow her review guide you should be fine. Super accessible outside class and helped me with all my doubts every time i went for office hours.
She is a fantastic teacher, passionate about the subject, knowledgable, and relatable. The class is challenging and you will need to work for it, but it's worthwhile and interesting.

Overall, this class is interesting but if you want to get a good grade, you have to be a good understand-er and reader. It costs you to spend a lot time of reading and memorizing. The lectures are some kinda dry but kind okay. The textbook is somewhat required because a lot of info. comes from it directly and many terms are not taught in class.
Good professor, imo. Teaches a smaller class size now (30-40 students). Very clear lectures, if a bit dull, but discussion was active and study guides, when fully utilized, guaranteed a decent grade.
LOVED HER!
Very friendly, listens to our opinions on issues we talk about in class. Taking another class with her next semester.
An excellent class.
No Comments
she is an awful teacher...if you want to take this class take it with professor isbell...she is soooo much more interesting. the material in this class is good but she does not teach it well

Did not enjoy this class. Her grading for participation is very unreasonable. Class is very uninteresting. The material can be interesting but the way she goes about teacher makes the subject very boring. Very confusing and exams were not well written.
a horrible class, i dont reccommend it to any one.. I've had so many problems with it, the evaluation of my work has been unfair, and the tests are made to be impossible.
Sigh...
She has a stupid participation grading, making over 300 people talk for credit.  Class is slow and boring.  She is not a good teacher, but you can gety a good grade if you show up to class.
tests are EXTREMELY difficult and the homework grading is completely unfair
No Comments

friendly but fake, inflexable, often unclear, tests are somewhat reasonable but test reviews are a complete joke, grading of the howework is ENTIRELY UNREASONABLE, and lastly attendence/participation metheods are weak and unfair based on which you choose.

this was the worst class i have ever taken at umass. she was boring. rumor has it that taking this class with the other teacher is so much better. all her examples she uses are straight from the book. her tests are hard and reviews dont cover anything.
worst teacher ever, avoid at all costs, could be interesting/easy class if taken with an alternate teacher

Prof is very nice, but easily sidetracked, only uses a chalkboard in dim lighting, and ideas jump all over the place. Would be a great prof in a small class. Easy to learn without comprehension, you can learn almost all the material for the class within a week or two without understanding the concepts. TA's are great and try their best to help.

Easy class but I learned nothing. Take this class with Despain for an easy A, but
personally I'd prefer to get my money's worth. He took down my last review for no reason 😡. TAs were trying their best but exams were all over the place and TAs clearly weren't receiving good communication from the professor.

His class was fun to be in, I enjoyed lectures and all the TAs were great. The only thing is that everything is written on a chalkboard which makes lecture notes hard in such a big lecture hall (even when sitting in the front). He is very exam heavy but if you study you should be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: everything is written on a chalk board, not mandatory but dont bother going you will not learn much, he gets easily side tracked. exams are hard especially because you have to self teach yourself everything but i think the exam grades are curved but he wont update any of you grades until dec so you have no idea what grade you have. avoid this prof

Took 394 with him, really a nice guy who is pretty easy on grading but so beyond unorganized, lectures aren't super engaging and don't encourage great understanding of the reading material. really essay heavy. overall you don't retain a lot in this class, and he's only graded one assignment and the semester is over.

I wouldn't say this class is very hard but Hans might be one of the most unorganized professors. Nothing is posted on canvas and he doesn't even have slideshows. You're graded on 3 problem sets, 1 midterm, and a final.  2nd midterm ended up getting cancelled. I'm sure the exams are heavily scaled, but i still haven't even gotten my score back.

Hans definitely doesn't deserve a 2.3 rating lol. He can definitely get off track during lectures. There are two exams, and the first one had a major curve. I thought I got probably a D, but I got a 95. The second exam hasn't happened yet so idk. Exams are pretty much identical to the homework. There are only three hw assignments the entire sem
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Nice guy, but super unorganized. Class is heavily weighted on quizzes that often contain material that wasn't covered in class or on the study guide. Used a chalkboard that could barely be understood all semester, and the lectures aren't even worth going to most of the time. There is no homework.

So kind, funny, and entertaining! Really wants to engage with students. Genuinely listens to our feedback and wants us to do well. A tad unorganized. If you want a good grade in this class, you can definitely make it happen with a little bit of hard work!

Hans is disorganized and unprofessional. He removed assignments/tests mid-semester, crammed all non-exam work into one week, and tries too hard to seem ‘cool' instead of teaching. Slides are sloppy, and exam test materials were often never covered in class, reviews, or referenced in the textbook.
Love him! So understanding and chill! Free candy for halloween too!
Dr. Day is an amazing professor and made the class very enjoyable. I don't even like reading or writing that much but this class made it bearable
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Caring

reviews.comment: Devin is such a great professor!! I usually never like English classes but his classes always made me engaged. He's also an easy grader, and thats coming from someone who's not good at writing. Seriously so sweet so you should def participate in his class!

He is a super nice and kind professor!! Very genuine and cares about his students. For a college english writing class it is SOO easy trust me. (we have readings but no one does them and you don't need to read to do well). we have 3 papers in the whole semester and i got A+ on all and I'm not even a good writer. TAKE HIS CLASS!!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He is so nice and always looking for participation which you get credit for. ALWAYS says if you need more time on an essay or assignment he will give it to you. He is a good grader he provides so much feedback and is overall a great guy/professor.

Very nice guy who clearly cares about his students and their success, two big essays and one project/essay for you final assignment, work load is manageable but still needs effort. Great professor, definitely recommend.
Great Professor, clearly cares about his student's work, gives great feedback, and I loved his personality. Definitely take a class with him.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I loved this class so much! Professor Day truly knows how to give amazing feedback, making you want to continue improving your writing. There are three main essays and he gives you plenty of time to complete them. If you're able to take English Writing 112H with him, please do! So worth your time in my opinion.

Professor Day was my favorite this semester. He was very sweet and seemed to genuinely care very much about helping students enjoy writing. He doesn't seem to mind late work much and overall his classes were entertaining. If you can have him for college writing definitely take his class.

Dr. Day is a great writing instructor! He has made the (expensive!) textbook for the course optional and shares PDFs or articles on Canvas for us to read instead. Most of his assignments are for completion. A paper per unit is assigned and he allows ample time for drafting, providing helpful comments during the process. Also great music taste!

Great professor and super caring! teaches relevant lessons to actually improve your writing. If you show up and do most homework (he's kinda lenient with late work which is nice), and communicate you'll do great. I feel like if you participate you'll get a good grade because he seems to really appreciate that.

He is a super sweet and very empathetic professor. There are lots of reading assignments that are spoken about in class for participation. There were only a few writing assignments/projects over the course of the semester and he is a very generous grader. I do not think he had any issues with extensions and was very liberal with absences.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Caring

reviews.comment: He had us read a disturbing paper during Hanukkah about how Anne Frank suffered in the concentration camps. The paper explained how Anne Frank's story needs to be broadcasted as a disgusting tragedy because today it really isn't. True, however don't pass that paper out during Hanukkah. Other than that, he was a great professor, no tests only essays
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: She is absolutely amazing! Fostered a great class community! She really cares about all of her students and creates great dialogue in class. Very supportive. Overall a fairly easy course. Participation matters and there are three essays but if you talk in class and try on the essays you will get a A. My favorite professor and class by far.

She said CNN is a right-leaning source, which basically means she's intellectually challenged. She also claimed the Iranian people loved the Ayatollah, which is laughable.

Even setting aside her obscene radical-left opinions, the fact that she believes CNN is right-leaning tells you everything you need to know.

Professor Marya claims to be open and inclusive. She preaches that we must question everything and think critically. However, if you disagree with her far-left opinions, she will immediately shut you down and give you a bad grade. Take this class if you are content sitting in a room for 1.5 hours with no technology while she spews misinformation
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Great professor who wants to see her students thrive. Participation is important but she will never cold call. Only 3 assignments (essays) and weekly readings, but you could get by even if you missed a reading or two. Would definitely recommend her for this class!
She was great, minimal work, doesn't force you to talk and if you ask her to view your outline before essay you are guaranteed a good grade. Def would recommend if you're taking 201H.

Professor Marya is such a kinda, caring lady. I definitely recommend her 201H class to any incoming freshman. There are readings for the class (which she provides) and they are usually pretty short, but honestly you can get away with not reading them at all. She just grades on participation so just talk in class and you will be okay!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Great class if you don't care about learning! Don't need to read or pay attention really. More of a lecture than a discussion. She talks at you all class and you regurgitate her opinions back 3x a semester in a paper. Just don't take if you like actually discussing material or anything. Also no tech allowed during lecture. Get ready to doodle!

Easy A, only three papers not harshly graded and lots of readings that you can get by not doing. However, Dr Marya has some outdated ideas and is not open to feedback. Difficult to have genuine discussion and argue anything that professor doesn't automatically agree with. She even gets mad at you if you try. Not bad if you don't care about learning
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I really enjoyed this class and the material taught. Prof Marya is very sweet and kind and always genuinely wanted students to participate for their own benefit. I would definitely recommend her.

This class was a perfect amount of work, composed of 3 moderate-length papers written on highly relevant and exciting topics. Professor Marya is more than willing to meet students outside of class time to go into detailed feedback. Her presence is warm and inviting, making the class a conducive environment for learning complex topics.

This class was much easier than the other sections of 201H from what I've heard, only 3 papers, 3, 4, and 5 pages respectively over the semester, and Professor Marya is very lenient. She is very knowledgeable, though she does tend to talk a lot for a discussion based class.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The best 201H prof you can get. Reading or watching HW for every class, not bad at all. 3 short pages that arent harshly graded, just put in some effort. Prof Marya is very caring and inspiring. Topics discussed were eye opening. There are participation points so try to contribute to discussions.
I really enjoyed her class. She really cares about her students.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor Marya is so extremely educated and insightful, and such a joy to have as an instructor. The readings can be difficult at times, but she takes great care to lecture and explain the material throughout class. She assigns a couple of essays throughout the semester and if you can write a rhetorical analysis essay, you will be set!

She is very intelligent and kind and has an incredible understanding of a variety of topics. Weekly readings/movies that are discussed in class and 3 papers assigned throughout the semester. Most classes you discuss really cool and important topics, sometimes you spend a little too long on them though. You can tell she cares about every student.

Each class we spoke about either a reading or movie, which were at times hard to follow but she was always sure to give an in depth explanation before discussion. There are 3 papers throughout the semester which have multiple options for prompts and she gives great feedback for improvements. She speaks with great passion and I enjoyed her insight.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Inspirational

reviews.comment: Great professor. A reading/film is assigned for homework and you discuss it in class. Some of the readings are a little hard to parse/can be long, but she is good at listening to your thoughts on the material as well as explaining things. You have to write 3 essays based on the readings/films but she will offer to help you out if you need it.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Professor Marya is amazing, her ideas are well-put and inspirational. Coursework is easy, reading-heavy but extremely manageable. There are about 3 papers, all of which are graded easily. It makes sense that this class is a requirement for first-years. Definitely take it with Marya if you are able to.

Deepika was akin to being a motherly figure for me this semester. She was very sweet and caring of everyone and welcomed multiple opinions in discussions. Gives good feedback to allow you to improve and is a very fair grader for participation and essays.

Deepika is such a sweet, funny, and laid-back gem of a person herself. She is very humble and considerate, she frequently listens to students when they were feeling burnt out, and 201H under her is always managed well.

I really enjoyed and loved Professor Marya's class. She is really sweet and caring. The lectures were super interesting. It is a small class so attendance is mandatory and you should be prepared for discussions. You can learn a lot from this class without having a crazy amount of workload. Really recommend taking classes with Professor Marya!

I loved Professor Marya's class! Most of the grade is based on only a few papers, but they are not hard and her grading is very fair. As long as you go to class and participate in discussions you'll be fine, it's also interesting to listen to her lectures because you can tell she really cares about the material.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I really loved having Professor Marya! She genuinely made every discussion interesting and encouraged everyone to participate. Additionally, she is really sweet and cares about all her students. She purposefully assigns short readings for every class so we can get the most out of discussion. Definitely my favorite class and professor!

Professor Marya was so sweet to everyone in our class. It is a small discussion based class where you discuss the readings or films she assigns for each class. Only reason I dock a point is because sometimes there is a lot of work, but most of the topics are really interesting. She is very knowledgeable and inspiring during the lectures too.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Inspirational

reviews.comment: Such a nice professor. Really cares about her students and always takes their thoughts into consideration. Can be reading heavy but discussion is helpful in explaining things. Probably would have been much better in person but she did well given the circumstances

She's a really good teacher in the sense that she makes the class interesting and really helps our readings and videos be more interesting. The big negative though is that she doesn't do a good job at all in keeping politics out of it and letting the students make decisions for themselves. She doesn't provide multiple sides/opinions for each topic.
agree with the comment below, took her class on globalization. I learnt a lot. Her lectures were very helpful in understanding globalization.
loved her class on globalization, please take it with her if you can
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Get ready to read--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: really helped with my writing. lots of class assignments, and lots of homework
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: this was an amazing class, i am so glad i took it with her. her lectures were so helpful in understanding the readings.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Taking Ideas with Prof. Marya was awesome. You need to participate in class, do some reading, but the major part of your grade is the four 4-6 page papers you need to write. She grades them relatively easily and allows you to rewrite them for a better grade at any point in the semester! So the only one stopping you from getting an A is you.

This professor typically had my Ideas class read an article or watch a film and sent us questions to discuss in the next class period. However, these questions were very plot-based so there wasn't much to actually discuss. Other than that, this professor had many great ideas. This class is an easy A with minimal work.

One of the best classes out there. No wonder it's mandatory for CHC students. It really is phenomenal, especially if you take it with this professor. Your input into the class  how much you get out of it. If you would rather put minimal effort, you can still easily get an A.
Gives good feedback and allows you to improve through rewriting papers. Very nice person as well.

She is extremely kind and genuinely cares about every student. Even if she gives you an A- on a paper, she recommends that you edit it to get an A. She believes it shouldn't be a class that people struggle with, and does a great job of making it so! You learn a lot about different global ideas, and it is an interesting class. Would take again!
lectures were extremely boring. nice guy, but not a good enough teacher for me to care about this class

Attendance is EC in lab + optional for lecture, exams are open note + online in person. Preparation guides every week for extra credit, so do those to help prepare for exams! Matt is sometimes disorganized on canvas as well, as he posts rubrics last minute and is constantly regrading many assignments. Caring, & wants students to succeed. EASY A.

He's a nice person, but the class is poorly structured. Lectures are boring, very little guidance in lab on R Studio assignments, and exams are randomly difficult even though they're open-note. Many extra credit opportunities, if you do them you'll get an A, but this class is way harder than it needed to be. Would not take another class with him

He clearly cares and enjoys the material he teaches but lectures can become extremely boring at times. Exams are open note but won't help if you don't study well beforehand. Very straightforward course structure, with extra credit such as SONA (up to 4% increase on your final grade and prep guides). Also hope you get a good graduate TA for lab.

He is really nice and cares about what he is teaching. But the lectures are so boring. They are so repetitive and you probably know more than half the material before taking the class. Exams are open note but your notes won't really help you. In class activity once a week. The projects are the only fun part but it's a pretty easy class.

I didn't do well on the first exam, but I barely studied and tried relying on it being open-book. I upped my grade with EC (based on the free + online textbook) and SONA (8 credits that add 4 points to final grade). Davidson is caring and sweet. The lectures can be a little boring. Office hours will help with R Studio assignments.
Nicest guy ever you can tell he really cares about his students and he loves what he does

Very sweet guy, allotted 5 minutes of meditation time before class. Class material is super boring but it's not his fault. Pretty open communicator. Moodle was a mess though and the lab is annoying. Some tricky multiple choice questions on exams but overall not too bad.

This professor was extremely rude to me. When I reached out with a question he responded with, and I quote, "Next time do some research before reaching out to me". Overall, extremely condescending and disrespectful. I am very interested in this class content but I would never take another course with this professor.

Nice guy, sounds like Winnie the Pooh, just happens to teach boring content. He was responsive to feedback & gave many extra credit opportunities, if you put in the effort you'll get an A. 
My TA would often not let us know an assignment was due until the day of...Take good notes bc the tests are long & timed & hope you have a good TA.. good luck

Lab is where you use R studio and you get extra credit for going. My ta's were EXTREMELY helpful for using R. Lecture was important esp for exams. If you hated psych 240 then good luck. I was so thankful to get a C but definitely should have gone to more lectures. Def do SONA for extra credit too! Also has extra credit with weekly review sheets.

The lecture itself was not needed, he does a participation activity every friday so don't miss class that day. He offers a LOT of extra credit, which is also great. The discussion was the hardest part. GO!! I had Erica and she was amazing, I heard other TAs can be harder. But most of your grade is from the work done in the discussion.

Psych 241 is a very easy class. I barely paid attention in lecture and got an A easily. The course is mostly centered around the lab, so attending lab is important. Online exams were 50 questions in 60 minutes, which was a time crunch, but Matt gives a lot of extra credit so things even out. The material is rather monotonous but not hard.

I got a 50 and an 80 on the two exams, didn't take the final and i got an A. He gives out so much extra credit. Very nice man, go to labs, read textbook, hand things in on time and you're good. The material is just a little dull that it is hard to pay attention.

This class is boring content wise but SO EASY TO PASS. Literally attending and participating gives you EC, you get EC for showing up to lab section (you're going to want to) R STUDIO IS HORRIBLE FOR LAB DATA. 3 reports for lab, 2/3 exams counted. literally everything else is EC for the class plus up to 4% from SONA EC. Exams take home except final.

Matt is a very nice guy, but it is just so hard to stay engaged in lecture. The tests often times have very random questions, but there is lots of opportunity to get points and extra credit elsewhere. Unfortunately, I don't feel like I really learned anything in this class.

Really nice guy, just happens to teach a boring class no one cares about. He sometimes notices that fact and gets understandably frustrated. Really he wants to see students succeed, even gave me opportunity for points back after not doing surveys that were worth 10 exam points. I love his meditations before lecture, helps me adjust to ILC commute.

Matt is not an end all professor, you'll survive this class, but his organization is bad. Moodle page is hard to navigate, unclear due dates, labs can be hit or miss depending on the TA. Exams are open notes, but 50 questions with 50 minutes. Lectures are dry. Attendance is not mandatory but he does zooms ONLY on friday for in class activities.

Davidson is a nice person, but not a great lecturer. He is very disorganized with his lecture material which makes studying difficult. He's also not very good at answering student's questions about the material.  Read the textbook for exams.

Labs are incredibly useful because you gain practice in coding, data analysis, and scientific writing.

This class was pretty boring but it was the fault of the material not the prof. He was a nice guy who was very accommodating throughout the semester, and gave everyone the tools to succeed in the class. Not the most engaging lectures, and his tests didn't always seem to lineup with what was discussed in class, but a solid professor.

Prof davidson is a very nice person, but his teaching is not that great. His lectures are very hard to follow and you never really know whats going to be on the test, he just kinda throws in a mix of everything that was even mentioned or could have been mentioned. The labs are very hit or miss depending on your TA.

In all honesty, Matt may be the least engaging professor at the school. I could not bring myself to pay attention to any aspect of what we learned in lecture. Learned far more in the lab component than anything else. SONA credits can boost your grade by 4%, so do that! Exams were online for our sem, which made things nicer, but be wary.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Davidson is a nice guy, outlines stuff really well and always finds ways to help students. The material for the class is really boring, and lectures can sometimes be difficult to take notes for. There are multiple projects completed in the Lab section, be ready to use R a lot. Do the study guides for the exams, very useful
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Exams are harder than lecture content, but are open note and online in class. 1/3 exams and 1/7 hws are dropped. Pay attention in labs, TAs go over how to do the hw and you pick it up quickly. In class assignments can also be done over zoom + some are dropped. This class is definitely more work than it is difficult, so just stay on top of lab hw!

He seems like a kind guy, but the material is boring. I never went to class except on in-class assignment days, and I still did fine. Exams are open note and on Moodle, quick work. Attendance at lab sections is extremely important because they help you do your worksheets which are a big part of your grade. Read the book it's very helpful.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The material is dry and tedious. The lectures are somewhat helpful but can be hard to follow. My biggest advice is to read the textbook for each chapter, it's the quickest way to learn this stuff. 2 tests, optional final, in class assignments, and lab work. Lab work can be a lot but the TAs are helpful.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The content in this class is dry. Matt does his best but, it was hard to stay engaged. You are graded on in-class activities, three exams (2 of 3 scores kept) and lab reports/worksheets. Read the textbook and take notes according to the study guide. Attend lab to stay on track. The TAs are decent. Just an average class that you gotta get through.

Incredibly boring and material is very dry. Professor trys his best. DO SONA CREDIT! 2 exams and a cumulative final that are open note but pretty hard. The lab section is hard if you don't know how to use R Studio and if you have a bad TA its really rough. Just make it through the class. Important to take notes on everything and read the book.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Matt Davidson is such a nice guy.! Go to lecture, take good notes, and read the textbook (not that much at all) and you will be completely fine. Also go to lab and do the HW ** before ** your next lab and it is super manageable. 3 projects, in-class activities every week, exams can be a little hard but there is only 2. Overall not a bad class.

I did not learn a single thing in this class, he reads everything right off the slides. Also you're really on your own learning the material because the only assignments you ever get are through lab sections, he never assigns work for the actual lecture and never makes sure his students understand the material, there are also ONLY 2 exams.

READ THE TEXTBOOK BEFORE CLASS. I think it's an awful class until I realize I didn't listen to him when he said read chapters beforehand. It makes a difference. If you're good at statistics you'll breeze through it, if not it'll be a challenge. The lectures are kind of confusing, but again the textbook really clears it up. Do the exam study guides!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Prof Davidson is definitely a very sweet and caring person, even if the lectures are not the most engaging. Most of the work from this class is done in the lab which is a lot of coding assignments and lab reports. Honestly not my favorite class but it's a requirement for psych majors, as long as you pay attention in lectures the tests aren't awful.

This class was okay. Not hard but not easy either. you are only graded on in class activities which are graded for completion, midterm and final. The material is boring but you need to watch the lectures to pass. Lectures are recorded and posted so there is no mandatory attendance. He offers SONA extra credit

Prof Davidson is the kindest, most genuine man. If you are a hard worker who attends classes, takes VERY GOOD notes, and prepares for exams in advance - you will ace this class. He makes stats pretty interesting, is accessible, and explains the material so well. Only two exams and he is a very very fair grader. Definitely a must take !
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Overall the class itself was really hard, especially because his lectures and slides were all over the place. He was frequently really passive aggressive, especially over emails, which made me hesitate to contact him if I needed him in the class. This made the class really difficult.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I really enjoyed having Davidson for PSYCH 241! As a lot of comments have mentioned, research methods material will probably be boring no matter who teaches it. However, I found the lectures quite interesting because he clearly made an effort to add something more to them. He's also very understanding and willing to help. :)

The textbook was mostly useless. It looks like so much reading but all you need to do is copy the important terms and read the highlighted parts (its online). There are in class activities every day that you need to do. Lectures are VERY boring, but its just because the material sucks. The class isn't hard if you just push through it.

Unfortunately I had no choice but to take this class with Davidson because its a requirement but oh my lord if this isn't the most boring class and most dry monotonous lectures I've ever had... The course is ok itself but the delivery made it painful and the opposite of beneficial to a learning experience
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: As everyone else has said, this class is very boring and the material is dry. However, as long as you do the weekly homework, are at least somewhat present during the in-class quizzes -just look at the learning outcome sheet-, and spend more than 30 minutes on each of the 3 labs you should get an A. Lots of SONA credits and only one exam, the final
He's a nice guy, but soo monotone so drink your coffee first. Chances are you're a psych major who has to take this, but it'll be ok just make sure you do the reading quizzes!

I genuinely do care about all my students. In addition to wanting you to do well, I care that you pay attention, that you follow instructions, and that you submit a complete assignment in a 400 level course. Also, I care that you ask questions when you have them rather than wasting time and getting frustrated. We will all be happier that way.

Based on the date of the first comment I am confident this is from the student who was caught cheating three times before Feb 28th. They were turning in fake Dr. notes and other BS that required a charge be filed. Clear violations of the academic honesty policy require responses from faculty, or the policies will become worthless in the end.

I had him for Research Methods too, as every Psych major must, and he's is my least favorite professor by far. Beneath his veneer as a caring professor is a passive-aggressive man who looks down on you when you aren't following along in class/don't understand something. He grades harshly, and subjectively too. Overall if you can avoid him do it.
WORST. PROFESSOR. EVER.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This class really made me think, rather than just memorize the material, and I liked that the activities were rolling assignments we worked through together. The Prof did a good job of covering key concepts and designs and was available for help whenever I needed it. There is a lot of support to do well in this course, you just need to use it.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: I thought the Prof did a good job making dry material kind of interesting. Some of the examples were cool, imo. I will take activities over lectures any day, even if that means readings on my own. We are in college now and need to be able to learn some stuff on our own. Not the most entertaining class but an easy A if you do your homework!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: This class was different from most but was pretty easy once I figured out the blended thing. There is a chapter quiz each week and activities every day but they are straightforward if your prepared. You get to talk to your friends a lot so that can be helpful, as long as someone is prepared. An easy A if you do the work and attend class regularly!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: absolutely horrible class and professor. expects you to teach yourself the entire course through the textbook. gives no clarification in class. ridiculously ineffective quizzes in class. avoid this class at all costs. professor is extremely boring, does not clarify points and just expects you to know everything. one of the worst/most boring yet...
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: A ineffectual professor. Lecture is drier than saltines and likes to play the "this should be easy by now" card about once a class after mid-semester. Doesn't do a good job helping students understand concepts; usually assumes students have mastered material simply by doing the readings. Typically acts baffled when students don't know an answer.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: The most boring class taught by the most boring man. I didn't pay much attention to his lectures because a lot of it can be common sense but most of it is taken from the textbook. There are vocab quizzes every week and one final, which isn't too bad. There is only one group project at the end of the semester but with a good group its not that bad.

EZ A if you follow this: 1. Get a good TA (50% of grade is simple lab work with few stats. A good TA makes your life so much easier) 2. Quizlet is your friend. Look up answers for all online quizzes (there's 10). 3. Show up to class, assignment almost every class, and have a doc on your phone of the current key concepts (10 in-class quizzes).
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: This class uses a flipped classroom so a lot of the material you will have to teach yourself. Class time is just used for quizzes every single day which gets rather annoying. The lab portion has papers due every few weeks but most of the lab time is spent working on them so they aren't too terrible. Overall it is a pretty easy A if you do the work.
