This is quite possibly the worst class ever. If your taking it, good luck understanding derivations. There is only one way to understand the material, if you don't there's not really anything to do.
There is something about a teacher that alludes to Modern Warfare in class that just warms my heart.  A pure genius and personally mentor/hero.
Nice guy. He knows its boring materical so he makes jokes to make the time go faster. You take 6 exams and he drops the lowest 2 grades. Exams are kind of hard, so study!
So funny! Great professor, very smart.
He's no Fred Feldman
Funny guy, study the material the day or two before each test, and you will ace the class. Easy stuff, terribly boring material.
Very funny and smart guy. Don't need to go to class at all, he wrote the book. If you can do problem sets in book you will ace the course.

A truly excellent man. He likes to laugh at his own jokes, but hes amusing and very clear. If you go to the classes then it will be easy to get through the exams. One of the nicest people Ive met outside of class as well. I imagine that in high school, he'd be a nerdy guy that wore button downs that was on the model un that the cool kids liked too.
Excellent professor.  If you show up and do your homework, 90% of you will understand him.  If you ask him any questions you need answered, you're almost guaranteed to pass.

Easy class but teacher was major  turnoff to the subject. Never showed up considering he had very dry humor and on taking my final he made a very rude comment to me. Suggest the class, not the professor.

Ok. Remember the guy from the Clear Eyes commercial? "For dry eyes use Clear Eyes!" Yeah...you could probably compare class with Professor Hardegree to that commercial. The material? Absolutely useless. However, Hardegree is a cool guy!! Take the time out to talk with him after class. It may or may not help your grade. The book is online too.

It's a fun class! If you pay attention to the powerpoints and do practice problems, you'll do just fine in the class! Attendance may not be mandatory, but it REALLY helps to go. The way he explains problems in class is incredibly useful.

gary's a bubbly guy, loves cracking jokes. no homework and you can skip classes and learn everything two days before the test and do okay. also he gives you 6 tests and only counts 4...so its easy to do well

He's a great guy, laughs at his own jokes, clear about expectations. Either you get it or you dont, but he will try and make sure you get it. Will definitely help students who ask for it. Do the homework problems!  Best 4 out of 6 exams, one of my easiest A's at UMass, but still an interesting class. Worth taking!
Awesome class. Wicked funny. Don't need to show up. Easy A. He takes the best 4 out of 6. Definitely one of the best profs at UMass.
Hardegree is a great teacher. He's funny and loves to laugh at his own jokes. Logic is definitely one of those things you either get or you don't but if you're proactive he'll help you out.
He's clear about what he expects from you, and he's pretty fair.  The class is incredibly boring, though.  He goes off on tangents and I fell asleep a few times.
hardegree is the man. every word that comes out of this man's mouth are like prcieless gems. this class is a v. good intro and is unquestionably easy.

Amazing class and professor. Shouldnt be too difficult if you go to class and do the homework problems (at least some of them). Teacher is hilarious and makes class very interesting. Definitely one of my best professors so far.

Hardegree is a riot, cuz hes just strange in a funny way. The class is pretty hard if u dont pay attention. One of those, either u get it or u dont classes. Buy the book b/c a lotta the questions on tests come straight from book examples. Not necessary to go everyday to class, u can seriously teach urself stuff using the book & powerpoints.

Funny teacher. Don't have to go to class. Lecture slides and notes online. No textbook, you can look online for it or buy one if you want. Three tests. If you miss one you can make-up during finals week. No make-up during the semester though. It's a difficult class though... Great guy though.

This was one of teh hardest classes ive taken. But i got a tutor to explain everything to me and ended up doing well in the class. You never have to go to class. theres no point, he doesnt explain anything and he wont if u go to his office too. GET A TUTOR, you can get an A. Also, REALLLYY EASY TO CHEAATT!!

He has a very dry sense of humor which made the class.  I dont like logic at all but if you do the exercises at the end of the chapters you should do well.  Lectures are posted online so there is no need to have to go to class.

The professor wrote the book and put the slides and the notes on-line, so going to class isn't necessary.  The problem is that the information covered is so boring and useless that you'll end up cramming right before the test and then dreaming of tildes, backwards Es and upside down As.

you dont have to go to class. read his book, do all the problems in the end of the chapters and you'll get an A. he's a very smart man. oh and you have the option to take two more exams to replace two lowest score exams.

A very funny man. I had a conversation with him about the Carpenters. Seriously. Not an easy class, but passable and enjoyable so long as Hardegree's rather high-brow sense of humor doesn't throw you for a loop.

I recommend this class to anyone looking to fulfill their R2. Very interesting class. Hardegree is a subtle riot, his dry humor makes the class. One of the few classes I went to daily. i would recommend that philosophy majors take this class before phil 100.
yes, this guy knows what he's talking about, but he's a **** pig

Because Professor Hardegree wrote the book he teaches from, his lectures tend to be exactly the same as the chapters which coincide with them. While many may not like this, I find such a method to be very helpful. Missing lectures is no problem as long as I read the book and do the exercises, and slacking with the reading as long as I go to lecture and do the exercises. I'm not really interested in logic at all, but his strange sense of humor (which shows in his examples) at least makes the class bearable.
Took every class (20 years ago) he taught.  Great, funny, a bit weird at times.
Awesome teacher.  His book and lectures are extremely clear and make it an easy subject.  Read the book or go to his lectures and do some problems and you'll earn an A like nothing.

boring subject matter. only had to attend lectures and do very few text exercise problems(which are harder than his actual test questions)to prepare for tests and get A's. the before and after class notes online is a plus too.

I came into the class thinking "what the hell". Prof. Hardegree is weird at times.. and going to the lectures is a MUST.. but what helped me get through were the helps of the TA's before the exams. I came into that class thinking an F was in store for me.. I'm going home with an A.
Nice guy, sort of strange, very helpful.  If you understand the logic in class then the class is an easy A, otherwise it's a bit of work.  The text is good though.

This course was entirely too easy. Class was unbearably slow.  Not recommended for those who want to continue in philosophy-take something more challenging, or read on your own! Sometimes his text makes things more confusing by explaining them more than they need to be explained.  Nice guy though...

If ever you have trouble understanding the subject matter, see him during his office hours.  He is very helpful, unless he is talking about baseball.  His humor is so unique, that if it were anyone else it wouldn't be funny, but I can't help but laugh at all of his jokes.  Good guy.
If you get it you get it...it was hard for me..i busted my butt to learn the crap but couldnt...its easy if u get it..if u dont strap urself in
He's a good professor, as long as you can stand his dry humor.
Occasionally funny in a wierd sort of way, an alright teacher (boring though), and a really interesting subject matter.
He is a nice guy but don't take the class unless you are into logic. So boring that you are forced to skip class. Just take the damn calculus for your R2.
No Comments
great guy, ok teacher
such an easy class
One of the best teachers at this university. People might not like him because they have no sense of humor, or because they are bad at doing logic.

One of the wierdest professors I've ever had. Looks like Al Franken. Tells terrible jokes. Puts water on the overhead, swirls the marker around in it, and says it reminds him of the 60s. A strange fellow. But I liked it.
Don't take a class with him unless you have to.  He is boring, his jokes are bad, and his grading system is overly difficult
Couldn't stand the course. Don't ever take it!! It's boring, and completely useless
No Comments
Most boring prof I've had.
good teacher, great jokes
No Comments
Great funny professor. Class structure is super clear. Exams should be easy if you look at practice exams.
The sample exams the professor provided were super helpful.

your grade is based on 3 exams and a few owl quizzes. extra credit barely makes a difference. do not go to office hours and ask for help, he brags about his 'accomplishments'. if ur not in class and reach out to him he will bring up how u didnt go to class, exam gradings are harsh without any feedback, messing up 1 thing will end up in no points
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--EXTRA CREDIT--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He is an absolutely horrible teacher, too focused on trying to be a "hardo" teacher and appear tough, when hes just a little old man. So embarrasing and hes a rude disgusting person. Will make fun of students during lecture and is overall just a miserable human being. Do not take him

3 Exams make up 60% of your grade, and good luck coming back from a few bad owl quiz grades and a bad exam. I really did not anticipate this class being that difficult, but he teaches how to solve problems in Excel, but tests us on pen and paper. This makes studying extremely difficult if your not math savvy, like me. Save your GPA and avoid this 1
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Horrible professor who needs to be dealt with. Spends the whole class trying to show how smart he is rather than teaching anything. He also constantly messes up the material so he is clearly not very educated at all. Very confusing how he even has a job here, is most likely the least intelligent and worst professor ive ever had

Professor Iqbal Agha is a very funny professor, both intentionally and unintentionally. Unfortunately the course content was rather boring (not his fault) and his explanations of said content were often not sufficient. Weekly homework quizzes were often confusing and time consuming, however exams were quite easy and identical to the practice exams.
Pretty easy class. The last 4 weeks ramps up but even then its not bad at all. Weekly quiz and the practice problem solutions basically are the quiz questions. same with exams
He is very out of touch with his students. This class is hard for no reason you have to teach yourself.
Amazing professor- Wish he taught more classes!

By far one of the best professors I have ever had. He understands what he is teaching very well and the class is not hard. Just do the self-assessment before you take the quizzes and then you'll be fine for the exams. He posts videos on how to do the problems too. Everyone should take a class with him!
He is the best professor I have ever had. Incredibly smart and funny. Class isn't too hard at all. Any rating under a 4 or 5 is simply inaccurate, he's all around a great guy.

You can definitely pass this course without the textbook since most of the quizzes depend on his lectures. His lectures can be dry and confusing at times which can be frustrating. However, he is a generous grader and you get a practice exam for each unit, many extra credit opportunities and 2 attempts on each unit quiz. Do the work and you'll be ok
Best professor in UMass, no write up necessary.

Agha is an extremely knowledgeable and helpful teacher who care a lot about his students. The class is rigorous and covers a lot of material in a short time-frame. Grades are based largely on tests and projects, where homework is graded but weighted lightly. Effort is required to do well.

Agha is the man. A professor that understand when students are losing focus and knows how to reign them back in during lecture. Legitimately cares whether his students understand the material or not. By far the best professor I have ever had.

Gives an online quiz every week, but aren't too bad. The test is a good reflection of those quizzes. Gives extra credit. Let's you bring a cheat sheet to the test. Prints out notes for you if you go to lecture, but it isn't required.

He covers a lot of material. It is a good quality material. At times, it is tough to understand. However, he's available all the time over email, phone.        One of the thing that would drastically improve his teaching style, upload live class video for the student. This would benefit online and on-campus students
Horrendously boring material and also the worst prof I've ever had. If you like teaching yourself, take him. Otherwise avoid this man at all costs.
I would take this class with him. Very easy
Easy class. Great teacher who makes it interesting.

He is such an incredibly interesting, well spoken, and compassionate person. Very helpful to engage in many different formats; lectures, readings, discussions, journals, reflections. I really enjoyed this course and felt I learned a lot packed into such a short period of time!  I'm actually really glad he had us take physical notes. Class was interesting but lectures were confusing. I enjoyed this class. Professor Kaiser's choice of book is really good and inspiring in understanding the sociological perspective. He breaks down abstract ideas into actual examples. There are discussion posts due each week but if you have done the readings they are easy to answer.

I think the amount of groupwork Professor Kaiser used was a very helpful teaching style to get different perspectives and ideas. A lot of the times that I did not understand something, my group members would talk me through it. Being able to express my own ideas during lecture and be corrected or be told that your idea is strong was very effective.

The group activities were especially helpful because when I got to hear what other people said about their experiences it made a lot more sense. But, there were times that I was greatly impacted by the professor speaking about the lessons. Particularly when the professor made themselves seem more human and related to us or our experiences.

I really like how class is divided into small groups and has time dedicated to talking within groups because sometimes I need someone else to explain something in a different way for it to make sense, so being able to talk to classmates often about the topics during the lecture allowed time for that and helped my understanding of the materials.

The way Prof Kaiser lectures in class was helpful. Prof Kaiser lectures in a casual and comforting tone. He really dissects every chapter/ reading of the week and does so in a simple but informative way. I loved the carefulness of what was being said and allowed in the course.

A big aspect of this course was discussions with groups who have all different opinions or experiences. This allowed me to see the bigger picture on almost any subject. Class discussion and weekly discussion posts helped me learn because I can't sit through an hour lecture straight and I found it interesting learning about others perspectives.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Accessible outside class

The breakdown Professor Kaiser did almost every class during lectures where he talked through the main concepts that were eventually covered on the exam, and gave examples with text evidence really helped me tie ideas together and succeed on the exams. SOCIOL106:

Dr. Wilson is an amazing lecturer and extremely knowledgeable about all things classics! Sometimes he would go on tangents but I always found them interesting and related to the material. Classes are interesting he expresses a great understanding of material. Talks about it more as an interest then like he's teaching. Do recommend as a professor. is very passionate about the subject that he goes out of order

Awesome guy, I'm scheduling my next year on how many Joe Wilson classes I can take. reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

Practice exams do not always mean the exam is on that content. BE WARE.

Quiz are open note, 3 exams, final exam, attendance, homework, lab. Attend all classes, get 30 extra points. Do all the homework, get 7 extra points. Attend all PLTL meetings, 10 extra points. Great guy. Genuinely wants his students to do well, gives a lot of of help outside the classroom and responds to emails fast. Class is difficult and your expected to memorize a lot of things but it will help you in the long run. If you put effort into this class you will do well.

Prof. Mentzen's class is definitely difficult and requires a lot of effort, but he's a caring professor that really does want you to succeed in his course. By far one of my favorite professors this semester. A very fair grader and lays out material and grading criteria clearly. Always accessible for HW/exam questions both in-class and by email. Funny and tries to make class as entertaining as chemistry can be.
This is definitely a class you have to lock in and study for. As long as you pay attention and do all the OWL's (even the optional ones are super helpful) and study hard you will do just fine
Professor Mentzen is an awesome professor and really helps you understand the material even though a bit difficult.
Great lecturer, even with 112 being a lot harder. He explains concepts well and is willing to go over them so you understand. Encourages questions.

Good professor, very accessible for office hours and after class questions. He explains the material relatively well and makes due dates very clear. Exams were similar to the OWL homeworks and he drops the lowest quiz score

Does not put in grades the entire semester, does not care about students personal matters even when clearly communicated to him, and rarely responds to emails. Lectures are okay if you can understand math by clicking through slides. Overall a 2/10 professor and not a good freshmen professor.

He explains every thing he teaches in class. He is always open to answering questions during class and constantly encouraging students to go to SI sessions and his office hours if they're confused.
