reviews.comment: Prof. Z is super passionate and engaging. While the workload can feel heavy at times, her teaching style and practice materials are incredibly helpful. Unstuck AI was a game-changer for nailing the cumulative exams.

Dr. Zehnder was a fabulous teacher. She always made the classroom feel welcoming and taught with great clarity and was willing to go over tough topics. As long as you put in the work, her class is very manageable!

Dr. Z's was my favorite class of the semester, you could tell she had a real passion for bio and for teaching. As someone who took highschool bio over covid and didn't remember anything, this was not an issue in Dr. Z's class, everything was explained completely and background knowledge was provided where needed
Best teacher I have had so far; clear and concise teaching method, lots of opportunities to practice content and get easy points, practice tests are exactly like exams.

There were 3 midterms and then a final; multiple choice and open response. Lots of homework each week including an online open-note quiz, a HW of 10 questions, discussion HW, and a learning reflection (kind of a waste of time). All her exams questions are pulled from the HW's and iclicker questions or worded similar. Overall pretty good!

I loved Dr. Zenhder. She was very clear in her lecture. The homework was super light and easy to understand. The discussion sections and TAs were a great help. She offered extra credit during the semester and tests were exactly like the practice tests and iclicker questions.

She's incredibly organized, so great at explaining, and overall a great professor! There's weekly discussion homework & sections, quizzes, learning reflections. Put work into this course & ask her for help and you should do great. Got some extra credit for 2 surveys & her exams are a bit tough but very fair (stuff done in worksheets/iclicker mcqs)!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Absolutely loved her class this semester. Lectures are super informative and she does a great job explaining difficult topics. Study clicker questions and practice exams and you'll most likely be fine. If you have the opportunity to take a class with her 100% would recommend.

She is one of the best teachers I have ever had. She is very clear and precise in her lectures with a lot of iclicker questions to actively stay engaged. Has great practice exams and iclicker review question. 100% recommend.

Dr. Zehnder is, simply put, the best professor out there. I have never came across a more passionate, caring, smart, and understanding professor. All that matters to her is that her students are learning, stress-free, and accommodated. She is a gem! I highly recommend taking any of her courses.

Her lectures are a lot of info but she does a good job teaching, exams are hard but the weight of them isn't horrible, exam do aheads are annoying but she's so nice and if you review and do the assignments and keep up with it you should do well.

If you can take her for Bio 151 I'd highly recommend. The class can be pretty early but her teaching style is well worth it. She allows multiple choice redos on midterms which can be a major exam score booster if you struggle with test-taking. She also gives practice exams that are very similar to the actual ones so she prepares you well for exams.
Weekly homework and quiz (lowest is dropped), one major project (but you get to choose when you want to do it), easy grader, tests are based off of quizzes and lecture questions

I cannot say enough good things about Dr. Zehnder. I will admit, the course content is not easy but if there's anyone who can teach it well and help you suceed, its her. She not only has clear grading and plenty of office hours, but genuinely cares about her students. With a solid amount of effort, its a doable A. Take her class if possible.
This was an amazing class with an amazing professor! She was great at giving feedback and super helpful. She was super nice and always responded to emails quickly.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: I really liked Prof. Zehnder. Had her for 151 and 152 and she is a very caring prof and she is passionate. Workload is pretty average but might feel like a little much sometimes, but all of it is very helpful in the end and honestly saves a lot of studying. Exams can be a little on the tough side at times but all the hw grades help out.
Favorite bio teacher! Only person I'd be this happy to have to listen to at 9am on a Monday morning. Take this class with her.

Easily one of the kindest professors who you can tell truly cares for all her students. Not only that but she's consistently passionate about what she teaches and explains concepts very clearly, helping you feel prepared through an abundance of practice material. 100 percent recommend.

Dr. Zehnder clearly cares about students' learning. She includes many types of iClicker questions which actually really helped for exam preparation, eliminate points of confusion, and clarified content of importance. Her effort to provide a variety of types learning opportunities allows for better retention. She is the best professor I've ever had.

She is genuinely a very good professor. She genuinely cares about her students and gives many opportunities to get easy points. The exams are very lecture heavy and are a little difficult, but she gives weekly homeworks that make it so that you get lots of points to boost your grade. If you could take a class with her I would highly recommend.
A sweet and easy gen-ed teacher. Homework is sooo easy and try to talk to someone in your class for tests. Really accessible and would recommend overall.

Dr. Zehnder is a great professor! She has office hours every week and TAs are also very helpful outside of class. Classes are somewhat lecture heavy but are very helpful, especially the clicker questions she goes through which are similar to exam questions. There are 2 exams and a final which are fairly easy if you spend time studying.

Dr. Zehnder is by far one of the best biology professors at UMass. Can skip up to 8 classes without losing points. Exams were easy, just pay attention in lecture. HIGHLY recommend taking 151 with her. If you took AP Bio this is LIGHT work

I was pretty nervous for BIO 151 as I am a Freshman, but Dr. Zehnder made my experience in this class amazing. She is a very caring person and wants you to do well. The lectures can be heavy, but she uses iClicker to check our understanding. The exams are similar to iClicker questions and discussion work. All assignments are beneficial.

Best prof. I've had so far. Lots of grades and opportunities to get points. Tests are cumulative but similar to practice tests. Questions are reused from in class and practice. You can tell she loves teaching and wants us to get good grades. I would 100% recommend Dr. Z

I do not recommend this professor, lectures were extremely boring and were of no help,she does not give enough information at all,an obnoxious amount of work with some not even relating to the course material.very picky grader.practice exams are not similar to actual exams.Unless you enjoy this part of bio or can handle teaching yourself good luck.

Hands down the best professor I have had at UMass thus far. She is extremely caring and teaches the material very well. The homework and quizzes are extremely helpful and the practice exams she gives are very similar to the actual exams. She is so funny and genuinely cares about her students! Wish I could take every class with her!!

Dr.Zehnder is one of the best professors that I have had during my time at the university. Her lectures are very informative and she truly cares about her students doing well in the course. She prepares you very well for the exams and makes sure that you understand the material. I would definitely take her courses again.

Dr. Zehnder really cares about the student success. There are a ton of grades throughout the semester which will totally supplement a bad exam grade. Her exams are also very similar to what you go over in class or on the practice exam. I definitely recommend taking good notes, because if you just rely on her powerpoints you'll be missing some info.

This class requires an iclicker. She has very helpful lectures, but can sometimes not spend enough time going over the basics and expects you  to come prepared to class with a general understanding. There are weekly quizzes and a quick little assignment with various other assignments due Sunday night. All HWs due at end of semester.

Ridiculous amount of useless reflection assignments and stupid busy work (ex. making an artistic representation of something you learned). Half the lectures are 30+ iClicker questions with no new info. Horribly worded questions, sometimes having more knowledge around a subject is a disadvantage. Kind professor but didn't enjoy the teaching style.

great woman who is very knowledgable and cares about her students. She genuinely wants people to pass this class and does her best to cover the lecture content to the best of her ability. Make sure you study for this class. You definitely need to put time outside of class to get a good grade.
super easy and super informative teacher

I love Dr. Zehnder and her teaching style. She really emphasizes the important topics that show up on the exams, and she also made it easy to make friends in class. 
I was lucky that my enrollment appointment was really early, and I was able to also take bio152 with her. People were fighting for the spots in the class!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: The class does require a significant amount of work-HW, quiz, etc. each week. But her teaching style is awesome and she wants everyone to succeed. During exam week (in class) its entirely review. I didn't find the material very difficult and I know other professors required their 151 classes to go way more in-depth. Would definitely recommend

Dr. Zehnder actually studies the science of teaching/ learning, and it translates to her classes. She also helps her students (who in this class are mostly freshmen/ underclassmen) learn about ways to study and learn/ retain information. Strongly recommend doing all of the reading, there isn't a ton of it and it is a great supplement to lectures.
Very nice and personable. if you do the work and try to learn you will succeed in this class.
Dr. Zehnder is a great teacher, and I enjoyed her lectures a lot. She made course material interesting and was always happy to answer questions.

reviews.comment: I took Bio 151 and 312 with Dr. Z. She is an awesome professor- both incredibly knowledgable and invested in her students' success. You will definitely learn a lot from her, and I would recommend her for either class.

Definitely don't skip class as the lectures have lots of clicker questions and you will easily get lost. As long as you show up to class and do the homework (don't procrastinate), you might enjoy the class.

Amazing professor. Cares about her students and learning. Explains concepts well, answers questions in class. Assigns weekly homework and quizzes. Two exams + final that are fair and based off of lecture notes and iClicker questions. Pay attention in class, attend discussion, and do the work and you'll succeed.

Really does care about her students, offering countless resources for help. Offers breaks during lectures dedicated to answering any questions. Doesn't use a textbook, she specifically tells you what you have to and don't have to know for exams, so don't skip. Requires iClicker use, but you can miss up to 10 classes and still get full points.

Professor Zenhder is a great professor. She explains well and always answer questions. The workload might be challenging at times but if you are engaged and attend the lectures and discussions, you'll be fine. Definitely try to have her for BIO151.
Such a sweet professor. You can tell she genuinely cares about her students. Material is not too hard to get as long as you put in the effort. 10/10 recommend.
She makes the material easy to understand, really good lectures, weekly quizzes and homework
Favorite Professor by FAR
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Although the material is very limited to a point you can snore, she makes it all enjoyable and easy to digest. What is on the exam is extremely fair given you were paying attention to class. Do your iClicker questions and understand the processes being taught. Do that and a A+ is more than manageable with little to no studying.
Such a sweet professor!

Would give a 6/5 if I could. Zehnder is talented at teaching, and she's a really nice woman: super personable and someone you get to know. Unlike Jeff Laney, Caralyn Zehnder was not condescending or rude, but rather she was very considerate and respectful, and she clearly wanted her students to succeed.
Always take Bio 151 with her whenever you get a golden opportunity to avoid Jeff.

Get this professor if you want a decent grade while still picking up useful biology concepts. She is way better than Jeff Laney, whose exam averages are always in the D-/F range. There's no way out of the work no matter who you take Bio151 with, but Caralyn Zehnder cares about her students and always listens to them when they're feeling burnt out.

The amount of work that Dr. Zehnder gives is a lot, but it's really helpful and she provides it for a reason. It's possible to do well in the class if you just put in the good amount of effort and go to offfice hours and the SI sessions. She does put in a lot of iclicker questions in her lectures and they're mostly application based.

Great professor, the lectures were less content and facts and info and more of the application of concepts to the topics (eco, plants, climate/carbon, neurons, etc) and how to answer application based-reasoning questions. Go to the SI Sessions!! Lots of hw the ended up being helpful, feedback on problem sets, etc. Good prep for 200+ classes.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Z was a great professor. She really dedicated time to making sure her students understood the material and were prepared for exam questions. My only complaint was the amount of outside work for the class, but honestly it better prepared me and it was worth it. Great teacher! Very helpful and straightforward notes.

She wants you to succeed as her student, and she is very understanding and forgiving with her policies. Lots of clicker questions but they are very similar or the same as the exam questions. I took bio152 with her after having her for 151.
Very caring professor and iClickers are very useful.
Some questions are difficult, but she provides plenty of guided and practice problems that get you very familiar with the answers she wants.
Amazing professor. She really cares about everyone and creates a great class atmosphere.

Was an amazing professor! Yes there are a lot of weekly assignments, but they take 2 hours a week TOTAL tops and if you get into a rhythm of getting them done before they are all due at the end of the week it will not feel like anything. Easily did the least work for this class.

Everything good said here is true! Q's on exams, quizzes and HW can be difficult, but they're supposed to be. The class is definitely easy enough and she really is a great teacher. It is a good idea to look through the PowerPoints before class and take detailed notes in order to do well, but there is no need to read the textbook or study too hard

Professor Zehnder's class has difficult exams (all cumulative) and lots of homework. However, her lectures and test prep material for exams are great and I learned the material very well. This class also changed my study habits for the better. My advice is to attend her lectures, and study the quiz and iclicker questions.

reviews.comment: Fantastic professor would love to have her again. She's so caring and knowledgeable. Make sure to pay attention to the iclicker questions though...

Dr. Z's lectures are pretty good and engaging although a lot of them are just clicker Qs. Attend the SI/ other review sessions and make a study guide before tests (this can defs help !)

reviews.comment: Professor Zehnder is one of the best professors I have ever had in my college experience. She understands that we are all online and struggling. She cares for her students and always checks in on us and also makes sure to address any current issues within the US. Zehnder makes sure that everyone understands the material and makes class fun
Test, homework, and quiz questions are never straightforward. Hardest class to get a good grade in that I have taken in college. Very frustrating.

Dr. Zehnder is an awesome professor. Although I did not receive the grade I was hoping for, it is entirely my fault. I found her class to be very interesting and she explained things very well, and was always glad to go over things that people found confusing/difficult. There are weekly quizzes, but that just helps to remember the content! :)

Professor Zehnder is wonderful. Throughout the pandemic she was so helpful and gave such good feedback on homework and tests. I would definitely recommend! The only thing I would warn you about is that she does a flipped classroom where you want to read about the material before lecture but if you do not mind that, she is fantastic!

reviews.comment: Dr. Zehnder is awesome. Exams are cumulative which may seem daunting at first, but when the final rolls around you realize you're very well prepared. Not an easy A class, but Dr. Zehnder is very good about communicating what will be on the exams. TA review sessions and SI sessions, as well as reading before class, are integral to doing well.

The exams and quizzes are very difficult and are not just open ended straight forward questions. Great in her lectures and describing things, but it feels like no matter how much you know youll never get a good enough grade on the exams and quizzes so its hard to get an A. Read the textbook before class is a must and go to her office hours.

I loved having Dr. Zehnder! I had her for both semesters of intro bio, and she was amazing! When we switched to online classes, she was my best prof at checking in and making sure we knew when everything was due and made it easy to stay on top of things.

reviews.comment: She is nice enough, but not the best teacher. reviews.comment: She's not the worst. However, I wish she explained that the classroom is a flipped learning style--meaning that you're expected to have read the material before coming to class. The material isn't challenging, but getting too deep into your thoughts won't help you on her exams. Also hard to pay attention if ecology and environment is not for you.

Zehnder is a fantastic professor, and although it's a difficult class, especially with her quizzes, you do learn the material. She was the best professor I had for online learning when we were sent home.

reviews.comment: Quizzes every Friday are a bit of a force but good to see the type of exam questions she will give. Must attend class to use iClicker but also to pass tests.

reviews.comment: She explained thing very clearly and made everything easy to understand. She used a lot analogy that can help some people understand thing better. She is the only professor that I can actually follow along during lecture. I am going to be her TA next year too.

I thought she was okay when I first had her. However, looking back and having dealt with other biology professors, she really was a gem. She tries to make the lectures personable and is really good at explaining concepts.

reviews.comment: She is very nice and interested in helping you learn the material. The Friday quizzes are hard if you don't study and class is based mostly off of your exams. reviews.comment: Very tough exams if you have never taken AP Bio

reviews.comment: Dr. Zehnder is incredibly knowledgable in her field, and I thought she was an excellent professor. Intro bio is difficult at first but once you get used to the teaching style it gets a lot better. The weekly quizzes help to keep you studying throughout the semester.

I think this prof is a good choice. The grading system is pretty good. if you aren't great at tests there are other ways to help your grade (discussions, mini quizzes, participation etc) and she cares about student success and is always willing to help you. This isn't a hard class, but if you don't put in any effort, it won't go well for you.

reviews.comment: I love her so much and highly recommend! Her tests can be tricky but it teaches you to be a more critical thinker.

She encourages you to find smart ways to study, and many of her assignments revolves around studying methods (thats cool!). However, I did not learn much (had to teach myself the material). Found it difficult to force myself to go to class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Zehnder was an amazing professor for both Bio 151 and Bio 152. Highly recommend going to her office hours. She is great at explaining any concepts you need clarification on. You will have to try for an A but you will learn so much.

reviews.comment: Great professor. Cons would be that you sometimes have to guess what she is looking for in exam questions. Many questions are easily interpreted by some but not by others. reviews.comment: Professor Zehnder is amazing! She is an interesting lecturer, and honestly improved the curriculum by tying it to climate change. I didn't have any difficulty with any part of this class, and enjoyed the lectures.

reviews.comment: I studied so much for this class. I reviewed all of the slides, iclicker questions, quizzes, homework, textbook, but I just can't do well on her exam. Doesn't cover new material very well, but she thinks she does. Also, she's a really tough grader..

reviews.comment: Zehnder is my favorite professor so far at Umass. I had her for 151 and took a 9am 152 to be in her class again. You can skip mon+wed lectures but there are quizzes every fri (10 Q, easy) but you'll miss clicker points (3% of grade), get ebook for HW but don't need to read

Dr. Zehnder is probably one of my favorite professors ever. Her teaching style is something that took me a little to get used to, but she really works to make you understand concepts rather than memorizing a ton of facts. I never really had an interest in ecology but she makes it super understandable. Wish I had her for 151!

reviews.comment: Zehnder was an awesome professor. Would highly recommend - she's worth having to get up for a 9:05 class. I have no bad thing to say about this professor!

Caralyn seems like a nice lady, but she is not very good at teaching. Her lectures consist of clickers and questions to discuss with the people next to you. reviews.comment: Caralyn is a great professor and is caring toward the students. Sometimes the topics can be hard but the lecture videos are posted online. The exams are super straight forward and if you study a little you will get an A. She is not trying to trick you at ALL. Highly recommend.
Her class is hard

reviews.comment: I got Cs on all the exams and still managed to pass the class with a representable grade. Do all your Homework and dont miss quizzes which are VERY helpful and boost your grade if you are getting Cs on exams. She also gives extra credit with clicker questions and some other things. Shes also really nice and explains material better if u ask.

Dr. Zehnder is an amazing professor who truly cares about her students and their success. She goes a bit fast in class but the lectures are all posted online. Quizzes are tough but prepare you for the tests. I recommend office hours and if you take notes you don't even need a textbook (I didn't have one!). She's truly awesome!
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Zehnder goes kind of fast in class, but will stop for questions to clear up confusion. She's clearly very knowledgeable and uses good examples to explain difficult concepts. Quizzes every Friday and 3 tests aside from the final. Having not taken AP bio, I felt kind of far behind, but the SI sessions were super helpful. Tests aren't too bad.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--Would take again

reviews.comment: This an intense course no matter the professor. If you're like me and had no prior college-level biology class before starting college, she's great! Although she's great I didn't do as well as I thought was going to do because i'm a freshman and it was all entirely new. Take advantage of the fact that she's a sweetheart, go to office hours!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Hilarious--Would take again

reviews.comment: Very good at teaching biology effectively.

Super difficult, goes way too fast in class. Cumulative exams instead of ALL of the other bio 151 teachers who only have the final exam being cumulative. Asks for feedback on class and the next class lists why she's not going to change anything. Needs to realize bio 151 is not only taken by bio majors.

Shes extremely knowledable about molecular biology however she talks to the class like they already know what shes talking about. Shes super sweet and personable and really funny in class. But the subject is already difficult to begin with and there doesnt seem to be enough time to adequately go through each topic.

reviews.comment: Best lecture ever had, explain things really clear. Quiz every friday graded tough but not worth whole a lot. Prepare you good for exams. GO TO REVIEW AND SI SESSIONS. No extra credit is kinda annoying, but definitely recommend.

This was an interesting professor. Little put in the grade book all semester. Barely any homework, but a lot of reading we were supposed to do, but most didn't. Tests were very different from in class and were tough to do well on, and if you didn't then that tanked your grade. However, prof was a nice guy, understanding, dropped 2/4 exam grades.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: One of the funnest and inspirational economics teachers I've ever had. Lots of reading that are pretty complex, but then the class discussions are really stimulating. Not too hard to squeeze out high grades compared to other classes so if you put in the effort, it'll go well. 10/10 would take again.
Prof Abdul was the best teacher. He clearly explained all the course material and made sure everyone understands before continuing the lectures. Would take again

Best professor I have ever had, and I have taken a lot of college courses. She provided a selection of readings and let the student pick which ones to read and discuss. It was a great transition back to school. Great feedback, great professor, wish I could have her every class!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Abby was awesome. Made the stress of writing a mandatory 30+ page portfolio effortless and guided us towards completing it in a logical and step by step way. Was extremely nervous going into the semester, and now that its done can say I was so pleasantly surprised.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: I guess every class is different but I would not say the UWW Writing About Experience was easy. Abby was very helpful and friendly though. Very fast to respond to questions. Good suggestions for writing. Thank you

so easy, lots of reading but ou dont even have to do it since you're never tested on it and the very few in class responses are easy to BS cause she always tells you what to write down.. no tests.... 3 papers and you can write on whatever you want very easy.. good class for 2 gen eds esp for the lit gen ed.. its prob the easiest one
Very helpful and interested in getting class involved.

Really good teacher, passionate about educating his students in sociology. You watch many videos and documentaries which is a plus. If you're not into that they're still really insightful and make the exams easier than they already are (there's only two).  Just don't be a cynical jerk about the class like some people are and you'll do very well.

Ryan was an awful teacher. His lectures are boring as ever. He basically just reads the textbook to you in class and uses the slides made by the textbook instead of putting things into his own words and actually explaining it. He is EXTREMELY painful to listen to, and plays way to many boring documentaries too.
Very easy class. If you're even a little interested in sociology, you'll find this to be an engaging class.
Pretty easy professor.  Lots of reading, but nothing too drastic.  Overall, a quality professor who is just starting out.  Really nice guy, loves and wants to spread the study of sociology.
Social Networks. Extremely fair. always available for extra help and responds super fast to emails and whatever questions you have!

took this class as a gen-ed thinking it was about gender, sexuality, and literature, but instead it is all about space. the readings are incredibly difficult to understand, no matter how much time you spend on them. she is a super harsh grader, with only two main grades in the gradebook, and will give you a bad grade with no explanation.

reviews.comment: Professor Ahmad was just awful. All she talked about was space and gender, nothing else. Half the time I didn't even understand the concepts she was trying to make. We had very few assignments, which she graded very harshly. I also didn't know my grade until the middle of November. It was not an easy GedEd, just a rough and annoying one. Avoid!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Just don't take this class. Every assignment and reading is vague and SUPER difficult to understand, every lecture is her talking foreverr. This is one of my least favorite classes I've ever taken, even as someone who actually likes English. She threw in "space" last second and it became the entire class. Genuinely do everything you can to avoid.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Prof Ahmad was nice, but if you aren't majoring in English, don't take this class. It was literally only about "space", which was confusing and not what I thought it would be. Never did the readings, but thankfully, she didn't cold call. I got sick and missed a bunch of class, and she barely got back to my emails. Def better classes to take.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I signed up for "Gender Sexuality Literature and Culture" and got that but with "space" added to it. I did not want the space element, and it became the entire class. She takes forever to grade anything, every reading is very conceptual, hard to understand (as an English major), and just so annoying to read. DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I only got a real grade back on one assignment, and she didn't show grades on Canvas at all. Some of the readings were interesting, many of them were nonsensical. The class was marketed as a gender and sexuality literature class, but she changed it to be about gender and "space". There are definitely easier gen eds.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Sarah is awful with grading, as we didn't have grades in until two weeks before the semester ended. The grades that are given are solely based off of the mid-term and final essay, with only one or two extra credit assignments. The content and books that we read were all extremely out-there concepts, including suicide, murder, and graphic sex.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: prof ahmad is very intelligent but not in a way that makes her inaccessible to students. there is a fair bit of reading but it is worth it and you could probably get away with not doing all of it. she fosters a classroom environment where everyone is engaged (which is impressive for a gen ed class). do yourself a favor and take a class with her!

Has weird readings, is not very lenient about extensions and office hours, and a very harsh grader. She also did not release our grades until the day of final grades are out, so had no idea of my grade until the transcript came out. She's also weird about using devices in class. Maybe avoid her if you're looking for a easy workload for a gen ed.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Prof Ahmad was amazing. I was having an incredibly difficult semester and her class was so helpful towards my other papers as well. The reading list is amazing (included a Parasite viewing) and her lectures and discussions felt honest, challenging, and encouraging. Def recommend this class!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Caring

reviews.comment: Get ready to read the weirdest stories (this includes suicidal and shady plots and you won't even get a heads up for the plot either. Last task was to watch the movie parasite - figure out a way around it if you can't bear dark psychological movies like me. No matter how hard you try, she will cut off your points somewhere.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Professor Jensen is very sweet, but she is an extremely hard grader. Before each exam she has everyone do a group assignment that she grades tough and it feels like even if you get one question wrong it costs you an unfair amount of points. These assignments are also very much busy work and do not prepare you for the exam.

Jensen is a very smart person. She is very knowledgeable about the content but she expects everyone to know as much as she does even though its an intro class. She doesn't explain topics thoroughly and she expects you to know every little detail on exams. Exams are worth like 60% of the grade so beware. Don't take this class if u dont have to.

This is actually for BIO 572. She just read off a slide the entire time that was basically a textbook. Her midterm was the most unfair exam I have ever taken in my life. She was a tough grader and blamed us for not understanding or participating. Just liked to hear herself talk. Did not answer questions well.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

There are no words to describe how awful, miserable, dreadful the instructor made this class. No regard for students. Reads off slides for 75 minutes straight & makes no sense. totally disorganized

Oh I wasnt finished ranting in my first review so heres a second one. Only extra credit opportunity is worth one grade point divided into four portions over the entire semester so if you want the *whole* singular point you need to know within the first two weeks or so.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: The exams for this course were weighed way too heavy in comparison to the other aspects of this class. Had 2 attempts on the weekly quizzes yet received no feedback after taking our first attempt making the 2nd essentially useless
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Jensen is a great professor. She is so passionate about what she teachers which makes the class 10x better. Her exams are super hard but it is completely a reflection on how hard you study. You will not pass if you don't read the textbook and review your lecture notes. Lectures can be really boring but the content overall is very interesting

Shames students for using a zoom-in option she provided because they have covid or covid symptoms. Takes attendance but it does not count for a grade. Talks to you light you're stupid. Sends rude emails and is just rude in general. Changes the format of the exams without notifying students. Heavily specific open response questions on the exams.

Do not take advanced genetics with this teacher. She does not organize the outlines well. You dont learn any advanced genetics. You just read papers and write paper and outlines of outlines. Very redundant work.

Prof Jensen was a terrible professor. She just read off the slides and never went in depth, but he exams were always about the smallest details so you need to read form the book if you want to do good. She is not understanding at all. I went to one of her office hours and while I was asking questions she rolled her eyes at me.

I have been in school for 7 years and she is the worst teacher Ive experienced. Lecture slides are just pictures and a sentence taken from the book which she reads directly from. Good luck asking her questions in class. With each lecture I was more confused and lost than before. Tests are ridiculously hard but read the book and do the practice Qs.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Dr. Jensen was, unfortunately, horrible. Gerald Downes taught for half of the semester and did a solid job, but the other half with Jensen was terrible. She shows zero zeal for both the material and for inspiring students to learn. I did fine bc I studied hard and like the material. She was the worst and least approachable prof I had in college.

I generally like this professor. The actual lecture is boring and makes me want to fall asleep because material is so bland. But the professor is a nice person with pleasant personality. Gives you lollipops during exams too- which are worth 90% of your grade. Reading the text book and following her study guide helps you do well on exams.
Worst proffesor I have ever had.

AVOID. Literally reads directly from slides (from the books software). The study guides(from end of chapter summaries) she provides would be helpful, but aren't bc her tests are random and irrelevant. Honestly she she not be teaching, obviously only here for the grants she receives for research... which she only oversees and doesn't contribute too.
She is literally the worst professor I have ever had at UMass. Avoid taking this class with her at all costs!

She's really not so bad. Go to class because she covers everything that shows up on exams. I recommend skimming the book to review and to go over hard topics. The Questions of the Day show up word for word on the exams. It's easy to get distracted so maybe sit in the front. It's a hard subject so good luck!

Jensen was boring.  If you can read and follow along with the book, you'll be fine.  Your grade is based on four exams and  eight quizzes.  The final is optional and can replace your lowest scoring midterm grade.  You need to go to class to get the "questions of the day" which are word for word on the exams.  Easy class, but you need to do the work

Exams are pretty straight forward and follow the book's material exactly. Lectures are pointless. Copy and pastes from the book to make her lecture slides, then just reads her slides in class. No curve in the class so what you get on exams is what you get. READ THE BOOK and know ever little detail. That's how I pulled a A w/out taking the final.

Goes over class time, cannot fully answer questions about material, reads directly off of slides. MUST read textbook to get decent exam grades. Quizzes are online/homework and straight out of book. Go to class, she gives out "free" test questions ONLY in class. Rather rude to students, seems clueless, admitted that molecular bio "isn't her thing."

If she didn't have a textbook she wouldn't know what class she was teaching. All she does is read the figures and diagrams from the book. If you want a good grade read every word of the chapters she "teaches". I didn't go to class because she confused me. Her exams are straight from the book and the questions at the end of the chapters. Avoid Her!

I took this class when it was split between Abbie and Jerry. If you have to take it the semester Abbie teaches it, make sure someone else will teach the second half.  She can't answer questions, she just reads her powerpoints and her reviews are COMPLETELY useless. She has an annoying voice and she is a terrible professor.

Awful. Literally misreads the textbook in front of class. Writes awful, ambiguous test questions. Just straight terrible experience in this course. If you can avoid her, seriously do. Even if you study the book and do all the readings, you probably still won't perform well on exams. This class can be enjoyable, just not with her.

By all accounts, a terrible professor. Her lectures consist of her photocopying the figures from the textbook and essentially reading the captions. Ask her a question about something that isn't on the slide she's currently on and she freezes up and typically has no answer. Avoid this class if you can, and good luck if it's a requirement.
I'm not sure how she was able to become a professor.  She does not care about students and has zero Cell Biology knowledge.  Avoid her class if you can!

I found that the biggest problem in dealing with this professor was figuring out how to study for her exam.  Basically, you need to read and outline all of the chapters and study them furiously if you want an A.  She knows next to nothing about the content of the class and just reads off the textbook slides.  Extremely grumpy and unapproachable.

She was SO mean! Her lectures come straight from the book. The only reason why people even went to class was her questions of the day which would be on quizzes and exams. She's not helpful at all. In fact, she yells at you if you ask her to go back a slide so you can copy a question down or if you're leaving for another class when she went overtime

Abigail knows just as much as you do when it comes to cell biology. Lectures are copied from the textbook with little or no insight and background. It's also questionable whether she plagarizes all of her exam questions from other biology departments (quizzes and exam questions have been found on multiple departments). Exams arent that bad. Avoid.

She is a good, clear lecturer but is completely mean. She once continued lecturing after class was over and said "well if you don't want the lecture..." as if it was our fault we had other classes. She is rude to students and is not understanding at all.

Copy pastes pictures from the book then reads you the captions on them.  Horrible teacher in general.  Blames low grades on poor office hour and class attendance and not on her lack of teaching.  Impossible to take notes in class.  Avoid this teacher if possible.

She was not very helpful. Her material came straight from the book. If you got the extra credit wrong she counted it against you grade which would make your test score lower. I tried to argue this but she said extra credit would "raise the grades too much" (which is supposed to be the point of extra credit. Avoid her.

I have never had a professor that puts as little effort into a class as her.  She recites the textbook to students, WORD FOR WORD.  She can't teach her own material.  Not only that, the exams are nothing like anything we go over - and they're REALLY hard.  I seriously think this is the worst class I've ever taken at Umass - and I'm a bio major...

Jensen is terrible.  She flies through the material which is actually just pictures from the book.  Barely any words on her slides. She invests little time in preparing for class and holds office hours only by appointment.  Her accomplice searcy is not much better.

I really wouldn't recommend Dr. Jensen. She does not hold herself to the standards she expects of others.  For example she clearly expects her students to teach themselves and does not feel the need to do any pre-lecture preparation herself.  I'm a straight-A student and she is probably one of the worst teachers I'd had the unfortune of bearing.

Slides come straight from the textbook.  Her goal for this semester was to write more thought-provoking exams.  However, lectures consist of reading slides to students word for word.  Concepts aren't taught on a high enough level to allow for this sort of understanding.  Oh, and the book isn't so good.

Fair exams, but very boring lectures. All she did was make slides from the book, exactly as the book had them, and used the books words to explain them.   OWL's and practice exam questions were often the same as questions from the book.  In the end, studying the book was the same as going to lecture

She teaches exactly what is in the book, in the order it appears in the book. The owls are annoying but they are easy so it doesn't really make much of a difference.  Her tests are fair as long as you do the reading.  All around a nice lady except if you need to make up a test.

She tends to go through lecture material quickly. Unfortunately, she can sometimes leave out details that are important, so be sure to read the book! Her exams are very fair, however, as long as you study. Her OWL's are a bit annoying, though, since you only get two attempts per question for credit.

One of the best professors I've had. Really cares about student success rather than grades. He was extremely lenient on extensions for homework. Overall a great professor and very useful class for OIM majors.

Great professor who sets clear guidelines for the course, is very helpful and cares about students success. Attendance is not mandatory but I recommend going because it makes it much easier to get a good grade in the class.
Great guy. Very knowledgeable and really wants his students to get a good grade. Class can be very difficult at times, but luckily I was in a good group.
Hes a really nice guy who is very knowledgeable about the field. Make sure you get a good group because the class is heavily graded on the group projects and require a bit of work.
Great teacher, he is always trying to help everyone in the class succeed and he teaches relevant information. If you pay attention, go to class, and take notes you can easily get an A.
Not a bad class, but have to teach yourself the main material on exams.

Class isnt too difficult. There are some team challenges that are important to do and does not give too much direction on them (open ended assignments) which makes them difficult and very time-consuming. Nice professor but is impossible to reach outside of class. Does not respond to emails.

(aka OIM411) Ahmed is an awesome professor. reviews.comment: OIM 412 is a class that is more work than most OIM courses, but Ahmed goes out of his way to help you learn. He was the most helpful and nicest professor I've had in UMass. The course is also very useful, I strongly recommend, both taking the class, and taking it with Ahmed.

He is not awesome or great, he is nice. will not take a class with him anymore, he did not have a clear vision for the class. Team challenge take all my time.  last minute notice he announce there is a final exam. too much homework. no review for   final.  two students told me not to take his class.  he gave a outstanding  student  B- I  am scared

So intellegent, so great at lectures, genuinely cares each of us excels and understands. Also hilarious, and kind! Puts in way more hours and thought into the course than he is required to for the benefit of students- UMass did good in hiring this man. One of the best professors and advisors to Isenberg OIM I will ever encounter! Thank you !!!

I took Deterministic and Integer programming, but the professors never has time to meet up with me to answer my questions. my friends said the same thing. the professor never does a review so we can know what to study for the final. I got a B+ in both class because of him as he never had the time to meet to answer my questions. He is not that good!
Really fun class, a lot of math and problem solving.  Need to have good friends in the class to work through it.
The class itself is hard but your grade is largely based on the homeworks so its not hard to get a good grade.

Ahmed is extremely intelligent and is an incredible lecturer.  Really wants his students to understand the material and does a great job of breaking it up over the semester.  Such a nice guy, favorite teacher at UMass hands down

Material can be tough and case study's can be long, but extremely interesting all around. Great lectures, immediately clarifies (on rare occasion) any confusion.  Inspires interest in the subject and is truly an amazing research outside of being a superb Professor. Isenberg's lucky to have people like Ahmed.
First, hot and charming, especially his jacket with his height. Second, very prepared for class and clear in teaching. Third, very friendly and caring.

Great professor, great class. Material could be tricky but if you go and pay attention, it's very easy to grasp. Ahmed gives three exams, 20% each and then 40% HW. Is very good at working with you to make sure you do well through office hours, extra credit, homeworks and take-home exams. Probably my favorite class this semester
I loved Ahmed's supply chain class. The material is challenging, but he really wants to help you do well. Go to office hours!
Ahmed is nice and helpful. If you visit him during office hours, he helps u with homework and may give you extensions.

Max makes the material so much more understandable, we covered a chapter every lesson and he makes sure to show lots of examples and answer questions. Go to every lecture and take notes and you should do pretty well on exams, they get curved sometimes too.

reviews.comment: Exams were on the easy side, not sure if it's because the course was easy or it was Max's teaching. If you like math you will really enjoy his lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Mahmud is a very good professor who goes at a reasonable pace for a tough course. In his 50 minute classes, he does one chapter per day and explains examples very well. He is very caring of his students and puts in the effort to make sure his students learn the material. Difficult exams (by the math department) but Mahmud prepared us for them.

Amazing professor! His lectures go pretty fast, so I ended up just skipping to read his notes and watch the video after, because his notes are extremely detailed. He is accessible for questions and he really really cares about the students. I'm pretty bad at calculus and he was super accommodating when I needed more time to finish a homework.

Before the switch to online classes, I really liked him and he explained things really well. However, once we switched to online, he added 15-25 minutes to every lecture, and this extra time was used badly as he over-explained to the point of confusion. If you're on campus, I'd recommend him, if you're taking classes online, do not take his class.

Jack Ahern is a great professor and made my Landscape Architecture class very interesting. He is very knowledgeable and has a long history of research in the field. He also engages everyone in class well.

Prof. Ahlfeld is one of the best professors I've had at UMass.  He is extremely excited about the class he teaches, and made a class that I expected to be boring into something exciting and do-able.  His lectures are great, and he really gets down to the basics to make sure you fully understand the concepts.  Also has a great sense of humor.

This guy is the best teacher I've ever had. He's clear and concise, his lectures are interesting and he doesn't just assume you knows things- he goes very into detail with his solutions. He made what could've been a brutal course somewhat easy in my opinion. Great sense of humor. Professors should take a page out of this guy's book.

Great man. Lectures were perfectly clear; assignments were clear cut. For a grad class, not a lot of work. A lot of material is covered briefly; nothing is in depth. Super approachable, great sense of humor. 1010 Would take all the classes with him.
This Professor is awesome, he is extremely helpful and will spend excessive amounts of time outside of class helping you.
Great professor whos shows a lot of interest in his field. Always keeps the lectures intersting and cares about the success of his students

Judging from what I've heard from other people, take this with her.

Yoojung is a great professor. You are split up into groups early on and do a business simulation competition with your group competing against other groups. Not much homework. One group presentation and one exam in the middle of the semester.

POLISCI190A

Readings in course were insane, weekly quizzes on authors that were sometimes not even reviewed in class (she ran out of time or cancelled), quizzes were some of the only assignments given other than 3 tests, I think part of the problem is that these subjects are so simple for her that she considers them intro level, but they are not
