That being said, unless you're very talented at math, I wouldn't recommend skipping class. The second test is very hard, and as there are only three tests it carries weight.
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Her exams are way too hard. She gives you practice exams and then makes the exam totally different. Told my class that her exam average was a 60.
Adena was great! She's has clear and concise notes and gives a lot of examples of the different problems you can encounter. She makes learning math really fun and really understandable.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor Calden is an extremely caring professor who seems like she cares about her many students. She has very helpful lectures and seems intelligent in her subject matter. Calculus is not a very fun class but she has made it bearable. Watch out for the second exam, the class average was a 64.

Adena was very open to questions during lecture, and made it a point to have time during class dedicated to walking around with the TAs answering questions about practice problems she assigned. So long as you go to lecture and do the homework, an A is more than reasonable.

Adena is one of the nicest people ever! She's really sweet and honestly the best 127 professor by far. She has note packets that you can print out and fill in to make your life easier and is better explaining concepts than other profs. If you got As in math throughout HS like me, this class will be easy for you.

Adena is hilarious and the mood of the class was great. She realizes that math isn't for everyone and tries to make it as clear as possible. The homework isn't awful if you've been going to class because she really does cover and explain everything you'll see on the homework and tests.

Adena is an amazing teacher, definitely try to get her as a professor for Math 127. It is a hard class in general, but the way she teaches makes it much more understandable. She puts guided notes on moodle to use for each class.

Adena is the best Math 127 teacher you get at the school. The first test was very easy, but the second one and the final were very hard. Attendance is not mandatory but her lectures explain the material extremely well so it is a good idea to go.
She is not a bad professor, however the final exam was extremely difficult. I went to three review sessions and did multiple review packets and still had trouble with the final. Good luck

If you have to take this class, make sure you get Adena. It's a tough subject, but Adena is truly gifted as a teacher. She is clear, moves along at a slow pace and is a really nice person overall. Make sure you touch-up on algebra before taking this class... the first exam can trip you up if you're not careful, and it's hard to recover.

Adena is an outstanding professor who is truly engaging and makes the math easy to understand. She explains things slowly and offers multiple examples of what you might see on the homework or tests. Tests are hard, but if you study hard enough, you can get a good grade. She is helpful during office hours and she is an overall amazing person.
She is honestly one of the best teachers I have gotten.
I wish there was more problems on your test to even out the chance and risk of mistakes.

Professor Calden always did everything she could to be clear in her lectures and make sure the students understood what she was teaching. Her guided notes really help & she even responds quickly to emails asking for her help. Definitely choose Calden if you need Math 127!

Adena goes slow enough to make sure that everyone is following. Although it is a large lecture, she alway makes it a point to make it clear to her students that there is help there if you need it. Also, the review sessions before every exam guarantee a way to study. If you do your homework and do the test reviews, you should get an A.

Adena is an amazing professor. She is very clear and it is obvious that she really cares about her students - she teaches as though you have no background to math to ensure that everyone understands the material. I would absolutely take one of her math classes again.

Professor Calden was my best professor this semester. She is extremely clear with explaining the material. Especially after hearing about how hard this course was from my roommate last year I can't say enough about how easy professor Calden makes it to do well in this class.

I just didn't understand this class. Certainly came out of it knowing no more math than when I went in. Seriously, I did not learn anything. Class is entirely group projects, no tests. She gives you videos to watch but does not teach a single thing in class--- class time is devoted 100% to group project work and quizzes. She is a nice person though

Adena is the reason why I have not failed Calc I! Extremely clear lectures (and she is funny and has a great personality!). Online homework assignments can really boost your grade and give you ways to practice for the tough exams made by the math department. Many opportunities to get extra help (TAs, SI sessions, practice problems) and office hours

Adena was by far my favorite professor this semester. I have never been a big math person, but with her as a teacher i ended up getting an A on every single test, and there's no reason not to get an A for homework, since you pretty much have unlimited tries. I recommend lectures but they're not mandatory which is nice.

Adena is still my favorite teaching after having her for Calc 131. The Math Writing course is pretty standard: you have some sort of assignment due for each class. It seems like a lot of work, but it's super easy. And if you do it, and it looks decent, you will get full credit. I was scared of Junior Year Writing, but this class is awesome!

I had Adena for Calc 127 last semester. I am not really a math person at all but Adena made the material so clear and easy to understand. I would definitely take another class with Adena. As long as you put in the effort, you should do well in this class.

Was a really nice and helpful professor. I took honors, so the tests were take-home but almost impossible and so challenging. Otherwise, there was easy homework every week and she gave a lot of students opportunities for extra credit. 3 major group projects, which she can be tough on grading, but very easy. Definitely recommend this course.

Calden is very helpful in lecture and out of lecture. She explains things very clearly and is always willing to help whenever possible. She also practically gives you the exams through very similar practice problems. Do the homework, show up to lecture, and you should be good to go. Pretty easy A.

I took this class online and Prof. Calden definitely was great. She posted her own lecture videos for each section, created a discussion board so students could interact with one another, and even gave some extra credit. An online class is alot of work but Calden is fair and gives good feedback. The pace is fast, but manageable.

Nicest lady ever. Her teaching style is great and she offers so many resources for students to excel. That being said, it is not a guaranteed A; there is a lot of homework for practice, the second exam and final are challenging, and the later material is complicated if you have never taken calculus. If you need this class, take it with her!

Everyone suggested that I take Math 127 with her but this semester (fall 2014) she had a hybrid class (half online, half in person) and instead of a second lecture we had group work (which didn't count towards our final grade at all). She's a good professor but if you struggle with math like I do, do NOT take the hybrid course. Help Cntr  your BFF

I took calc my high school senior year so I had a good background, but Calden is an amazing teacher. She teaches different ways to solve a problem and she's always there to answer questions. The homework was very easy, and in the off chance you need help, go to the TA hours and you'll get the answers. I never liked math, but this class was great!
Adena posts guided notes for all the lectures which is helpful. She also offers videos if you miss class. She has extra office hours near exams and is nice.

Adena is a really nice teacher and explains a lot of things clearly. However, there are somethings that make no sense at all and you have to depend on Khan Academy and Wolfram Alpa to get you through the assignment. There are also so many things that she just skips over and assumes that we've learned.

This was a good class to takes as honors, even if you aren't as strong in math, because it is a smaller environment. Adena is really friendly and has realistic expectations of her students. The exams are take home, but can be long and difficult. Overall I would say she is very fair and available to help you in any way!
She is a great person and a great professor. I am just not a math person in the slightest sense, so that is why this class was so tough for me. Otherwise, I think she's great!

Adena is an excellent math teacher for calculus. I had her for calc 2 online and she is always there to help over email, online, anywhere. Great notes and lectures that are easy to understand and she is great at getting back to you quickly if you have a question about anything. Overall a great prof.

Adena is a great professor for someone who isn't a strong math student. She moves at a very managable pace and provides guided notes to print fromMoodle which are incredibly helpful to stay organized and keep up in class. The exams aren't easy, but they're do-able.

Calden puts in great effort making sure her students understand the material. She moves through the lessons at a manageable rate. I always felt prepared for exams. Three exams and weekly WileyPlus homework problems.

Adena is an awesome teacher!! She is so nice and is always willing to help. She provides a lot of chances for help and I wish I took her up on more because I would've gotten an A instead of a B. Overall if you listen to all her lectures you should do very well in her class.

I loved Adena! She is one of the nicest professors Ive ever had. Her 127H class requires a lot of work, and although tests are all take home, they are very hard and take a very long time. However, classes are fun, and she clearly cares for all her students and is very helpful in office hours. If you have to take math, take Adena!!

Adena is an incredibly nice and open-minded woman; she is always willing to help you out. Unfortunately, unless you're ridiculously awesome at calc, this class is extremely difficult (the take home exams are killer). You really need to try in this class to pass.

She is very good about moving through the material at a pace that you can understand. She offers many out of class opportunity for help and will always answer questions in class. Two tests and one final is consistent with the course. No extra credit and online homework problems.

Adena is a great professor! She explains material clearly and her tests are straightforward. Easy A if you put in the effort to practice the math problems/attend class. I highly recommend taking Calc with her!
Math is not the best subject for me but Adena made it interesting and clear. She is really good at teaching and I am taking Math 128 with her next semester.

Don't get me wrong Adena is a great lady and everything but she is not even the slightest bit clear. I learned from SI sessions (so be sure to take advantage of those), and also her handouts. Her posts and handouts are great and useful but her teaching is horrible. Had plenty of Ta's better at teaching than her. But again, great lady.
CANNOT TEACH. Nicest lady ever, but she is just not clear at all when she is teaching the material in class.  The TA's know what they're doing

Well, she is one of the nicest professors on campus…so there's that. She gives easy examples of problems in class and on homework then BAM! Good luck on the tests guys, cause they'll kill you. Test questions are all really theoretical and nothing like what you learn in class. She grades homework based on two questions chosen at random :P

Adena is awesome. I was dreading taking calculus but she's a very good teacher. I got an A but I also worked very hard. Go to every single class, take advantage of the SI sessions, and go to the math help center. You will do good if you want to do good. If you have take calculus take it with Adena!

She is an amazing person and a great teacher, but the tests (although they are take-home) are CRAZY difficult. You have to be really good at explaining things to get full credit on the test, but she does give a lot of partial credit which comes in handy. She's definitely the nicest person I've ever met and the class is super interesting.

Best math teacher ever. My class is a hybrid (half online and half in class...which I wouldn't recommend) but she is awesome. She explains ideas so clearly, so I really don't need to study all that much outside of class in addition to the assigned homework. She makes note sheets you can print out and bring to class. Absolutely recommend.

Adena is the best calc teacher I've ever had! She made the material very comprehendible and she prepares you directly for exams. She wants you to learn and understand the material and she does a really good job of explaining. The TAs are useless. Take Calc 127 with her. I heard the other teachers for this section are terrible.

Adena was awesome! I got a better grade in 128 than in 127 because she was the teacher. Super clear and nice. She gets students don't like math so she tries to make it as fun as possible. She always reviewed before tests and gave us what she thought the format would be. Def recommend.
Totally awesome! Best math professor for 127/128. Had her for the latter, a huge improvement over my last professor. Do everything you can to ensure you take her class and not Cook's!!

Adena was an excellent teacher! Went through material step by step and welcomed questions.  Lots of review packets. Cons: she doesn't make any of the exams and often doesn't know what will be on them, so expect some surprises! Much better than Prof. Cook though for sure!!

Adena is the best math teacher there is. She knows how to explain calc so it makes sense. the second exam is always harder than the first exam, but the final is very easy. homework is basically another exam grade so thats an easy A since you get unlimited tries until you get the problem right

Adena is by far the best prof I've had at UMass. She is not only and excellent teacher, but also a great resource. If you're confused at all, office hours with her will clear all confusion up. Her teaching makes exams seem so much easier than they would without here. Take 128 and 127 with her!!!
She explains very well and makes sure everyone understands before she moves on. Calculus is confusing but she makes it a lot less confusing. Take her !!
Adena is probably the best teacher I have ever had. She made calculus so enjoyable. DEFINITELY take math 127 with her.

Take writing in math with Calden if you can! The class will not stress you out, but at the same time isn't a total joke... You actually learn useful things (e.g. Latex). The more pedantic assignments are fun, and doing them in latex makes it educational.

GREAT TEACHER! If she wrote the exams, you would probably get an easy A because she teaches math so well, and her class is very fluid. The real problem is out of her control and that is the exam content since the math department makes the questions, and they ALWAYS turn out to be demented versions of class examples.
Great teacher always upbeat. Doesn't really show examples that will be on the exam. Exams were hard, but she doesn't write them herself, the whole dept. does. HW very doable

127 is a manageable class. Adena is a great professor and she really wants you to succeed. She's always in a great mood and she's very nice. She and the TAs are always available for help. Class goes a little slow if you've taken Calculus before. Exams are a little tough and they don't allow a cheat sheet any more, but they're still manageable.
Adena is a great professor. She is very clear and easy to understand. I'd definitely recommend taking 127 with her.
Adena is the best. She teaches some classes online so you don't need to go to class those days. Homework is through Wileyplus which is easy and helpful. She is a great professor and very funny.

Calden is the best for 127 and 128. She explains things really well and is actually interested in what you say and how well you do. Go to office hours! She is more than happy to have the company and explains things differently than she did in class to give you another perspective.
BEST CLASS EVER! adenas awesome. Highly recommended for Math127

Adena is the nicest lady and she couldn't be more clear during class.  Rolling homeworks that you have the option of completing months in advance.  Three exams, all of which you get to make a cheat for and all of which are multiple choice.  easiest class/professor.
Easiest professor for 127. The class is an absolute breeze if you have prior calculus experience. My high school calculus teacher was more difficult than Adena.

Great prof. Best for 127. She writes the exams, so you will get more from her than you will from other teachers. She is very fair and clear. Pay attention in class and she feeds you the questions on exams. You only need an 85 for an A. About as easy of an A as it gets.

Great teacher, understands that not everyone likes math and teaches you what you need to know and leaves anything useless out of lectures. Various examples of how to approach problems make it easier to learn rather than preaching about the history of the mathematical reasoning and abstract examples..take this class if it doesn't fill up right away!
Awesome Professor!!! Enough said! :)

Incredibly talented at taking dry, tedious math and making it easy to understand. Do not miss class once because the material covered in one day is astronomical. Very fair grader. Exams are 20 questions, so go through every practice exam to make sure you know each type of question. Exams are exactly what you learned in class.

Adena is the best. She scales your final grade by 10 points so thats awesome. Exams are all multiple choice, and homework is an automatic 100 because you get unlimited chances. She teaches really well, and gives clear examples. I learned way more in her class than I did in calc in high school. Great Professor!!

so nice. gives great examples. Easy class if you've ever taken calc before if not its still confusing. Do the review packets before tests. HW is an automatic 100 if you get it done which is 20 percent of the grade.  class is scaled so an 85 is an A. Cheat sheets for tests. OH and you only have to go to class once a week other day is online!!

Great professor!! I would highly recommend her. I somehow got placed in math127 when I had never even taken pre-cal, and I still managed to do well. She is a great teacher, the exams are fair, and you get unlimited chances on the homework. The only down side would be that she teaches at an extremely fast pace, but that might just be me.

Great professor tests are easy. Homework, thank god she gives unlimited tries because it is the most difficult hw and I even took calc in hs and got A's. I dont know why but the homework is just so difficult but you get unlimited tries so it doesnt really matter just takes a while
Awesome professor, so nice and understanging. Never uses the book so don't buy it

Adena is the best! I had Thurlow Cook originially but word got to me that Adena was a great teacher, and its true. Her class is fast paced but understandable, she lays out everything clearly and with usable examples, even if you cant get in her class make sure you have that spot open so you can ditch your other prof and go to hers!

She is an awesome teacher and makes things very clear. She covers material very thoroughly and knows what she is talking about. She is also very friendly and helpful. I would recommend taking her class.

Really nice lady. Teaches to easy however. Her questions on the tests are easy, but it is difficult to do the other professors questions since they teach more intensely then she does. Very helpful though, and really wants her students to succeed.
Very nice prof and easy class
Love this professor:)
Adena was a great teacher, explains things well and as long as you got to class and do the homework/online quizzes you will be fine. Tests aren't too bad

I never went/or even studied, but just doing the owls is pretty much good enough.  But when i did go a great teacher, very clear, good at explaining things. I wish she taught 128, I would have actually done very good in that if she was the teacher.
excellent teacher. speaks english. explains things thoroughly and wants to help kids out. grades easy, and if you need more time on homework just ask her, shell extend deadlines
She is a fabulous teacher, shes straight forward and to the point. As long as you go to class and do the homework you'll be fine.

Adena is the best math teacher I've ever had. I'm in the business school, never took calc in high school, and had to take math127 in order to be in isenberg. she's so clear, she knows the material, and she teaches it perfectly. i have an "A" in the course, and again had no prior experience. she's the best out of all the math professors.
Fantastic teacher. The material isn't really that difficult if you've taken calc in high school.She's very friendly, funny, and helpful. I suggest taking her hybrid calc class because she's great!

By far the best professor I have ever had. She's young, funny, really likes teaching. If you go to class you will do well. Going to class is worth it bc she explains things really well, and she let's you use cheat sheets on the exams.

Adena is a very good teacher. She explained all of the material very well. As for the class, the material isn't that difficult, a very watered down version of calculus. The first two exams however were pretty tough. The final was not too bad though. Just work hard on and finish all the hw and you should get a good grade.
She is amazing, if you have to take math 127 then it is essential that you take it with Adena, she IS the best professor/teacher you will ever get in a math course.
Very good class and quite easy.

She was very entertaining and the class wasn't too difficult. Lots of homework, but it counted for a good amount of your grade. No quizzes, only 3 tests including the final. She was really helpful and fun!

Easy class, good professor.  Homework is online and you have unlimited attempts at questions.  PRS in class.  2 midterms and a final.  Final was WAY harder than the midterms.  Not sure what happened there, but no one got their grades on it, just final grades.  If you have had Calculus before it's pretty much review and an easy A.

I hated math in high school, so much.  Adena made it easy to learn, follow in class, and earn points.  I got 95s on my first two exams.  Homework is easy to do, and gives easy points (with no deductions for wrong answers.)  PRS in class, but the material is very easy to grasp, lots of help available if needed.  Don't take Calc127 with anyone else.

The class is pretty straight forward, I am in a hybrid course so half is online, have to remember all the online homework and you need to be in class for PRS but aside from that the material is easy and she does a great job at explaining and offering examples. Hybrid class is nice because online helps with review (esp. for exams).
By far the absolute BEST calc professor.  Take this class with her. She does plenty of examples so you understand everything.  Tests are generally easy, just do the OWLS and the practice exams.

i hated this class but you really should go to do well.... its pretty confusing.... just a bunch of problems and i found it completely necessary to go to the SI sessions everyweek to find out what was actually happening in class.   i knew the info perfectly and could do all practice tests fine but the test were different and they sucked

If you're going to take calc you need to get Adena. I actually was in a different professor's class but I only went to her classes because she was such a good teacher. She's so down to earth and makes sure everyone understands everything. Let's you out of class really early too.

I have one word for Adena: Awesome! She was incredibly helpful and very clear. Calc was never my subject, and I got an A- in her class. She reviews for exams with exams from prior semesters. I highly recommend taking this course with Adena Calden. The best Calc professor at UMass by far. Do NOT take this course with ANY other professor!!
best math teacher I've ever had, I attenmded a couple different math 127 classes with different professors, Adena was by far the best!!!
Great teacher. I will take her for 131 as well

ADENA IS THE BEST TEACHER IN THE WORLD!! ive never liked a class so much. She makes everything so clear and easy. The tests are easy you are allowed to have a cheat sheet(formula). If your gonna take 127 take it with her. Shes the sweetest person ever.
The homework assignments are much harder than the exams.  Do NOT need the textbook.  Fun teacher and she usually ends class about 20 minutes early.  If you have to take calc, take it with her.

Great teacher and extremely easy math class if you have ever taken a precalc class. prob still easy even if you havent...owls are pretty easy...and DO NOT buy the book, you will never use it and itll be a waste of money. Solid class.
if you're going to take calc, you need to get Adena. She explains everything perfectly- tests are wicked easy, you get a cheat sheet and she has so much review for her students.

Shes amazing! makes math as easy as possible, dont buy the book i never opened it, i suggest going and writing down everything because then theres no way you can mess up, really cares about her students, lots of extra help offered and you get a cheat sheet for every test which is awesome
Adena is probably one of the BEST math teachers I have ever had. She is very clear, and prepares you well for the tests. If you need a math credit TAKE THIS CLASS!

adena is awesome. she is extremely helpful and teaches calc in the way that you do well on the test. she skips all the boring background before it. if you have a different teacher, come to her class, its WAAAAYYY better
Awesome
No Comments
Adena was great. She prepared us for the tests and taught ver well. Plus she let us out early every day. Take Adena for Math 127!

She makes this class so simple. I didn't use the book once because she is so clear about everything. Adena's test class average was always higher than the other prof. with the same test. She is amazing, take this class
If you ever want or need to take calculus, you want to take it with her. THE BEST, by far!

Adena is the best teacher I have EVER had! She makes everything so simple and shes funny too. Class is not required but i would highly recommend going because she makes everything so easy to understand. No one ever used the textbook. Just make sure you take good notes and go to class as much as possible. I would love to take another class with her!

Adena Calden is the BEST! Adena is very good at teaching and is extremely nice. She's very funny and likes to make jokes in class. I don't know of anyone that doesn't like her. If you goto class and pay attention then you'll understand the material. No need to buy the book. Also goto the SI sessions...they're a big help...goto KELLY's SI sessions!

YOU HAVE TO GO TO CLASS!The thing about Adena that is great is she teaches us exactly whats going to be on the exam. She never wastes our time with stuff that isnt.  Young & sometimes funny.Do not get Rudvalis and if you do, go to Adena's lectures.Go to class, go to S.I. if you need to. Do the owls.  Lets us out 15 min early every day.

Best way to describe it: I don't think I'd gotten an A in math since my sophomore year of high school. Come in second semester of my freshman year, and all of the sudden I had a 95 on a midterm I thought I was going to bomb. YOU WILL LEARN MATH IN THIS CLASS. Show up, pay attention, and she will show you everything you need to know to do well.
She is an awesome teacher.  The best math teacher at Umass.  Take her class if you need a math class. People would come sit in on our classes from other calc classes because she was so good.
Great teacher, you learn a lot and you get out early. If you go to class you will have no problems on the test. Worst part is OWLs, go to lab for help!
SHE IS THE BEST!!!!TEACHES YOU ALL U NEED FOR UR EXAM. DONT NEED TO BUY THE TEXT BOOK, BECAUSE SHE IS SO GOOD AT TEACHING!!!!
Adena is the best! You won't have another professor like her. TAKE HER CLASS! She's helpful and crystal clear on teaching. You can't go wrong with her!
She gives out really good practice exams.

i had rudvalis, and got a 25 on the first exam. then a friend that had him with me, told me she skips and goes to Calden's class. so i went to 4 of her classes before the next exam, and got an 85. Thanks Adena!
Adena was a great teacher. She knows her stuff and is always willing to help out or work something out if you've got a problem. She's very understanding.

Adena is AMAZING! She is very helpful. I didn't do as well as I wish in the class, but she was VERY clear with the material, and I was able to somewhat recover from the second exam's hole I found myself in.  She was definatly the best math prof I've had, TAKE HER CLASS!

GREAT CLASS, shes funny and teaches you exactly what you need to know for the exams, the exams are 20 multiple choice questions and scales it too, lectures are usually 30 minutes long(which is awesome) and theres reviews before each exam which help a ton
Great Teacher. Explaings everything and uses examples that are similar to the exam questions. Class is not mandatory but you should defintely go.

Deffinitely who you want for math 127! Explains things very well for people not-so-interested in math. I don't own the textbook for this class and I have never needed it. She is more than willing to stay late after class to help you with any confusion you may have, but her teaching style is so clear, there rarely is any confusion.

If you've had calculus before the material is absurdly easy, and even if you haven't, she teaches it well. Two exams and a final that aren't bad at all and you get out of class early basically every class.

Adena is by far the only teacher who can make a student understand math. She has a way of teaching that all other professors should learn! She understands the students, is so helpful, and bottom line amazing. I had her twice and if you go to class and take good notes you will be prepared for the tests.
She's great. I hated calc until I took this class.
She's really nice and helpful!
