Kat Benincasa meant well, but she was unorganized and often made mistakes in her own in class examples. The only way to get through this class is by getting all the extra credit points awarded for attendence and pop quizzes and by using outside resources to learn the material. She doesn't help!

Probably one of the worst teachers ive ever had.  her classes are lackluster and boring, and she has no priot knowlege to whats going to be on the test.  I survived with a C in the class whereas in Calc 127 I have a A.  Avoid this teacher, and if you do get her just get a tutor.
She barely teaches anything useful, on top of which the stuff she does teach isn't on the tests.  Half of class fails the first test every semester
great instructor....very helpful

Really sweet person, but really lacks in the teaching department. Basically, if you study by the practice tests that she hands out the class is a breeze. Cat didn't know how to solve many of the problems and would follow up by saying "well, it's not on the test, don't worry." Her explanations are  convoluted and can be solved in much easier ways.

Forgot calculator for first exam, got a 44. Only went to three classes (first two and last) and still managed a C. Looks like I put all the guesswork back into math (thank you multiple choice)! Not hard if you're not stupid and you know a little math (most people here don't know any so whatever)

The first exam was a nightmare. It was her first semster teaching and she had no idea how the tests would be & neither did we. I believe the class ave. was around 40 for the first exam. She then started helping by making review sessions which was great. Dont be afriad to ask questions. You cannot afford to fail an exam, its hard to raise ur grade
Her online notes were very useful and I found her to be most helpful and she really took the time to help me figure things out.

The class material is very simple and the the printed notes are helpful. The test on the other hand are hard and the multiple choice questions are not even written as questions...they are more like statments...not an effective way of testing math. Also the first test average was a 57% and she claims she can't scale it...lame.
She's very helpful.  I was struggling through this class but thanks to her, I got through it and feel good about it.  She's a great teacher.
I like the class becasue i know the stuff, if you want a class that get you an A, that is it, but if you want a class that taught you some math then dont get this one
frist test avg was 48 for the class, 2nd test she helped us out a bit more but. the only thing that helped was the review sheeet, notes dont help too much

horrible teacher. i really dont recommend her class! she makes mistakes constantly, and when asked a question she does not know how to answer she creates a web of disaster and confusion and ends with a "well....i wouldnt ask you this on the test anyways". such a bad teacher, the average score on her tests is 54% and she does nothing about it.

I think she's great. She's the only teacher that posts her notes online the day before class. I find it very helpful. I did some student teaching once and it was pretty scary teaching a class of 25 students. I can't imagine what it's like to teach about 200 !! She knows her stuff and I recommend taking her class.

says she has taught for a long time..not beleivable. not too organized, doesnt post notes til midnight before class. makes mistakes alot. takes too long on peoples silly questions. easy class if you took any math at all in high school.

Caring a great professor! If you went to class and paid attention, you would be fine. His email reply is like instant, so you don't need to wait a lot when you have questions. I think the course could improve by getting people to have more discussion on the definition part.

Overall he is great!

The last review that was written on this page is a ridiculous representation of Mantek. 

He was an awesome professor that was always very respectful and did a great job throughout the semester. The content is a little difficult but he makes himself very accessible for any questions at any point. One of my favorite classes ever.

Professor rushes through material and doesn't explain lessons well. Provides no office hours, always late to class, disrespectful to students, lies about course structure, unfair and harsh grader. By far one of the worst professors I've ever had, don't take his class.

Professor Mantek is truly one of my favorite professors I have ever had at UMass. He really cares about his students and is always willing to help you learn. The curriculum is challenging but he prepares you well and if you study and participate you will have no problem in this class.Could not recommend this professor more!!!

His material isn't hard because he is good at teaching the information as well as prepare his students for exams through homework help during class, reviews, and detailed study guides. I say as long as you attend class, it is an easy A. Especially because if you are ever confused about anything, he will help you. Responds to emails in minutes.

It's a shame the limit is 350 characters because it won't be enough to describe how awesome he is. My favorite professor of all time. He truly cares about his students, and he was super understanding about my disability accommodations. He WANTS his students to do good. Truly caring, he sets a high standard for other professors. He is the best!!

Material is on the hard side, but if you go to class, do the homework, and take advantage of office hours, you should have no reason to not do well. Cares about his students and keeps class interesting and fun. Would definitely take a class with him again!

Highly recommended! The course itself was a bit challenging since it is a pretty important concept if you are going deep into the business intelligence field. However, the Professor was very nice and well-prepared. You will learn a lot of useful things in this class.
GOAT

There are 4 exams and you can drop 1 lowest. The prof make sure to prep us well for the exam, but you still have to study quite a lot because they are quite challenging. He also gives out opportunity for students to improve their grade and office hour are always useful. Highly recommend this prof for OIM 350.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Homework and exams can be challenging but I learned a lot about business intelligence in the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He's a decent lecturer, and some classes were pretty interesting. The work was very easy (ESPECIALLY if you've taken CS250 since there's a lot of overlap in the intro to formal language theory) and it rarely took more than an hour per week. As a non linguistics major, I still enjoyed learning many of the topics, and I'd recommend it as a Gen ed.

A good teacher, clearly wants the students to learn. He was slightly hobbled by the course schedule and how quickly he had to teach something so complex (formal language theory) to an audience that had largely no starting knowledge. However, you could tell he knew what he was doing and would have been a very good lecturer under better circumstances

The lectures were very light and fun, He makes the material interesting and connects it to the world.Even though the class is pretty big he does an amazing job of making the class more personalized for us.For an introductory class,it teaches you a lot in a fun way and shifts your perspective on different topics.Highly recommended for your freshmen.

Around 300 kids, 4 TA's, and 1 professor that never responded to my emails. I got a 49 on my final and don't know why because of how long it's taking them to grade all of the papers from five units ago. I attended every class and did all the extra credit. Do the extra credit. It's a free 12% added to your grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He's insensible and mean. Never met a meaner teacher
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment:
Ling 101 is a very chilled class.
Recommended for an easy gen ed.
He gives 12% extra credit

pretty chill class, i did'nt find the lectures helpful so I stopped going and still did well. you need to go to discussion session but it's helpful and makes up for the lack of lecture content. there isn't a ton of work, midterm and final that need some studying but nothing crazy and one pretty simple paper. perfectly fine for a gen ed
You need to attend the lectures to do well in this course. Professor Bhatt may be a bit confusing at times, but his examples were helpful and his lectures were really interesting.
His lectures were very entertaining and I never found myself bored during them, he obviously cares a lot about the subject and teaching it. The strictness in grading was dependent on who your TA was.
reviews.rating_tags: Inspirational--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The class is pretty easy. It was tough at the beginning and then gets way easier. The homework is hard but lots of extra credit ad other stuff is offered so you can make up for it. Discussion is mandatory but the lecture is so big that it's not. I thought I would fail and I finished with an A.

Prof. Bhatt is such a funny professor who's makes others also passionate about linguistics. He explains the material clearly and thoroughly, and so does the TAs. It is not hard to get a good grade in this class, just show up to the discussions. There were only two exams (midterm and final) and they were both really easy.

Very easy gen ed class. Kaden Holladay is a great TA for this class, I stopped showing up to the lectures and just went to his discussions and I understood the material well. Most of your grade is quick weekly homeworks, with a final paper at the end making up 15% of the grade. There is 10% extra credit available which is very easy to get.

Take this class to fill the SB and DU geneds, 50% of the grade is weekly homework assignments which are quick and easy to complete, and there is only 1 paper which is worth 15% of the grade. There is also 2 easy extra credit assignments for an extra 5% each.

Bhatt does not explain anything ever. Even if you watch the lectures, the mandatory discussions will make no sense. He is unclear in every single homework assignment and RAs are ruthless with grading so good luck. If you miss a discussion you have to say you're sick because family emergencies don't count. I wish I never took this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: I love this professor. He gives great lectures and really knows his stuff

Linguistics 101 - Bhatt may be the best public speaker / lecturer I've ever taken a class with -- He can really deliver a lecture. Class wasn't all too hard, consisted of weekly homeworks, one study participation, and a paper towards the end. 

Highly recommend
good

I went to a total of seven lectures, and I gave up and looked at his slides on Moodle instead. This class was really easy, you just need to show up to the once a week discussions where attendance is mandatory.

Nothing special nothing terrible. I'd already taken intro to Linguistics before this and found a few things that were covered again in a different way to be a bit more confusing but you will survive. Grading is spread out across a few tests and several homeworks and discussion attendance so easy to pass.

He's a good guy but I think this class needs some reworking or a pre-req - it's very tough and especially time consuming if you have no previous programing experience. Wasn't the worst class, but be ready to invest effort into it, and he is very happy to answer questions and whatnot. Two projects, one had to be in a group, the other optionally.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Professor Bhatt is clear, engaging, and approachable. For someone new to computer science, he takes things slowly enough and wants you to really understand the material. Would really recommend for 409.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Professor Bhatt makes syntax come alive. I never thought I'd have so much fun in a class like this. Go to his office hours, he is very approachable and friendly to talk to.

Although he can seem intimidating in lecture, he's actually a very approachable and friendly professor. Go to office hours. The class was not easy and I was stressed out a lot, but that's the nature of the material.
Computational Linguistics - difficult class but Bhatt is very open to questions and help. The most difficult thing for me was understanding how to code programs. Recommend going to office hours.
Very knowledgeable and helpful, genuinely interested in student input. Has an adorable sense of humor!

While Rajesh obviously is an expert on syntax and knows his field very well, articulating in a way that is understandable for someone new to linguistics is definitely not his strong suit. If you do not have any background in syntax consider taking this with a different professor as you will be very lost.
Rajesh is a cool guy, and though sometimes his lectures are unclear he's funny and helpful. Sometimes lecture is difficult, but overall I enjoyed the class.

Great professor!! Really enthuastic...make an effort to go see him and he will do all he can to help you out. If you're lazy, don't complain because this is a challenging class and the prof expects the best from you...!! Its a good thing, trust me. TAKE THIS CLASS!
awful. most unhelpful professor i've ever had. does not help in office hours, and does not care how well students do. awful.

forget what anyone else says.  rajesh is an awesome teacher who cares about the students and the subject matter.  he assigns a lot of readings, and if you don't do them you will probably be lost (like the other person who commented apparently was).  it's all about going to see him during office hours.  plus, he has a cute accent.

Lectures were very unclear and he did not really show much of an interest in helping students learn. the subject matter was admittedly difficult, but he did not do much to help clarify anything.  Very hard grader.

Goes slowly and takes time with each concept. Gives a lot of practice questions in class under each topic and is always willing to explain (even the most foolish questions). Clear explanation and effective teaching.

Manas has a significant aura surrounding his work. Lectures, while hard to understand, were stated with charisma and love. He explained he thinks the course is boring, and did so with extreme clarity. Notes are written unclearly, but why would you need them as the lecturing is superb (also hard to follow). Homeworks were easy, final was cool.

Overall he was a good guy and did lots of practice problems. Felt like a standard college calculus class and the class was mostly graded by exams. Exams were fair and he gave pretty fair grades. As long as you study you can pretty easily achieve a B- or higher. Unfortunately, this class is bad for anyone who struggles with testing. Do your best!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Chill guy, spends the whole class going over practice problems, and as others have said sometimes it's easy to drift off. That being said HWs were easy and exams pretty straightforward (follow the same format every sem). Discussion not helpful but go for attendance credit. Highly recommend the SI sessions though, they were a godsend for exam prep

He's a little hard to understand and the lectures are just not engaging. The amount of times I thought I would pay attention and then accidentally started drifting to different thoughts was not helpful. The homework is fairly easy, you get 5-6 tries to get it right. The discussion quizzes also count towards your final grade so make sure to go.

I took his Math 131 class and am currently taking his Math 551 class. Amazing professor. Understands any doubt you might have, gives a clear answer. Very accessible outside of class and very accommodating. Remembers every student who participates actively, and is very professional. His notes are some of the best I've used - easy, concise. Goat.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Love his lectures, very cool and inspirational teacher
Manas is a nice teacher. Just make sure your on the right track when preparing for the exams, because they will cover a lot of material from the class, to help you be successful.

I'm not even done with the term yet, but I just want to say he is so cool. He gave us a quiz today with little to no risk of failing. Solving the math equation was pretty fun without the pressure of getting a bad grade! I want more teachers like him, who make learning enjoyable and don't punish students for not knowing.

Manas was very passionate about math, and you can see it. He did give quizzes, but they were overall grade boosters, and helped you solidify what you learned in class. You also had until the end of the day and it was only one question. He was very accessible outside of class, and was always willing to help. He made me enjoy calculus.

Great professor with good lectures, and incredibly helpful outside of class over email and in office hours. Attendance isn't mandatory, but you should absolutely go, since you can easily fall behind. Semi-weekly quizzes (not open-note) and semi-weekly homework. No exams, but the "final" is basically an extra-hard, extra-long homework assignment.

He's a great prof and if you actually go and listen to the lectures and take notes, you will do good in the class. Attendance isn't mandatory but you should still go or else you will be stuck on the exams and homeworks. There are 3 exams which are worth most of your grade.
He was very difficult to understand as he had a very heavy accent. The teacher himself is very nice and understanding if you go to talk to him though
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Very good prof. He was very kind to me and all my peers, understanding and accessible. The second midterm was very challenging in comparison to the first exam and the final, but that was out of his control. He teaches for the exams perfectly, provides a plethora of examples every single class. Attendance was not mandatory, but you will want to go

Amazing professor! He is extremely nice and cares about a student's success in math. His lectures are helpful when doing the homework. The quizzes can be hard but he lets students work together and sometimes will help you get the answer if needed and extremely accessible outside of class. Would definitely take him again for higher math courses.

Professor Bhowmik is often difficult to understand. 290W is an organic weed management course, however the professor openly claims organic methods do not have much merit and regularly criticizes them. The University should find a better fit for the class. Do not take this course if you want to learn applied organic weed management

He's stuck in the past, and completely biased towards chemical herbicides.  I stopped going, because I could not handle memorizing names and chemical makeups of a million herbicides that I would never use. If you work on a golf course, you might enjoy this class, but if you care about sustainable ag. DON'T TAKE IT!
No Comments
he sucks as a teacher and is immpossible to understand cool guy though
very interesting. . . the lectures are very informative but his labs are a little slow
He's pretty passionate about his field, but the lecture is a bit boring. Homework is just readings and 2 group projects. Light workload. Good overall

He's very passionate about his field of study and he often shares stories of his travels around the world. No exams, but there were about 4 quizzes this semester. Group projects but it was all light work. Just pay attention to his slides.

Dr. Bjorn Nordtveit is an amazing professor. He really cares about his students wellbeing and wants them to do well in the class. Bjorn encourages us to think outside of the box. I would recommend this class to anyone in the college of education!
fire prof, attendance is soft mandatory he's reasonable, if you do the readings you'll learn alot. offers support and extensions to those who need them and is overall reasonable. also super funny.

Bjorn is a great and caring professor. I took his course for junior year writing. I never wrote op-ed before taking this course, therefore, I went to his office hour and ask for help. He did clarify what is op-ed and help to sort out my ideas. He gives helpful feedback on assignments so that we can improve on our next one.

Bjorn is a great professor and is very understanding of his students. From the first class He made it a priority for everyone to feel accepted and included. I took his course for junior year writing and I was struggling managing the work, but Bjorn understood my circumstance and allowed me to pass things in after the deadline.

Professor Nordtveit is a very caring professor and wants every student to succeed. He is passionate about the class material and puts a lot of effort into making class interesting. He gives great feedback on assignments and sends out a weekly communicator to make sure everyone is on track and aware of expectations for the upcoming week.

For a mandatory class, he was able to make it interesting. I enjoyed his openness to learning from his students. If things weren't working throughout the course he gave many opportunities to provide him with feedback. Generally a very understanding guy. Lots of writing but that can be expected with Jr. yr writing. Modern outlook on AI was cool.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: I learned a lot from taking his class. He was very passionate in teaching the subject. He was well prepared for the class. I like the way he facilitated the class, the subject was not an easy one but he could create a relax atmosphere, very engaging and at the same time, it made us think critically. He did his best to support his student success.

Don't get me wrong, this class is incredibly easy. If you want an easy A in a gen ed, take this class. It's just so boring. Lectures weren't engaging in the slightest and I always used class time to study for my other classes. Nordtveit is a great guy and the TA's were also very nice, but the class was just so painfully dull and uninteresting.

Not a tough class until I find out that final require you to answer 3 questions and each not less than 500 words. The final is 1 hour 15 min, and at least 1500. For a non-native English speaker like me, it is jus impossible to complete this task.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He's honestly a great prof who really cares. Textbook use optional, and he gave us PDFs of the required readings. Important topics, well taught, super interesting. The easiest and best class I've taken so far. Highly recommend him!

Grades mostly depended on attendance, 2 group projects and quizzes. Will randomly call on people, so... Otherwise, it's an easy A. Topics can get pretty heavy. He's been incorporating videos into his lecture. There were lots of moments of confusion in the class, esp. when he assigns group work and he's not clear on the instructions.

He is a very passionate teacher that may not always come through as very passionate. His lectures are pretty boring, I think mostly just due to him being a bit monotone, but he does deeply care about the topics. The class itself is easy as long as you participate, especially in your group.

He doesn't inspire anyone to learn in the class. The motivation is there, but there isn't any energy or drive to bring the students together and discuss, which is important in a TBL class. The TA's fall short when trying to bring us to discuss, because it seems way too forced. The only thing tough about this class is to stay awake.

Bjorn is supportive, helpful and compassionate in the classroom to all his students' needs and takes the time to really explain concepts, ideas and assignments. He encourages discussion and dialogue, which makes it a better learning environment than most professors who love to go off into irrelevant tangents-What's not to like?
Very funny and insightful lecturer

i loved her energy and this class its was so interested and you can tell she was invested. i was wary because i was only graded on a few exams, but they didnt end out being too hard as long as you did the practice homeworks. very funny and personable!

Dr. Biezma is definitely a polarizing professor, from what I can tell, but my experience with her was overall quite pleasant. Overall, she's as engaging as she is flexible for those who are willing to reach out.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She is okay but is sometimes passive aggressive and sarcastic during class and in her comments on the drafts. Much of the grade is on rough drafts which makes it a question of "can you use the grammar perfectly or not?". She gives A-'s on almost all the drafts. sometimes she would dock points for sentences that work but aren't to her preference

The class itself isn't difficult, but the rough drafts were worth more to our grade than the final draft, and she didn't give out A's for rough draft.... so getting an A was hard. She made the class more about grammar than improving our writing. Take 311 before this otherwise the grammar is so difficult. Lectures are excruciatingly boring.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: A helpful, nice, funny TA. She is somewhat strict: she expects people to do their half, but she is very nice about helping you if you are genuinely trying. She has a fairly significant accent, which keeps her from being able to make distinctions between sounds, but it really isn't a problem.
great ta. she really explains things thru and tries eveything to help you do well in the class. doesnt grade really hard either so i definately recommend that you take her discusssion for the class.

All lectures are posted online. Attendance is not mandatory, but it is easy to fall behind if you don't watch the lecture recordings. You have to buy the website to use complete the homework. Lots of homework, but multiple chances to get full credit, three exams plus a final.
Overall a super easy class. Jeff was awesome and very fashionable, he was always willing to extend deadlines and give plenty of opportunities to improve your grade

Jeffrey Beaulieu is an amazing teacher. He is very caring and clear with his teachings, & offers alternative times to meet for office hours to thoroughly explain material in ways that best fit my learning style. I appreciate how he maintains a sense of humor throughout his lectures and goes over difficult material multiple times.

Jeff is a fantastic professor. I've never been good at math, but his teaching style is so comprehensive and straightforward. I had him for Math 101 and 102, and I've learned so much. He's very patient and kind, and seeking help as you need it is crucial to your success in this course! Go to office hours and NEVER skip an SI session! Ty Jeff :)

reviews.comment: If you need to take a math class, take it with Jeff!! One of the best professors out there, explains material very well, super accommodating, and actually wants students to succeed. Exams are easy if you just attend/watch all the lectures and do the hw.

Genuinely the most accommodating and kind professor. He is always willing to help and goes above and beyond for his students! Do the homework and go to his office hours if you need help because the homework questions make up the exams. He really cares about student success!!

Super accommodating, quick to respond, clear and straight-forward instruction, made lectures interesting, and was great at communicating info about HW and exams. Legit everything you want in a professor. Jeff is the GOAT

Jeff is the absolute goat, bro I cannot stress this enough. If you have to take an intro to math like 101 or 102, this is the class. Super caring, great feedback, don't have to go to class, but you should because his way of teaching is so good it makes learning math fun.
He's very nice and I like how he teaches his classes!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Really sweet and explains topics well. Recommend taking

Jeff is such a nice guy and he explains most topics well. All exams are multiple choice and typically no more than 20 questions, 5 being free points! Attendance is not mandatory and lectures are recorded, but he looks sad if you don't come to class :( so go to class for king Jeff we love him

I am a d1 Jeff glazer. I suck at math and this guy was so helpful when instructing as he focused on the why we do things instead of just doing it. As an extra plus, I love his voice he sounds like Obama. Homework is super easy but MyMathLab is expensive and sucks as a program. Jeff I love you I wish I could take you to Math 127 with me.

I've NEVER succeeded in math until having Jeff as a professor. He explains everything so simply, and his tests are beyond doable. Not to mention he's so kind and wholesome. As a sophomore, he's honestly my favorite professor thus far! I genuinely have nothing negative to say about him or his class.

I've always been a poor math student, but Jeff is seriously one of the best math teachers I've ever had. He makes hard problems seem simple and explains things so well. Tests are fair and homework is a good resource for the exams. Highly recommend him as a professor!

This is the only math class I have ever felt confident in. HIGHLY recommend Jeff.
All homework assignments will be on Pearson's My Math Lab. This will give you the opportunity to try problems multiple times and find study materials on what you struggle with. Each class is recorded and uploaded to Canvas in Echo360.

jeff is the GOAT. explains things very thoroughly in class and cares about students. he genuinely wants you to understand the material and goes out of his way to help you. really funny and has great sense of style. i wish he taught every subject ever.
easy to follow along. lectures are recorded. cares about his students

Jeff is a great professor. I took math 101 and 102 with him. Although I have trouble understanding math, his teaching style makes sense to me. Jeff is AMAZING and truly cares for his students success. If you're struggling, make sure to meet with him:)
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He is flexible with assignments and test dates. Overall, best math class I had in a long time!

Amazing professor and person. Genuinely cares for his students and will go out of his way to help them. Super sweet and easy to talk to, responds to emails fast, is very understanding, can sometimes oversimplify the material in class. I wish I could have him as my professor for all my future math courses.
someone marry this guy already

Jeff is so awesome I love him. I would take him for every single math class ever if I could. He is super caring and really loves what he does, which makes the class so much more interesting and fun. He is always willing to talk to you and help you out if needed, and his classes are just lovely. Shoutout Jeff.

Jeff is great! He likes to be called Jeff. He is super nice, helpful, and great at teaching. His class had SO MANY resources for help. There were always exam reviews and SI sessions. We had no quizzes just 4 exams that were all on our materials. Super easy to learn with him and the TA's

Highly recommend this class. The notes are super helpful and are all I used to study. Tests are based on theories and if you know the steps to solving rather than asking you to solve. Tests are 25 MCQ and final is 40 MCQ. The homework is only about 20-40 MCQ but you get about a week and everything's covered in the lecture. Learned a ton.

Jeff is a great professor who clearly cares a lot about his students. Very accommodating and is very generous with extensions on hw (if you have a good reason you will get it almost every time). Most of your grade is based on exams so do  keep that in mind. Laid out very clearly what will be on the tests and gives lots of opportunities to review.

Jeff is a G. Lots of notes, my hand kinda hurt, but it's chill. Only con is that you need to pay for the homework software, but it's worth it cause the homework is an amazing grade booster. Exams are all multiple-choice. Calculators aren't allowed, but you don't really need them. Overall, love him. Taking him again next year for Math 121.
Stay on top of the assignments go to the SI sessions and pay attention in class. Very good teacher and he is nice man :) To access the assignments you need to buy pearson for like 90 dollars
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I will miss Jeff so much next semester. Truly made the material easy for me to understand and also gave clear expectations for what was going to be on the exams. Homework was easy and he always answered any questions and made sure you understood before he went on. if you can take a class with Jeff DO IT.

Jeff is hands down my favorite math teacher I have ever had. He explains things so well and will stay after class with you to discuss any questions. The amount of homework is not bad and the exams are very fair.
goes slow and cares if you understand the material or not
We all love Jeff! He would even bring in props to help explain probability problems with real life examples. He thoroughly explained everything and is very accommodating.

The first time I've understood math in years. I got all zeros on my math placement tests and had to start from scratch (as a CS major who should be in Calc 1) and he breaks everything down so well. Jeff is the best math teacher I have ever had. He is a teacher that fully explains the material in many different ways to ensure full understanding. I have Extra time accommodations on tests and Jeff went out of his way to help me set up times with him that worked with my schedule.

Professor Beaulieu is an incredible lecturer who genuinely cares about student success. The workload is manageable if you stay on top of it, and Unstuck study ai is a great supplemental study tool alongside the free textbook.

This class is objectively very easy, but I strongly recommend taking a different gen ed for either your R1 or R2 if you haven't done math in a few years. He breaks the content down to the bone and exams are all multiple choice. Super caring and understanding.

Jeff is a great professor for those interested in taking Math101. Jeff explains things very well during lectures, but sometimes oversimplifies concepts. reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: When I say there were no surprises in this class, I mean it. The hw WELL prepares you for the tests because the tests are exactly as he says & are more conceptual than "problem-ey." Jeff is an amazing professor! I was nervous about this class because I'm HORRIBLE at math but Jeff made all the difference. So kind & accommodating & genuinely wants you to succeed!

ALL I CAN SAY IS THAT HE WAS AMAZINGGG, I DON'T CARE WHAT ANYONE SAYS HE IS A GREAT TEACHER. ALWAYS READY TO HELP, ESPECIALLY WHEN IT COMES TO OFFICE HOURS, I WAS ALWAYS THERE AND HE IS AWESOMEEE!!!!    THANKS JEFF!!
Great professor would 100% take again. Lectures are clear an concise. Just the right amount of class interaction. He posts recorded lectures. Exams are just as he states.

Amazing. The goat. Makes math easy to understand. Does not stump you and ask trick questions on exams. The legend. The man himself.

reviews.comment: Jeff is amazing. Seriously the kindest professor ever. You will never be worried to ask questions- he will never judge you. If you take any math with him, consider yourself blessed. I'm going to miss having him as a prof SO much.

Professor Beaulieu is one of the kindest people that I have ever met. He will always make time to meet with his students outside of class (when possible) and will go the extra mile to ensure that his students are knowledgable of the subject material. I typically struggle with math, but Jeff helped me get where I needed to be.
Jeff was super amazing. He is very well spoken and great at explaining if you're struggling. Tests and homework are fairly easy if you pay attention. Great professor!

I liked Jeff, I just felt his lecture style wasn't my favorite. He would write the notes with you, but he went pretty fast which made it hard to keep up. Sometimes people just talked over him the whole time which also made it hard to pay attention. Otherwise it is fine.

This class was amazingly easy and I am so thankful to be an education major where this counts for R1 and R2. Very easy class as long as you do your homework and study for tests. Online homework assignments almost weekly, will extend due date if needed (just email him). reviews.comment: Jeff is a great guy. He seems to be on the prof's that really care about the students and strives to see them succeed. He answers emails very fast. I do NOT like math nor am i very good at it, but jeff made it easy!
He was a good teacher but very boring. Attendance was not mandatory and lectures were recorded. Exam was kinda hard tho

This guy might be the nicest man on the plant. He accommodates any need and is always willing to help a student through any hardship. His class if fairly easy and very lecture heavy. Beware for his tests though as they can be surprisingly difficult in comparison to the rest of the class.

Professor Beaulieu is a great teacher. I have always had a difficult time understanding math, but his lectures are amazing. He posts recordings of all lectures, and is overall a great guy and it is a good math class.

I would definitely take Jeff's class again, to pass the course you definitely need to pay attention, there's only two hw assignments a week on Pearson, extremely nice professor. 3 exams and 1 final. He's a great guy, gives great explanations and created a super inspiring classroom environment!

Jeff is a great professor. His lectures are very easy to follow, and he writes out notes that are projected to the entire class. His examples are always great, and provide a wonderful explanation of the material. He is easy to reach via email, and very considerate of students with accomodations.

Jeff is an absolute King! One of the nicest, most caring, and most professors at Umass. He truly wants his students to succeed! In class, he explains the topics in a way that is engaging and fun for everyone. He is accessible out ion class and clearly explains everything during his office hours.

I miss Jeff's lectures so much. He would write out the notes with the students so there was no rushing to write everything down. If you have accommodations, he makes time for you to take the exams with him, which was nice to not have to go through D.S. and I could ask questions if I was confused.

He explains materials very clearly, you can stop him mid explanation if you didn't understand something and he would re-explain it to you in a way you would understand. Home works from him aren't bad either but I would say their easy nor they are hard.

Make sure you understand the concepts and vocab from his lectures, take notes, and study before taking the exam. If you do these you will get an A. If you only know how to do the problem and not the concept then you will struggle. No extra credit btw

Such a sweet professor. Will boost your grade if you come for extra help and lenient with points on exams. So so accessible outside of class, responds to emails very quickly. Lectures can be a little heavy and boring as he keeps you until the end of class every time but only 3 exams. MUST study for exams as need to complete problems a certain way.

Best math teacher I've ever had, I suck at math and took this class to knock out the R1. He really care's about his students, make sure to email him and meet with him if you have trouble. Make sure to do all homework thoroughly (graded randomly).

Jeff! He's a great professor who moves slowly through material to ensure that each student understand what is being taught. Attendance isn't mandatory but is helpful in understanding the material. Previous reviewers said he gave out extra credit, but I went to every lecture and discussion and not one extra credit opportunity.

Jeff is so caring. He is willing to help you during office hours so you understand the material better. He records the lectures, which is good. Jeff is literally the most amazing professor. He will go above and beyond to ensure that you understand the material at its core. You can tell he truly cares about what he does.
The class consists of him lecturing and doing work on paper being projected onto a screen the whole class can see. It is not always easy but it because it is recorded you can always watch it again.

Great guy

Jeff is so cute I love him he really cares if you pass. Math 101 was very very very easy for me. There is a lof of hw but its all due at the test date so its like nothing if you spread it out. Jeff is so kind! He makes the concepts simple and easy to understand. Even for someone who hates math this class is pretty easy.

Jeff is the best professor I've ever had, period. I took Math101, Math102, and Math121 with him, and he is incredibly caring and takes the time to explain everything to the class. Attendance is not mandatory, but definitely go or else you won't understand the subject, and you do in class exercises which equal a max of extra 5 points.

The best math teacher I've ever had in my life. So clear and concise. It's clear that he wants every one of his students to succeed and really cares if you actually understand the material. I usually hate math but he made it almost enjoyable. You get points added to your grade just for participating in class exercises. Very approachable, great guy.

Jeff is a great teacher and is well respected by the whole class. He does a daily problem for extra credit every class. Also only one homework assignment a week
Really nice professor for a really easy class.

reviews.comment: Great Professor who was super willing to go over material again if students didn't understand material and made sure students had multiple opportunities to review material before exams.
Jeff is clear. It is obvious that the everyone in the course struggles with math- Jeff is concise and shows care and compassion in his students struggles.
Great professor. His lectures are clear and to the point, he's specific and concise. He always offers help. No quizzes, three exams and a final exam. His exams are fair. Homework isn't too bad.
Fairly long homeworks, fair tests, and pointless discussions. He definitely cares about his students.

Jeff is a really great professor. I had him for a year of precalc. His motto is truly just show up, do your work, and you'll pass with flying colors. pretty straightforward, shows you how to do the problems and then makes you practice one in class. Homework is online and pretty easy, tests are pretty easy too depending if you review or not. Overall great professor :)

Great guy. Cares about his students and wants them to do well. Very accessible outside class. Will go over concepts until everyone understands. Gives extra credit points as an incentive for attending lecture and discussion.
Jeff is the best math professor there is. He is kind and genuinely cares about his students. There are many opportunities for extra credit and exams are not bad at all if you study.

Jeff is a great professor. He cares a lot, and takes the time to really walk you through  the steps and concepts. Showing up is kind of extra credit, which is a great incentive to show up to class. 3 exams and a final, and homework is all on MyMathLab. I'd recommend taking any math class with him!
JEFF IS AWESOME! so clear with EVERYTHING, REALLY wants everyone to just learn and pass and succeed. He's so easy to talk to if you ever have questions, and is all around just a great guy

great teacher, easy class if you show up and do the work

I never write reviews for professors but after Jeff's class I literally felt OBLIGATED to. class is not mandatory but i would advise you to go because he gives out extra credit. studying outside of class isn't something you have to do as long as you listen in class. Jeff is the nicest teacher Ive had in college.  He explains material very well and answers questions well.  There are daily in class assignments that are for extra credit and help your grade.  Homework every week which is pretty difficult.  Overall great class and generally easy.
