reviews.comment: don't bother wasting your money on the textbook; you'll barely use it. his writing class is pretty much a waste of time..literally. this guy's "projects" took more time to complete than all my other classes combined. that being said, he's a helpful guy. just a lot of work.

Steve Brewer is one of the nicest professors I've had. He's always willing to give you extra time on assignments without lowering your grade. If you're not really familiar with Microsoft Word, formatting your papers can be difficult but he's always willing to help.
I thought this class was very manageable - weekly journal entries and group projects throughout the semester. Steven gives you every chance to succeed, and overall a very nice guy.

First off, Steven is a nice man. But he is a horrible teacher, very hard to understand and hard to know what he is asking of you. He made a class that was about writing in biology into a computer science course! And he made us do work for the town of Amherst, haven't we given them enough with all our cash! Please Steven, stick to the BCRC.
This guy is nice but extremely boring. He never seems to be able to answer questions.

This class is a requirement for bio majors. Steven is a really nice guy. took the time to learn everyone's name. Just very very confusing! A lot of the class time seemed useless. class content needed more structure. Also, if you dont have a Mac you may be a little lost...
This class is very computer oriented. There are four writing assignments which are usually done in groups...over the computer, and most of them required outdoor activity such as going into the woods.
No Comments

Kathleen runs one of the easiest classes you will take, but there were times when she gave blatantly false or outdated information, and if you have a background in the social sciences, you may notice how she butchers some topics and misses a lot of nuance. I'd love to take her class on American Indian Law, but 201H with her was unfulfilling.
Great professor. She provides all material needed for finishing reading. She is also very kind and caring plus nonchalant.

If you have the chance, you should take Ideas that Change the World with Kathleen. Compared to my other friends taking this class, I had much less homework and readings to complete. She talks a lot (making it hard to participate) and isn't tech savvy at all, but the class is interesting and relatively easy and she grades very fairly.

Great class overall. I had no idea what my grade was until end of semester. One big project was to write a speech. Multiple choice quizzes here and there. I learned a lot in this class. Definitely do the readings (she provides them so you don't have to purchase anything). Would take again!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Take Kathleen for ideas!! Compared to other professors, her class is the least amount of work. We had the entire semester to write one research paper on any topic and we got easy points for making name tags and attendance. She LOVES to talk so its hard to participate but she's super interesting. It was an easy class and she also gave us skips :)

Prof. Brown-Perez is awesome! Her personable, funny, and understanding personality makes 201H a class I loved going to (she is definitely the professor to have for 201H). Go to class and actually read the readings and you will do fine. She can be disorganized sometimes but she is always available to talk to if you have questions.
Had to read A LOT of things. She's a great professor and she's very helpful, but she really cares about attendance and expects homework every class.
Love her!! She's definitely the best professor for Honors 201. Highly recommend her. A few readings here and there but its not bad.

I loved Kathleen!  She's one of the sweetest professors you'll ever have, and she's super interested in making sure that you enjoy the class! Because she's a lawyer, this class tends to have a law slant to it, but it's super interesting and an all around great class.

Kathleen is LITERALLY the BEST professor you will ever find at UMass!!!! She understands that this class isn't meant to dominate your life and so she keeps it fairly simple and gives clear instructions. And everyday at the end of class she offers you help and to go to her office with her. She also gives some extra credit assignments during semester

Good. Comes off as tough, but she's really nice. Find out from the last class how much work they had to do for their research paper. If they did a lot, good! That means they complained, and you'll get less this semester. It's not hard when she is in hard mode, but try to get her when she's in an easier semester.
I 100% recommend Kathleen. She prepares you well for the research paper, runs a very interesting class, and tailors the class to be law-based (since she's a lawyer). One of my favorite professors!

Kathleen is awesome. She is so nice and as long as you don't disrespect her you will love her. Readings for homework and discussions during class (possible to participate without having read). Overall, an enjoying class that is manageable!

I loved Kathleen's class. I strongly feel like an honors requirement like 291A should supplement the curriculum, not overtake your semester, and Kathleen did a great job with it. The reading was light; we had no essays and only one project. You don't have to buy the books; she provides the passages online. Would recommend her for this class.
Great teacher- not a lot of work required, but she makes you think. She's very nice and very approachable.

Seems very tough at first but it's relatively easy to get an A in this class. Not much work required, but learned good research techniques from her. Entire class basically focused solely on writing a short (4-6 page) research paper.

Really good for this class. Expects minimal works and understands its only 2 credits. Somewhat repetitive but mostly keeps your attention. Very helpful with papers and funny too. Just don't insult Indians, go to class and do the assignments and you'll be good.

Very useful class to teach helpful methods to writing papers, especially resources the school has for works cited pages.  The classes went by fast, and got out early a lot.  Show up and do the bare minimum and you can still get an A.

A fun professor. She expects a lot from you, but it's not a big deal. She's funny, nice, and smart. She might repeat herself from time to time, but she's not boring. Just do the work, show up, and be respectful. Overall a very good class. :]

Class=mandatory, but get out early some days.  The books are interesting and as long as you're trying, shell help you. DO NOT fall asleep or be late.  BUY the MLA handbook and bring it to class. Shes very proud of being native american so dont her started on how the world has tortured her people. Thinks shes the greatest, but its funny so its okay.

Absolutely fantastic.  She made the class almost entirely discussion based, but picked topics that were easy to discuss and have opinions about.  And she didn't mind if the topic strayed on occasion and would even join in on some digressions.
Fantastic teacher- she instills indispensible skills and habits for research writing that will leave you feeling self-directed and on top of your studies

I would take Professor Baldi's FYS a million times again. The course subject is interesting and he's a great teacher. Be ready to read and participate, but he won't twist your neck on talking in class if you truly do not want to. He's really understanding about everything and really easily accessible if you have any questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Hilarious--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I'm so glad I took this FYS. Learning about photography is actually super interesting and I found the assignments very fun to do. Awesome feedback on assignments. Just really cool stuff to learn about :-)

HE IS THE BEST. He cares so much about his students, is so funny, and wants you to succeed. I cannot say enough great things about Prof. Baldi and I mean it. It is the total truth that this guy is extremely kind, personable, and easy to talk to. The material is easy as well, and you have plenty of time to do it all.
He is so awesome!! Such a chill class, funny guy
Really nice class!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Really genuine guy. Makes the class atmosphere super relaxed and brings snacks to almost every class. The class is pretty straight forward, the work load is fairly low, and he grades super easy (I've gotten good grades on responses written on my walk to class). Highly recommend taking class with him.

Brian is AWESOME, a real gem of a teacher. He's incredibly passionate about English and tries to inspire his students to really think and discuss their thoughts. I stayed back to talk with him many times and he's just an awesome person and is a real nerd when talking about certain books/authors. He also brings cookies to class often!
a smart guy, and a pleasure to work with. he legitimately cares about getting his students engaged with the class and offers a pretty laid back atmosphere in which to work. ask him about asparagus.
he's cool. i hate writing and still his class was fun. he has a good sense of humor and is wicked smart. since you got to take this class, try to take it with him. good man.
Brian is a great teacher. He is responsive to students needs, and he's funny, and very fair. i learned a lot. Definitly take his class if you can!!
No Comments
Brian's the man.  I love his class, and it's helped me craft my writing a little bit more.  He's very well-read and approachable.

this guy is nuts. hes funny but also a bit creepy. he stalks people who have the same name as him. the papers are not that hard. his grading is not really tough, but it is hard to get an A. if you have to take an english class... take it with him.

Wasn't too excited about this class to start with, ended up being cool. Because of the papers, not always fun, but he made the class interesting. Last paper is an album review, the type of thing that your typical writing class won't get to do. Good guy who cares about the students, take his class.
HATE THIS GUY!! Doesn't know how to grade. AVOID HIM!!!!
Very fun guy.  Great class discussion of reading and film materials.  Very fair grader as well.  Don't try to **** him...he's an English Professor!
He is a good teacher, but grades papers way too hard, Kids write papers no better than mine in other classes and get A's, While I am stuck with B-
Brian is not a worldclass scrabble player, but an outstanding professor.
Brian was very helpful.  His comments on my papers were good and I learned a lot, even though I didn't want to take that class.  He is also very cute.  I think he is a grad student.  Good glasses.
Professor was passive aggressive and some of the class discussion is extremely uncomfortable.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: extremely supportive in helping students construct better writing. im convinced that the reviews stating she is mean are misconstruing her dry sense of humor. she was nothing but respectful toward my class. she does have expectations for class conduct and how assignments should be submitted, but they are reasonable and easy to follow

I can see how some students might not like her personality, but I enjoyed her class. Really intelligent professor. I think I improved the most as a writer compared to any other English class I've taken. Weekly 500 word writing assignments but she gives extremely detailed feedback. Big final project, not bad if you don't leave until the last minute.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: exceptionally rude & mean professor
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Brenna is my favorite teacher at UMass.She is very smart but lectures in a way that helps students understand by simplifying complex history.Every assignment is predictable,she is clear about grading,she gets assignments back to us with extensive notes within two weeks of submitting it, she is flexible with extensions, always open to office hours!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Caring

reviews.comment: Brenna has great choices for the readings. But like reviews have said, she can be incredibly mean to students who think about the box. I would not recommend her — she seems to have a chip on her shoulder.

I took both Eng 296 and Eng 272 with Professor Casey. I find her ability to engage with literature and provide historical context unmatched. She does assign heaving readings but that should be expected in an English course. She expects high-level engagement and discussion, hopefully pushing students to actually read on a deeper level.
Professor Casey is by FAR the meanest professor I have had in my whole life. She loves to put students down who are, quite frankly, smarter than her. DO NOT TAKE.

Take this class if you are comfortable with participating, because that is a major part of it. There were 500 word writing assignments every week, which were then compiled into a 40 (ish) page final portfolio that was graded. Brenna Casey can be a bit tough on students, but is ultimately a wonderful professor. Great readings as well!

This class had less "big" projects than other English classes i've taken (500-600 word response every week), but the final project did take a while because you had to revise and expand almost everything you've written. Her feedback was helpful, and as long as you participate during lecture you were basically guaranteed an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment:
This is one of my least favorite professors I've ever had. I have never in my life been UNsupported by one of my professors. I'd made a genuine effort to contribute and attend office hours more and she told me “It's not too late to drop out.” 

She is passive-aggressive and outright snobby. Do not reccomend if you want optimism and positivity.

Arguably one of the worst professors I have ever had. She didn't grade anything throughout the semester, was terrible at clarifying discussion topics in class, and overall had a terrible attitude. She was not funny, not charming, and would belittle students who may not have had the analytical skills she expected. 0/10, will NEVER see her again!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: If you're ready to put a lot of work in, this is the teacher for you. She wants you to participate more than anything in class discussions. Books are super boring, you will have to do a recitation of a poem so if you don't like that then don't take the class. Final project is so long and tedious. Good teacher, but can be kind of rude to students
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Brenna is the best professor I've ever had hands down. She's an absolute legend. I've never felt so inspired to write before, and everything we read for class was amazing. Discussions were so funny but also very thoughtful. If you take her class you're in for a treat, also you should look up some pictures of walt whitman because that will come up:)
live love brenna casey tbh

The class' lectures are informative and highly entertaining. Attendance is not technically required, but there are assignments in-person on random days. His grading policy is so incredibly generous (dropping 1/3 of assignments and walk-in makeups even if you took the exam) that any sane student won't ever need to email him.
Pretty easy tests, allowed 1 double sided sheet. Very fun professor to learn from.

Very wishy washy professor, nice on rare occasions. Not accommodating whatsoever, not forgiving, doesn't give his students grace, and just forget about going to office hours if you don't want to be berated by a grown manchild. If you're stuck with him, I suggest picking another class especially if you have him for a 100 class

This professor is inconsiderate and does not accommodate. Avoid at all cost. He does not teach you any material and instead relies on modules that you have to pay for. I would not call him a professor, because he won't teach you anything. Good luck.
Extreme lack of compassion and very insensitive good luck!
Harsh, rude, insensitive
Not an accommodating at all, especially for a psych 100 level class. A very insensitive professor.

Very insensitive teacher. He does not care for the well being of students and told my friend, whose dad was dying of stage 4 cancer, to drop all of her classes since he could not accommodate her in a 300-person class.

Incredibly rude to me one time for no reason. Super hot and cold. I understand why so many students love him but do not go to him for office hours. Raised my voice at me made me super uncomfortable and scared. I felt cornered. Will never be taking this prof again.

Not accommodating 
Very insensitive

You need to roughly attend 5/9 of the lectures (randomly selected). He's genuinely the most forgiving professor I've had. You can take make up exams (mcq) just to improve your score.
The class is pretty easy, and his lectures are fun, I enjoyed listening to his lectures even though I could probably get away with looking on my phone.

The most important part of class is textbook reading— lectures often feel like review, but have certain interactive elements I enjoy. There are also so many opportunities to get extra credit/ improve your grades. The only “challenges” would be completing your essay and getting SONA credits, but if you start early, it should go smoothly.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: John is a good professor! I honestly did not do great on the exams, but still got an A because everything else is graded leniently. Lectures were good, but a bit boring at times. I just did not like that the exams were 25 questions each, so you can get no more than 2 questions wrong in order to get an A. Everything else is very simple and easy.
this class was super enjoyable, he is a very funny professor and he loves real life examples. His exams were easy, and theres makeups which helps a lot. I highly recommend him for psych 100!!

Literally THE BEST professor ever. Does have some weird ways of explaining things; however, THIS IS THE BEST CLASS EVER!! I absolutely LOVE Professor Bickford and would LOVE to TA for him. 

Also P.S. he's very supportive of LGBTQ+ people, if that's important to you. (He does not mention LGBTQ+ topics in this class sadly)
Amazing professor. He is so understanding of students. It is an easy A. Exams are easy and you get a cheat sheet. Only have to do a few homework assignments.

You can make a double-sided cheat sheet for every test and get a study guide. All tests are multiple choice. Attendance isn't required, but he'll randomly give writing assignments (you can miss up to 4). He's funny and engaging, and make-up tests allow two double-sided cheat sheets. No lab. Online homework and extra credit. Easiest class ever.

Such an amazing professor who really solidified my decision to switch to a psych major. Hilarious, the best Boston accent, and fits. You could not fail this course if you tried. He gives you numerous reminders about papers, SONA credits, and assignments due. As long as you do them, you'll pass. Also, go to the lectures, they're amazing!!

This teacher was truly inspirational. His lectures are TED Talk worthy, and I recommend attending. Uploads online and disability friendly. Grades 2/3 short project, 3 open-note exams, 4/6 LM essays, and 4/8 in-class reaction papers. He dresses flamboyantly and has a Boston accent. Quite a character. I'll be kissing up to his for grad school essay.
Overall good class. Lectures were a bit boring but he in general is an interesting person. Occasionally funny. Fits ate. If you actually do the work it's impossible to fail.

He's very nice and funny, but his lectures are painfully boring. He mostly reads off the slides and there isn't much interaction. For some people that works, but I prefer an interactive class. I had to teach myself most of the course, which sucked. I wouldn't take him again because his teaching style doesn't match how I learn. But overall nice guy
Super easy class. Theres a ton of credit for participation and the tests are really easy cause you get to use a cheat sheet for them. Highly recommended.

He is a very caring and funny professor. He offers retakes and occasionally emails to reward good work. While some tests were challenging, success comes from reviewing notes, slides, and readings. I would definitely take this class again and recommend that students be resilient!
just don't take his classes. he isn't easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Prof Bickford in short was a respectable gentleman all semester!

A very easy class. He randomly takes attendance and you have to be there about half of the time he takes it for full credit. Make sure to go to classes before and after exams, as well as during the last week of class.  Do SONA credits ahead of time, its not worth procrastinating.

Professor Bickford had a clear syllabus and structure which I found helpful. There were many easy assignment to gets credit for. He also offered chances for extra credit. Tests are in person, on paper, but you get a double sided cheat cheat. He is a little odd but its an easy course.

Had him for Psych 100, and now Psych 360, Bickford is the best. 360 is very easy if you put the work in  Attendance is not mandatory, but you have to complete 4 of 8 in class assignments. Very straightforward with what content he wants you to know, makeup opportunities for all exams. Very fun lectures, really invested in student success.

The easiest class I've ever taken at UMass. Just go to lectures, take notes, and make sure to go through study guide before exam. Exams are open notes, exam makeups available, optional final, multiple opportunities to do assignments incase you missed a couple. In class reaction papers-you have to do 4 out of 8. Textbook not needed.

Bickford is by far the funniest professor I've ever had. He makes lectures super super fun and always participates with the class. He gives so many extra credit options and the work is not hard at all as long as you actually do it.

Prof. Bickford made Social Psych very enjoyable! While lectures could get a little rambly, he would try to incorporate jokes and videos to split it up. Tests are very easy and cheat sheets are allowed. Truly a professor that gives you plenty of chances to succeed in the class and learn the material.

he was awesome. attendance wasn't mandatory after you finish reaction papers. records on echo 360 double sided cheat sheet for tests, easy questions that arent meant to trick you. keeps you engages in the lectures bc he has a sense of humor. doesnt believe in finals so we dont have one. take his psych 100 class over the other professors

Dr. Bickford is a great professor, especially for Psych 100! The assignments are simple and the textbook is online. Unfortunately, they do make you pay for the McGraw Hill textbook but it helps to really understand and remember the information. Overall, a great professor, especially for PSYCH 100.
Best teacher ever. Makes class both easy and interesting. Actually cares about his students and wants you to do well. Definitely recommend. Best teacher you could ask for.

Attend the lectures and this class will be the easiest one you can take, Prof. Bickford is hilarious, and stylish! He offers many opportunities for extra credit, in class, online, and even in the exam. Even though attendance to lectures isn't mandatory he hands out random in-class papers which if you aren't there for can affect your grade.
Super sweet guy, lectures are bare bones but the content is there. Worth taking his class for his fits alone. The tests were open note and thus extremely easy.
He was cool
Loveeeeee himmmmm

Bickford was easily my favorite teacher. His lectures were fun to attend even though they weren't mandatory. You have to complete 6 reaction papers in class, there are 4 midterms (no final) and you get a cheat sheet for all of them- pretty easy all multiple choice. The textbook assignments were quick, and helped to learn the material!

He might just be the most relatable and humorous professor I had. His lectures were very engaging and I learned something every time I left. He allows a cheat sheet for every exam, and you should do great as long as you complete most of the online homework. I would totally recommend taking Psych 100 with him!
exams are in person but are open note so just remember to study with textbooks because that helps so much! only have to do 4 out of the 6 short papers. really great and funny guy!

hands down the BEST professor i've had here so far. every time i left his lectures i felt as if i had actually learned something and the way he teaches and explains things actually makes sense to me. he is so relatable and funny and has the best fashion sense. if you can PLEASE choose him as your professor
Super funny guy, lectures are great. Gives LOTS of extra credit opportunities and allows cheat sheets on all exams.
This guy rocks. Cheat sheets, great lectures, no attendance.

Prof Bickford's PSCYH100 class is a great option - lots of extra credit, manageable workload, and engaging lectures. Definitely worth attending, and unstuckstudy ai can help with exam prep. Overall, a solid class that's not too difficult.

He's really funny, and extremely real to students. His expectations are really clear, just make sure you do all the homework and all the extra credit. He takes no late work. Even though he posts the slides online, make sure you go to class because he does pop quizzes in class that you can't make up called "reaction papers"
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment:
Prof Bickford is amazing! He gives many easy extra credit opportunities (Spring 2024)! 
For exams, you have 4 midterms! If you do bad on them, no worries as he has makeup exams! No final in class!
For assignments, you only have to do a certain amount (not all), and the same for papers that are given in class!

Im confused how he does not have a 5/5. This was my second course taken with him and I will jump on any opportunity to take a class with him in the future. His lectures are so engaging and you can miss half without penaltyHis projects are genuinely fun and not time consuming. Exams are open note and study guides are online! Incredible class and guy

Professor Bickford is a great professor especially for this course. His lectures are definitely worth going to and it is a manageable workload. He provides extra credit opportunities and sets his grading criteria well and up front. Could not say enough good things about him and this course.

Genuinely the most touching professor I have ever had. He is such a good man and an incredible professor. I think we have a textbook but I've never read it I don't think you need to. Tests have cheat sheets/you can bring your notes. Class was not hard, and he is AMAZING. Inspired me so much as a person. Also the class content was really interesting
He is honestly an amazing person. I feel like I am getting life advice every time I listen to him talk. Amazing man!

John is hilarious, engaging, intelligent, and insightful. I adore him. Exams open-note, a few papers, in-class assignments that you can miss half off, genuinely one of the best profs I've ever had. Love him so much. There's a textbook I never touched, not necessary.

He always shows up in the best outfits. Very engaging proff for a class of 300 students. "RP" are given spontaneously and you need to complete 9/13, so attendance isn't necessarily mandatory but I would go because he's so fun. Can bring cheat sheet for tests. 1 6-page essay (10 weeks to complete) and online textbook assignments that are tedious.

John's lectures are the best. I took Psych 100 for a gen ed credit, and it ended up being my favorite class. His lectures are so informational and entertaining. He is very knowledgeable and is very easy to learn from. Favorite professor I have had so far.

I can't stress enough how much I love John's class. Any class you take with him will easily be your favorite. He's such a bright and vibrant person who cares deeply about his students. The actual class is very stress-free as you have many extra credit & makeup opportunities & open note exams. I will definitely be taking many more classes with him!

Extra credit opportunities with iClicker and reaction papers sometimes had extra credit. There are test make-ups, which the better score is always taken, so there's no harm. Very funny and gives good lectures, the echo360 videos suck though (the room's recording is just bad), so it's better to attend class in person. Overall one of the best prof.

John Bickford is an amazing professor! He's hilarious and still does a great job teaching the material while also making the lectures engaging. He gives opportunities for extra-credit points and allows a cheat sheet for each exam. The course is super easy and interesting, I highly recommend it!

Professor Bickford is an amazing prof. Psych100 itself is a pretty light course but he makes it so much easier. His lectures and slides are very thorough and well-explained. He also has a good sense of humor and gives plenty of reminders for upcoming deadlines on exams and papers. Overall solid prof.
GOAT

Great professor w vibrant personality. Strict deadlines but VERY lenient ahead of time- ex. only paper was assigned 2.5 mo in advance. Only need 10 iclicker cred. and 5/9 in-class assignments for full attendance. Extra credit+no final+4 exams+2 makeup exams that grade-replace a past exam if your score improved. Engaging lectures; fair amounts of HW

Very entertaining lecturer. Attendance is mandatory in order to get full credit. A lot of homework and it piles on fast, but if you keep up you will be fine. Take advantage of every extra credit opportunity you get; it took my grade from a B to a A+. However, not very accessible.

I took this class as a freshmen due to it being a major requirement. John's personality is extremely vibrant. I like how in his lectures sometimes it's mostly him talking and other times it is us watching videos. I will say there is a lot of homework, deadlines come extremely fast, so it is really easy to fall behind. You need to really keep up
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Super easy class, learned a lot. Bickford is super kind and understanding. Love him. There's lots of options for assignments but you don't have to do all of them, 4/8 in class reaction papers, 2/6 individual papers, 1/4 grp projects. Exams are multiple choice, no final, 2 makeup exams that replace EITHER OR BOTH worse prev. exams.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Bickford is an amazing professor. He is hilarious and engaging, and explains the concepts in depth during lectures. He doesn't give finals for Psych 100, but rather 4 non-cumulative tests which you can use notesheets for which is great. I would highly recommend taking Psych 100 with him.

Professor Bickford is a nice guy but this class if you are not interested in psychology is extremely boring. The exams are kinda difficult if you do not fully understand the concepts but you are allowed a two page reference sheet every exam so you should be fine if you put enough information. But overall a very easy class tons of extra credit.

John is such an amazing professor. The lectures are always interesting and he always cracks some good jokes. Each exam can have a double-sided cheat sheet and there's no final. It's an easy class to get through and it's so much fun. If you're taking psych 100, take it with John.

John is a great professor. I think his style of teaching is incredibly good and his lectures are interactive and interesting. In Psych 100 there is a 6-page paper you have to write, but he informs you of it the FIRST week of classes so you have more than enough time to do it. Overall I have learned a lot from this class, and I would take it again.
Awesome teacher

Hilarious guy I love him. Lectures are actually interesting and fun. Attendance not always mandatory but heavily recommended and take notes if you wanna do good on exams. He gives so many extra credit opportunities and make-up exams if you don't do good. Lots of textbook reading but not too bad. 10/10 would reccomend esp if you're a psych major!!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Great professor who takes the time to teach students the curriculum while making it fun.

If you want to take psych 100, take it with this professor. He was funny and passionate, this class was overall my favorite. Makeup exams were offered if you aren't satisfied with your grade, he lets you bring a cheat sheet in to every exam. Not too many homework assignments.

Iclicker heavy course. Really easy, there's only one big paper but it's pretty easy. There's 5 reaction papers that are graded in class and 10 iclicker questions. 4 exams and he allows a cheat sheet. SONA credits are necessary. All work is on Connect.

Prof Bickford is such a great guy! There were 4 exams, and for every exam, you could bring whatever notes you wanted (besides the book) as long as they were printed out. He got the grades back for exams in like 3 hours tops and there are also makeup exams if you want to improve your grades. He's overall a funny, nice guy and his class is so easy!!!

super interesting class when he teaches it, tons of extra credit through iclicker, unlimited open notes for exams. don't buy the textbook there's a pdf online, make sure you read the chapters and take notes on the definitions for the exams because some of them will be on there even if it's not on the study guide
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Prof Bickford does not care about the wellbeing of his students and is extremely rude. He does not allow extensions for any reason, does not understand accommodations, and does not respond to any emails ever. If you can, take psych 100 with Tammy instead.

No weekly homework, multiple opportunities to do assignments throughout the semester. Usually you will need to do 2/6 or 4/8 of a class requirement, so if something comes up you will always have another chance to make it up. Open note exams, lectures are good but not always interesting. he's funny

John is one of those teachers who could talk for hours if they were allowed to but he is such a caring and funny guy. He understands that learning is about being engaged and not about being assigned busy work. Such a great lecturer and person
love his lectures. he is very engaging. exams are open notes and has makeup exams throughout the semester to improve grades if needed. this class is very easy and interesting! highly recommend

This class is just great, Bickford is amazing. Exams are open notes, make-up exams allow grades to be improved.  Every now and then there are "reaction papers" which are pretty much class participation grades. A couple of individual writing assignments. Just take this class!
amazing and entertaining, rating should be a 5.0 no question. Psych 100 is great if you need and extra course

I was shocked by Bickfords 3.9 rating. He is the best Professor I've taken here. Makeup exams, easy-to-follow lectures, and real-world examples that he uses are helpful. Not to mention, he gets you the exams back in ONLY a few hours. Now, if you want to see a professor that deserves the 3's, it would be Brian Lickel.

Bickford is an amazing guy. I've taken him for multiple years throughout my 4 years at UMass. He cares so so much about his students, taking time to compliment them before giving feedback or furthering the conversation. Any class you can take with him is a good time.
total jerk easy class
Professor Bickford was so funny and made lectures so interesting. He was very understanding, open note exams and the perfect amount of work

John is such an icon! His lectures were always engaging, and his accent and personality made it extra entertaining. You can miss a lot of assignments and it won't count against your grade. Exams are easy and you are allowed a cheat sheet for each one. As long as you put in a little bit of effort, you should do fine in this class. Take this course!

Great professor. His lectures are entertaining. 4 exams no final and you can bring a cheat sheet. Go over book for topics but some questions weren't on exam review. Either way, this class is an easy A and makes it very very interesting. He sounds like Bill Burr which is a plus. 5 page paper wasn't bad, just make sure you get 4 different topics in.

I had Bickford for psych100 and it was awesome. He was so funny and made the lectures super interesting. There are four non-cumulative exams and one paper. The exams are all multiple choice and he lets you have a cheat sheet. Overall, Bickford is the best professor I've had. I loved this class and would recommend it to anyone.

Truly this man is one of the best professors I've ever had. For PSYCH 391LB, it's discussion-based, and the only assignments are eight separate Reaction Papers, due at various points throughout the semester. All you have to do is show up, participate, do the RPs, and you're set. I always looked forward to this class this past semester.

Great class!! Not only is he funny but exams are open note and the textbook is available online for free! four exams, ( 2 makeup exams are implemented to improve grades) only need to complete 2 out of 3 projects, four out of 6 hw assignments, and four out of eight in-class writings. Multiple opportunities for extra credit
great class

He's a great lecturer and offers a two page cheat sheet on every test. There's no final. Of all his assignments you're allowed to miss a certain number which is helpful. IClicker is needed. Read the textbook as he includes questions on the tests that aren't on the study guide. He does everything to get you to succeed, you just have to put in work.

Professor Bickford was one of my favorite professors ever. He truly cares about teaching and does so in a way that makes sense. The class can seem scary at first but after you get into the groove, it's as easy as a college course can be. The material is super engaging and you can apply your learning in the 1 course self-analysis paper.

Professor Bickford made his lectures enjoyable due to his humor and engagement with students. There are four in person exams that are a big portion of your grade, but you get a full size paper cheat sheet and there are makeup exams as well. Homework is very easy, would definitely recommend taking psych 100 with him!
He allows retakes on exams and offers many opportunities to redeem/help grades

Best professor ever!! Bickford is hilarious and entertaining during lectures. You will need to take lots of notes but you do get a cheat sheet for each exam which are very helpful. There isn't a ton of work assigned considering you only have to do 2/3 of the textbook work. There is also no final for this course! Easiest A ever:)

Professor Bickford is awesome! He presents material in a relatable and relevant way. He's funny, his lectures and projects are fun. The class structure creative/applicable, it's NOT read, digest, regurgitate. The tests are the same, take good notes and be ready to apply what you've learned.

Now, I took this class because I was mislead by a lot of students on ratemyprofessor that this was the EASIEST CLASS. NOW, it's only easy of you ACTUALLY LIKE SCIENCE. I hate science and thought this would talk about how people act and why they act that way but it was all axons and dendrons. If you are NOT science inclines forget this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Lots of homework

reviews.comment: I loved Bickford! His attendance wasn't mandatory but over the course of the semester he'd do little reaction papers that only people attending class could do, they were worth like 10% of your grade. I attended almost every lecture because he was so passionate about what he talked about. Exams/papers had clear outlines and were easy if you studied!

I have taken two of Bickford's classes and I can honestly say that he is one of my favorite professors! He is super kind and funny & makes his 75-minute lectures engaging. You can skim the readings from the textbook and be fine! He allows you to bring in a cheat sheet for exams and there's no final. Highly recommend taking this class.

Professor Bickford is great. He is hilarious and by far one of my favorite professors. His lectures are really interesting and easy to understand. His tests are also really easy and all open note. Highly recommend taking any courses with him as I loved being in his class.

Favorite professor. Actually makes you interested in what he is teaching. There are tests but you can bring a one page cheat sheet. Uses I clicker and in class assignments to take attendance but not everyday. Homework is all online and can be completed quickly.

Professor Bickford was probably the best professor I've ever had in UMass. Had pysch 100 & 360 with him, got 2 As. Put some effort in coursework and you get good grade. Prof. Bickford allows a cheat sheet for each exam, so it shouldnt be a big problem to get 90%+ in exams. Very easy to communicate with, trust me he wants you to enjoy the course.

Literally the best professor I have ever had at UMass. He was the reason I declared a minor in psych, as I took this class for a gen ed my junior year. He is hysterical, very easy to follow, gives a bunch of extra credit, and the homework and tests are pretty straightforward. I will be taking another class with him in the fall.
such an easy gen ed, if you put in minimal effort you will do well. the exam averages are like B's but I have gotten over a 100 on all of them bc he scales
Fun and chill psych class. Open note for psych 100 and 360 (the ones I have taken). Funny guy with clear grading requirements. I would recommend this class.

I love John he's my favorite professor this semester by far. Super easy gen ed, super understanding, you can miss up to a third of homework assignments, no final, and can use cheat sheets on the four exams. He's hilarious and keeps the class engaged. You can tell he really cares about his students too. 10/10 recommend

One of the most easiest classes you can take. You will get an A as long as you do the bare minimum. He has a clear grading criteria and gives you a lot of opportunities to make up any work you had missed or didn't do too well on. Exams were very straight forward but sometimes wasn't in the lectures. He has make-up exams if you didn't do well.

Professor Bickford is easily the best professor I've had. He cares about his students and truly wants them to pass. He has clear grading criteria and chances to make up poor grades. You definitely have to read the book for tests, but you're also allowed a note sheet. Easy A if you put in the effort.

very funny guy, keeps students engaged during class. material is interesting. one essay for the whole semester. we did have online hw weekly & a lot of tests but he gave opportunities for a makeup exam to do better. cares for his students. not really accessible after class, his assistant and TAs are.

Such a great professor. There's a lot of outside work that he doesn't remind you of often, but if you keep track of deadlines you'll be fine since they're all short. There's one long paper but it's not hard to do and you have the entire semester. You get cheat sheets for exams and there's makeup exams too. Would take again in a heartbeat!

Great professor. If you go to class and pay attention you'll be fine. A lot of busy work but gotta do it because it makes your grade. Exams are fine, one paper for the whole semester that is totally doable if you plan ahead.

I abosolutely love Bickford. He is so funny. His lectures can drag every once in a while, but he switches things up with videos and in-class one page activities. Total of 4 exams, all of which you can use a cheat sheet for. There's one big paper, but it is pretty simple. He also gives lot of opportunities for extra credit.
Professor Bickford was my favorite prof this semester. Hilarious lectures, so lenient, easy work. There is a lot of reading but the homework is merely completion-based. 10/10 would recommend.

Such a kind-hearted guy, really just wants you to do well and understands things like testing anxiety. His lectures kind of drag on when he goes off topic but they are helpful. Read the textbook before exams and take detailed notes. Lots of grades other than exams. Learning modules aren't bad, he includes engaging activities in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Professor Bickford is easily my favorite professor. As long as you go to lectures the tests will be really straightforward, and they're open note so just pay attention in class. A few assignments throughout the semester but they're really not bad at all. He's really funny and just overall a caring guy, I definitely recommend taking his classes.

Easy A or A- as long as you do all the work. You only need to go to half of the classes to get full credit. LOTS of extra credit :). However, you NEED to do at least half of the assignments which he will not remind you to do and are not extendable. HW assignments can be 4ish a week but are short and easy. Exams not too hard and lecturesengaging
He is literally the best professor. The homework is literally just completion and some other things. There is a lot of work but it's not hard. I will definitely try to take him again

Bickford is the best, especially in Psych 391ZZ. He's very down to earth, reasonable, and if you participate, you'll be fine. He assigns reaction papers to the readings, which just means you can rant about what you think of them. One of the best professors I've had at UMass.

Great guy, funny and lively each class. Homework's simple but you can have up to 3 assignments per week so it's important to keep track of deadlines. Exams are pretty simple and there are plenty of chances for you to make up bad exam/homework/other assignment grades. Doesn't expect a lot out of his students and understands we have other classes.
He's good!

If you get the chance to take a class with Bickford, do it! I have had him for two classes now: Psych 100 and 370. He is engaging, funny, and gives realistic examples to help you understand the material. He provides so many opportunities to make up exams or complete extra credit. Bickford genuinely cares about your success. Take this class!

Prof. Bickford is a really great guy. I enjoyed the class and I found the material to be pretty interesting. Each lecture discusses a different personality theorist. There is quite a bit of writing (4/6 2-page papers, one 4-5 page paper and another 4-5 page paper (or you can make a collage) and 4 exams. He offers a lot of extra credit!

He is such a good professor. I love him. He is so funny, the exams are based on lectures and not that difficult, there are so many extra credit options, he tells stories that relate to the content, and you only have to do 4/6 essays. The essays are actually fun because they're about you and your personality or your friends. Such an interesting clas
Really interesting class, and he wants students to succeed

Super great class, super great professor. There is a lot of assignments, but they're all really easy. His lectures are funny and informative, all test answers can be found in the textbook or in his lectures. You can't turn in anything late, but you get told about everything in advance and can miss some without penalty, very reasonable.
The best professor I have ever learned from. Bickford cares about his students, gives hilarious lectures, and wants to help you. I wish I could take his class again and again.

If you're looking for an easy class with very little workload, this is the class/professor for you. The textbook is online and the answers to the homework, tests, and quizzes are all on quizlet. His pre-recorded lecture videos are all on youtube and aren't mandatory. Just make sure you turn everything in on time because there's no second chances

! Good/Bad depending on which of his classes you take. Had him my first semester of freshmen year. What a blast. Lecture heavy and make sure to show up because there are many opportunities for extra credit. Funny with great fashion choices. There is a lot of work involved, but it is all so interesting that it is worth the time to get the easy A.
Prof Bickford's lectures are really engaging and easy to follow and the workload is not too bad. Highly recommend taking this class if you're interested in psych or looking for a good gen ed

It's an easy gened if you're taking classes online. I didn't go to lectures and I learned nothing, but I got a good grade and had an easy time during this online semester, which is really all I was looking for.

Dr. Bickford is awesome, you definitely have to put the work in but he gives you a certain amount of assignments that you can miss with no penalty and without providing an excuse. Only one 5 page paper that is assigned 9 weeks in advance with clear guidelines. Exams(4) are very reasonable, not too difficult or too easy. No final. Great person too!

John Bickford is one of the best professors at UMass and he really cares about his students. Gives many chances for extra credit as well as easy/creative assignments. An enjoyable and non stressful class. If you have a chance to take a class with him definitely take it!

I really liked this class, there are 4 exams and no final and he gives opportunities for extra credit, pretty easy A. John is a funny professor and makes the lectures enjoyable, I highly recommend taking this class.

I only put in an hour of work a week. The big paper that was the most work out of all our assignments? It was 4% of our grade. I literally just didn't do it and my letter grade didn't change. There is so much leeway in this class, ex. you only need to do 10/15 SmartBook assignments (which are graded for completion). Easy class. And open book exams.
Jb was rad
Very funny and entertaining. Super personable even though this course was online. He was a very casual dude.

I absolutely love this professor and only wish I heard about him sooner as I am now done with school. He is caring, hilarious, makes the lectures interesting, and assigns really fun stuff, without it being too easy. He makes the material so fun to learn. A REAL gem, I respect him a lot.
Great professor, very engaging and an awesome guy

Professor Bickford is seriously the best professor I've ever had. Not only does he teach in a way that allows students to genuinely understand the material, he also makes his lectures fun and entertaining so you can't help but pay attention. If you have the chance to take Psych100, or any other class, with professor Bickford, do it.

Prof Bickford was great! For this class, he told you exactly what you needed to know for exams. Exams were clear and not confusing. He also drops a few assignments which was so helpful. Prof. Bickford was also my internship sponsor and he was extremely accommodating with that as well.
Great professor, especially for an introductory class. He made the material engaging and it was never a drag to go to lecture. The class had four exams and allowed a cheat sheet.

This class is insanely easy and is almost difficult to get a bad grade in. The exams are pretty straightforward and are taken with cheatsheets, the 3 total papers are quick and easy to write, and the class itself is pretty actually interesting. Professor Bickford is an absolute OG and makes this class amazing. Just try to show up for inclass credit
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Easy assignments and exams. Cheatsheet to use on exam makes it an easy A. Great guy and lecturer. Cares for your grade and gives you lots of extra credit opportunities. Textbook is helpful when making exam cheatsheet but wouldn't say you need it for anything else. Engaging lectures twice a week. No sections. Homeworks easy and insightful.

John is the best professor I have ever had in my college career since being at UMass. He does make-up exams which can only help your grade. Homework is online which is in the textbook, but is easy to do. During the pandemic, there was a 5-6 paper due, but he gave students 100 & waived the paper so it wasn't required to do. Do the sona extra credit.
Wouldn't want to take psychology with anyone else

One of the best professors I've ever had. You don't need me to tell you, just read his other reviews, but he truly cares students and wants them to get an A in his class (even though literally every professor says that) and he gives you so many chances to boost your grade either by makeups or extra credit assignments. His tests are open note too!!!
Funny guy

Prof. Bickord is by far the best professor that I have had so far. He cares about each and every one of his students. He is the sweetest and most caring professor ever. Definitely take a class with him if you have the opportunity to. He makes his classes enjoyable and easy to learn. Tests are open notes. His outfits are also dope.

Bickford was the best professor I have had at UMass. He makes it easy to do well grade-wise while being engaged in the course material. If you have a chance to take any class with Bickford, please do!!
He is genuinely such a funny professor. His lectures are never boring and the hour and fifteen minutes will go by so quickly. I highly recommend taking his class. Great guy and great TA's.
Awesome class, Bickford is an amazing teacher! Would take it again if I could. Lots of extra credit, lecture heavy, but notes are posted so you can access them
My Favorite class my freshman year! His lectures are hilarious and the material was interesting. Lots of extra credit, I would recommend taking it

Take psych 360 with John Bickford. Psych major or not, take his class. It was interesting, rewarding, engaging without being frustrating or discouraging, it's like the opposite of a weed-out class. He makes learning easy but effective, and is very encouraging. He offers lots of opportunities for extra credit, too.

I love this man. I had him for psych 100 and knew I had to take his classes again if I got the chance. For psych 100, you get a page (front and back) to write notes on. For psych 360 its ALL open notes, you have to be missing brain cells to fail. His lectures lean on the more boring side but he is so charismatic you cant help but love the guy

Great for PSYCH 100! Always has extra credit options. Attendance is sometimes mandatory so do not miss too many classes and buy iclicker! This class uses a very easy online textbook and that is what the homeworks and quizzes are taken on. Only 1 or 2 actual papers required in person I forget. He also allows cheat sheets for tests .. double sided!!

John Bickford is SUCH a great professor. He makes his lectures fun and interesting and is so easy with grading - he drops your lowest scores on in-class writing assignments and gives you the opportunity to miss a few iClickers if you're not in class. He knows his stuff and always wears great outfits! Lets you have cheat sheets on exams.

Professor Bickford was a great teacher and he offers a full page cheat sheet for every exam as well as opportunity to retake any exam no questions asked. His class is layed out to not accept any late assignments however, he only counts your best 4 assignments out of the 8 he would assign! Take this class, you wont regret it.

Bick was a great guy and great professor. Made the class interesting, yet the homework/quizzes were set up for you to learn and do well. Allowed to have one-page cheat sheet on test- He wants his students to succeed.

He is a very kind, sympathetic, and hilarious professor who explains things very well and makes sure that all the grades that go into the system and all of the assignments are very reasonable and he is open to talking about any issues that may happen. One of the best professors I've ever had

Professor Bickford is the most empathetic, kind, and funny prof ever. He schedules exams to be the weeks before midterm/final week so that you don't have to worry about his class on top of everything else. The class is very easy but I always attend class anyway because he's awesome. I've taken 3 classes with him and wish I could take more.

Great guy. He explains things very well and often gets into his personal experiences which is pretty cool. His assignments are cake, he has make-up exams (takes your better score) and you get to use your notes, doesn't believe in finals, and half of his assignments are optional. He also gives A TON of extra credit (peep syllabus ��)

Homework may feel like too much work at times, but that is the easiest wayto study for his exams. He allows cheat sheets for all exams and makeup exams. Lots of different things factor into grade, with some important categories. In class is random attendance (part of grade). Fun lecturer and really enthusiastic about student success
Best teacher for Psych 100!

This is my second class with Prof. Bickford and I can say, without a doubt, that he is my favorite professor that I've had here. You can tell he cares about having his students succeed and actually take something away from the material assigned. The course load is a little heavy, yes, but is still a quality class that you can take and use in life.

Legitimately one of my favorite profs at UMass. He's so funny, tells relatable stories from his childhood, and is visibly passionate about the subject matter. He's very approachable, so if you wanted to chat with him about studies, grading, etc. he had no problem taking time to speak with students. Such a wonderful man

Very tough class to do poorly in. John is a great lecturer and gives ample opportunity for extra credit. Even if you are not a strong test taker, you're likely to do well in this course if you stay engaged.

Lectures were funny and interesting as well as interactive. Homework was very clear and was all through an online textbook/ interactive learning system. Tests were fair and reasonable and matched up with the study guides. Best professor I've had here highly recommend

Bickford has been my favorite professor at Umass so far. There was never a lecture I was not laughing in. Exams are open note and pretty straightforward as long as you pay attention in class and take notes.

I would take every class with him! He gives you a monster syllabus at the beginning that clearly defines his expectations and following them nets an A. Constantly gives extra credit opportunities and exams are simple double-sided cheat sheet to the exam. Lectures are standout and funny; you have to go for reaction paper + iClicker credit.

Bickford is the man. This class was pretty easy with 4 open note exams, two individual papers, one group paper and a few participation papers. If you look at the study guides before the exam you're fine. Attendance only natters for the participation papers (you can miss 2 out of 7)

Bickford is one of the most respected and amazing professors you are ever going to have for psychology. He is a very understanding man and approachable. You can literally pass without much of an effort. Don't miss those reaction papers though!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Easy grader on papers, many chances to get extra credit, allows a cheat sheet on exams. Class is easy but engaging, and Prof Bickford really cares about his students! I'd take every class with him if I could. Also textbook is free online if you google it.

Make sure you get John if you're taking Psych 100. His lectures are engaging - while his speaking seems dry at first, he frequently sprinkles in ridiculous analogies and wicked jokes without changing his tone of voice. There's a lot of leeway with missing assignments and you get 2 chances for each exam. It'd be hard not to get an A in this course.

Easy and fun class, very discussion oriented. Don't take this class unless you are genuinely interested in the subject matter and open to talking about it. John is accessible and the TAs are helpful too. Assignments are straightforward. I got so much out of this class, genuinely life changing.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Bickford is the best to take PSYCH 100 with. If you do all the required assignments you will get an A. There are also opportunities to get extra credit and he allows a cheat sheet for the exams!!
Great seminar class with lots of interesting discussion. John leads it well but also knows when to back off and let the students take over.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: I liked everything but Bickford in my opinion was weirdly hard to talk to, he seemed to have an attitude or be uncomfortable by direct conversation after class. Other than that great class, I loved the way he lectured it was funny and also informative. SO MANY oppurtunities to get an A or a good grade. Woud recommend to take this class again.

Amazing professor. Gives you tons of free passes to miss stuff or drop a bad grade. Lectures were always interesting and the material stuck. Exams were open note but even without looking at notes, straightforward and easy. Tons of extra credit. Hard not to get an A in this class- it's literally set up so that you can get a good grade very easily

Lots of papers (4 2-3 page papers, 2 3-5 page papers), but are about interesting topics. 4 exams, but they are open note with two makeup exams. Try to take notes in class if you can, because there is not much on the slides he posts. Excessive opportunities for extra credit. Try to keep track of time because there are either papers or exams weekly!
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--SO MANY PAPERS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: John Bickford is a very fun and funny professor. 4 exams (all open note) and a couple projects he offers two make ups just incase. LOTS of opportunities for extra credit. Hes an awesome guy however I found the tests to be the downfall. You would think "Open note?? easy A!" but you aren't given too much time to do the exam making me feel rushed.

Great guy that wants all of his students to do well. There is an online homework assignment due everyday that you have class but they do not take long, 30 minutes at most and help boost your grade. Gives plenty of opportunities for extra credit. Overall great class 10/10 would recommend.

Bickford is my favorite professor in the psych department. If you do the assignments and give it a reasonable try you'll get a good grade. Take notes, because his tests are open note, so good notes from lectures will pretty much get you a good grade. His also a good lecturer, his lectures aren't boring at all.

This class is by far one of the easiest classes I have ever taken. Tests are open note, you're graded on a lot of things, and the assignments are not bad. He just wants to see everyone succeed. I love this man

I don't understand how some people are honestly complaining that the class was too easy? Do you know how dumb ya'll sound? The man is funny, the content is interesting, and you have to be the biggest bum on the planet to not pass this class! It's like you idiots want to drown in homework and stress over exams

Easy class. He gives you so many extra credit opportunities and allows cheat sheets/open notebooks for all exams. The assignments are short and easy and are mostly opinion based. I never bought the textbook and did fine on all the tests (4 in total with 2 optional makeup exams). Bickford is funny and tries to make the lectures interesting.

Open note exams, clear criteria for assignments, if you do the study guide and pay attention in class (and do the assignments) its very easy to get an A. He's funny, wants you to pass, and provides lots of opportunities to complete work at the students convenience. The projects are fairly fun too if you like being creative
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: The pop quizzes are really just opinions to questions he asks. You can only miss two, but if you miss more it's not that big of a deal. All lectures are posted so there's almost no need to go to class. The only thing to pay attention to are the studies he talks about, there are a lot of questions about them on exams so make sure you know them.

This was the easiest class I have ever taken. The professor wants you to enjoy the class so he purposely makes it easy. You can literally use your notes on the exams. There's no final, either. You have to try to fail this class.

The material is easy and his lectures are great and entertaining. Its almost impossible to not get an a in this class because he's so lenient and there is so much extra credit. You can have a cheat sheet on tests too, so you don't really have to study. I actually learned a lot in this class.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Bickford is one of the worst professors I've had during my 4 years at UMass. Busy work is the only work and tests are open note, so it's an easy A. However, Bickford is uninspiring and disorganized and rambles on and on during lecture. Pop quiz things that count as attendance are the only way he can get anyone to go to class. Pathetic.

Professor Bickford really cares about making his classes enjoyable for his students. He understands the stress students are under, and he really just cares about teaching on topics he loves. Highly recommend taking any course you can with him. Cheat sheets for tests, allows room to miss a few homeworks & iclicker sessions, no final.

Professor Bickford is the sweetest man ever. He has all the tests as open note, so you get to bring a cheat sheet plus all your notes from class. In addition to that, he has sporadic reaction papers which counts toward attendance since they're done during class. Plus you have an extra credit opportunity to do SONA studies for another 18 points

Bickford has very boring lectures- Class is mandatory but no one shows up- HOWEVER there are 8 "pop quizzes" that ask you to react to a video you watch in class- you can miss up to 3. Exams are difficult because of how much is on each exam BUT there is a cheat sheet (front and back typed) Homework about 2x a week - takes around 40 min v easy

Bickford is a really nice guy, it is VERY hard to get a bad grade because he grades fairly and your grade is based on a lot of different things, including extra credit. Lectures can drag but he really tries to make it interesting. Not necessary to go to every class to learn but he does have iClicker and little assignments so it's safe to show up
Really great professor, easy class

This class was an easy A. There was a lot of homework but he dropped a lot of low grades. There were a TON of extra credit opportunities and you could basically bring up your grade by half a letter if you did them. The lectures were general while the test were very specific but if you read the online textbook you were fine. One exam was dropped.

He is a super nice guy but he tends to ramble on in lecture. I love the content covered in this course but I think it could be presented in another way. He teaches very general and then tests very specific. I did not purchase the text book but I think if I did, the readings would be very helpful and I would learn more in his class.
He is an amazing professor I am taking two more classes with him next semester!

If you need to take Psych 100, take Bickford's class. Compared to my friends in other sections, I didn't have to do much studying at all. You can EASILY get an A if you do the minimum amount of work he requires-- which is not a lot. Lectures are relatively entertaining. Online text is easy and straightforward (and free).

If you read the textbook and take notes, you won't have to go to class and you'll be fine. He lets you have as many notes as you want for the exams. There is extra credit if you participate in psych studies in the psych lab on campus.

Prof. Bickford is a solid choice for a psych professor. He is very lenient with extra credit and doesn't usually assign a lot of homework. His tests are open note but even then they're not very hard. He really cares about his students and is very engaging throughout class. You don't need the text book much; just show up, do the HW and you'll pass.
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--EXTRA CREDIT--Would take again

reviews.comment: Honestly there is no reason to fail this class. There are so many opportunities for extra credit, his lectures are very lively, and only a certain amount of assignments need to be fulfilled. Come to lecture for iclicker and reflection papers, but there is a certain amount you can hit before you stop. Double sided cheat sheets & makeup exams!!

If you need to fulfill a gen ed and want an easy A take this class. Bickford is a great professor. Not a lot of homework, and you only need to do a certain amount of reaction papers and iclicker questions. He allows double sided cheat sheets for every exam which makes the class a lot easier.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures--Would take again

reviews.comment: Bickford's classes are all amazing. Tests are all multiple choice and open note. If you don't do well on an exam, you'll have the option to make it up. There are a lot of assignments (in class and out), but none of them are too difficult, and as long as you follow all the guidelines (especially length), you'll get full credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: AMAZING. FANTASTIC. WONDERFUL. I LOVE HIM. AMAZING CLASS. 10/10, WOULD TAKE AGAIN.
4 Exams allowed with a cheat sheet each. Homework is pretty easy and the lectures are interesting. Go to class for i clickers and response questions, they aren't hard.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: I attended less than half of the classes all semester and still got a B+. 4 tests are worth 50% of your grade, but he lets you have a cheat sheet so it's not too bad. Also extra credit opportunities. Definitely recommend this course as a gen ed/grade booster.

If you tend to procrastinate, don't take this class. He has a zero late work policy (even if it's due to illness, injury, etc.) and tells students not to email him in the case of personal matters. I got 95%+ on every exam and barely managed an A due to missing assignments when I was sick. Not a bad guy but still, something to keep in mind!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Professor Bickford makes it very easy to succeed.  The material is interesting and you have plenty of opportunities to earn a good grade.  Definitely recommend any class with Bickford

I would totally recommend this class. Psych 360 has by far been my favorite class ever. John Bickford's lectures are entertaining and the material is actually really interesting too. Make sure you go to class. You have 4 exams, 2 makeup exams,  3 papers, 6 randomly assigned in-class reaction papers, and tons of extra credit with the psych studies.

This class was an easy A & Bickford is a great professor too. He makes it clear how he will grade and allows for a lot missing class in the syllabus (e.g., assigning 12 reaction papers in class but only grades the top 8 so you're able to miss 4). His exams are also very fair and he allows you to have a double sided cheat sheet. Lots of extra credit

Bickford is a great guy! He makes it very clear how you'll be graded and gives you all the materials you need to do well. Lectures are a little dry sometimes, but you have to go for the reaction papers that are unannounced. The exams and writing assignments are very straightforward.

He's so great! 4 exams and no final, can use a double sided cheat sheet for all of them (which can even be typed. If you need to take Psych 100 DEFINITELY take it with him. He's funny during lecture and takes time to really explain the concepts.

He's by far my favorites psych professor here at umass. He has this cheat sheet policy where you can bring a 2 sided sheet of paper with you to each test. This helps a ton. Also he does a make up test policy where he will replace 2 of your lowest test grades with the 2 make up test grades so long as you did better. He's a fabulous teacher. So funny

Great teacher and easy class. You have retakes AND CHEATSHEETS! Took PSYCH100 with him and he's amazing and so I decided to take 360 with him. Would recommend and take another class with him. So much extra credit-- dont forget to to the "secret" question in the syllabus!!!!

Professor Bickford is a very straightforward guy. There were four exams, with the option of two make up exams to replace poor grades on the other exams, and all the exams were open note. As long as you fill out the study guide and have some idea of what's happening, you'll do fine.
Awesome professor, makes the class super interesting and fun. Tests are open note and gives plenty of extra credit. Two easy papers and one group project
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: He likes to perform experiments that include the whole class every time, which helps prove the topic and give you something to remember.

Have accommodations through disability services? He doesn't care. Large class, always had to sit on the floor even during exams. He teaches a lot of students and has a lot of classes so he's hard to get in contact with and really doesn't want to be contacted, so you're on your own. A lot of work required outside of class, but the books online.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Bickford is really a nice guy. His criteria and expectations are very clear. Class is not mandatory, but you are "graded" on how often you go. For example, he gives iClicker polls and reaction papers every once in a while, but you're allowed to miss a bunch of them (and of homework assignments) with no penalty. So many opportunities to get an A

Prof. Bickford is really nice and sweet, but lectures are boring. He skipped over important sections and wasted time on easy ones. But there are 4 open-note tests, and lots of easy and genuinely interesting homework assignments. There are extra credit opps on exams, bonus questions, and research studies. You will learn but only if you read!
Bickford can be kind of dry, but overall he's a nice guy. He gives cheat sheets on his exams so you can't go wrong with him. You do have to read the textbook to do well on his exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: John Bickford is the best psych professor at UMass. He's such a nice and funny guy and he really cares about his students and their learning. Tests are open note and theres no final because he doesn't believe in test anxiety. A lot of short 2-3 page papers but they are interesting and simple. Definitely a really good class and professor.
He makes it super easy for you to pass this class, easy A. Sometimes the lectures are a little dry but you don't need to go to all of them to pass.

Honestly the easiest psych class you can take at this school. You get a double-sided cheat sheet for every exam. There's no final. There's two makeup exams, and all exams are in class. Lots of SONA extra credit. Easy homework. Attendance counts though; he uses iClicker and reaction papers to check if you're there. He's also really nice and funny.

This  was by far the easiest class I've ever taken. Participation is "required" but he only checks by using the iClicker to answer questions in class and you only need to do a certain number of these to still get a 100 in this area. Same thing goes for in class responses and homework. He also lets you use a cheat sheet on every exam!

He was by far the best teacher my freshman year. He gave out free points, had easy homework, ad was overall a straightforward grader. Tests were easy and the assignments had much leniency to them. If you missed one or two assignments of a certain category, he would drop them. The exams had a double sided note sheet which made the class hard to fail
He is an awesome guy and makes the class fun an interesting. There is a good amount of homework but it is all easy. He gives a ton of extra credit too. Good gen ed.

He's an intelligent, reasonable, and caring professor. He gives TONS of extra credits and a lot of his policies show how much he cares about his students. He really wants you to do well in his class. It's a very big class because there are like 500 students in each section so it will be less personal though.

Random Iclickers, so go to class. You have homework every week or so and it can take a while. 4 tests with 2 make ups. A TON of extra credit opportunities. Overall, take this class it's very easy but expect a lot of reading and homework.

Professor Bickford is hilarious. He is also very clear when teaching material. He assigns a lot of homework, but they are so easy. There are 4 exams which he allows cheat sheets for and a final 5-page self-analysis paper. Go to class and you'll definitely earn an A.

Easy. Do all the work and you will get an A. I woke up on the morning of the final exam not knowing that there would be an exam, and by copying down enough info to my cheat sheet I got a 95. In other words, this class is easy as long as you do the assignments and perform well on exams. However, he is somewhat unresponsive to emails.

He's a good professor, easy to understand and concise. As long as you pass in your work on time and give adequate effort you'll get an A. Tests are easy because you get your notes, papers and projects are easy and 3-4 pages max. Dont buy the book.
Awesome professor, easy class. Just study and you'll get an A.

Interesting class. Tests are easy, unlimited open notes as long as you typed or wrote them yourself. Grading on homeworks and in class assignments a little tough. But would take again as its an easy high grade

Very easy A. Lectures are usually entertaining, attendance is semi mandatory - there are iclicker and reaction papers but only half of them count. You get cheat sheets and there's one easy paper at the end that requires no research. There's no final. Definitely would recommend

He is always giving students opportunities to get extra points if they do poorly.  He allows you to retake tests and offers extra credit points. Only have one paper and a total of three tests. He is funny and makes the class interesting. Iclickers and reaction papers count for points.
