Such an easy class! You have to try to not get an A. He lets you have cheat sheets and you can retake exams. Seriously would recommend. You should attend class because there are iclicker questions and reflection papers but it's interesting and worth it.

Prof Bickford is the BEST psych teacher there is. He made me want to declare a psychology minor! His lectures can be a bit long, but some classes you just watch videos which breaks up the lectures. His grading criteria is really straight forward, and he wants you to do well in his class.  He offers extra credit and lets you use cheatsheets!TAKE IT!

Bickford is a great professor who makes the subject pretty interesting. He shows videos and uses studies to give examples for the subjects we are learning. The best thing about this course is the amount of extra credit he gives, which can bring your grade up a lot at the end if you take advantage of it. Lots of reading the textbook.
Explains topics well, gives very detail syllabus and expectations, four exam, two make-up exams, no final. Textbook provided for free

Professor Bickford is a great guy and he knows what he's talking about. His lectures can be long and boring but the exams are exactly like the lecture slides. He assigns a lot of online homework due weekly and the assignments are time consuming but incredibly easy. Pay attention and do the homework. Lots of extra credit at the end of the semester.

There's 4 midterms and he allows one 2 sided cheat sheet on each one. The class has makeup exams and he allows students to miss a couple of classes and assignments. The class requires ALOT of reading and  tests are tough.

This class was pretty easy although there is only homework which is long but easy. You get a cheatsheet on the test, which if you type your notes you can fit all of them on it. Extra credit is a plus. There is also a 5 page paper that isn't too difficult. There are in class clicker questions which are random & graded for participation + writing.

I LOVED his class. Even if you aren't interested in psychology, this is still an awesome class to take. He's very funny and makes everything easy to understand. Sometimes the lectures are long but as long as you do the homework you'll understand everything he's talking about. He gives a lot of extra credit and you get a cheat sheet on every test

Easy class. He gives you 6 short papers, but you only have to do 4. There are 3 longer papers, and you only have to do 2. easy grader. There are 4 tests, and you have the chance to retake 2 of them for a better grade and they are open-note (make very detailed notes though- questions are mostly from the book, not the lectures)  easy psych elective
Tests arnt the worst if you prepare well

Prof. Bickford is very laid back and a really good professor. His lectures are very thorough and he lets you have a cheat sheet on every exam AND there's no final! One essay due the whole semester that's very easy and he is very lenient about letting you miss things. I really loved Prof. Bickford and would definitely take one of his classes again.
Great guy, really funny.

Easiest class ever; just do the readings and you will ace it. Online homework based and the tests are simple if you read. Only one project all semester. The lectures may not be the most exciting but I'll take it. Go to class- there are reaction papers
Great professor, knows his psychology very well, extremely enthusiastic about the topic, can be unclear at times but never usually an issue

Awesome class. 4 exams and 2 make ups (to drop your lowest two scores). He is an accepting person and wants everyone to feel good about themselves, my impression at least. I have had him now for Social Psych and Personality and his grading criteria ranges so don't think one bad grade will mess you up! He wants students to succeed.
Funny guy, really makes the class interesting. Gives lots of leeway on assignments.

I loved this class. Tests were open note (take notes from the textbook) and the lowest one was dropped (no final or midterm). Assignments were super easy as long as you read the instructions and followed them. Grading was very lose and based heavily on your own opinions. Bickford is a great teacher. If you put in a little effort you will get an A.

Really nice guy by the class is PAINFUL.  Powerpoints are ridiculously boring - half the time he reads right from them and the other half I have no idea what he's talking about.  Tests were too hard for the quality of lecture... 4 shorter papers, 3 projects and surprise in class reaction papers.  Wasn't the absolute worst ever but not enjoyable...

I absolutely love Professor Bickford's teaching style and class policies. He really cares about his students and wants them to do well. He is understanding and chooses the highest grades for grading and has makeup tests that everyone can take. I not only did really well in this class but I also learned a lot.

Open note exams, and he gives a study guide that practically has every topic he will ask a question on.  Take notes on every detail and concept he talks about in class, and aside from the small homeworks, I never studied for ANY of his exams and the lowest I got was a 94.  Easy A, and somewhat interesting.

Easy A if you put in the effort & do the extra credit.  Great guy.  One 5 page paper, 4 tests, can retake tests.  If you took AP Psych in high school this class is a breeze.  Textbook is freeonline. Homework can be time consuming, but do them all early and you'll be fine it's not bad. random mandatory attendance through random iclicker questions

Bickford is a great professor, he is very clear in what he expects in the work you turn in to him. However, his tests can sometimes be the more difficult part of the course depending on the material covered, but overall they are not too bad.
Love Bickford, pay attention in class and do the essays and you'll get an A

He's a great professor! Took this class as a freshman, thought I was going to be out of place but it was an easy A. Doesn't require much reading. Papers are short and mostly reflections, so you don't have to do research. You can put in minimal effort and still get an A. All the tests are open note. Just copy down highlighted words from the book.

Bickford's class was amazing. He is a really great professor and he makes going to class fun and interesting. There was a lot of homework in this class, but it was really easy and definitely manageable. Everyone should try to take a class with Bickford at least once before graduating.

So many online homework assignments, the class was interesting & he put PP online. The online assignments were easy but do take up a good chunk of time. The tests were sort of difficult, but he let you bring a cheat sheet to every test, one 8 12 x 11 piece of paper, front and back, and you could literally fit everything on that piece of paper.
He's a really great professor who has MANY ways to get extra credit. You'd have to actively try to fail this course.

Show up to class, he had participation papers every so often which will help your grade. TA's grade most of your work and they rarely give you full credit. Extra credit thorough SONA. Most boring class I've ever taken, no one pays attention because the exams are open note. When you look across the lecture hall everyone is on their phones and comps.

Bickford was a great teacher (especially if you have taken Psych before). He was clear in what he said and used slides and posted them online. He allowed cheat sheets during exams and does not believe in midterms or finals. He gives an exam that covers the past two exams and it replaces your grade (if it is higher).

He is a very cool guy and is very patient students. I genuinely like him as a person for his smart and chill humor. If you are going to take Psych 100, don't hesitate to take it with him if you want a cool guy.

You can either go to the class and pay attention and skip the textbook, or read the textbook and skip the lecture. Both is overkill. There are a lot of online assignments but they're quick and easy. Can get a ton of extra credit through participating in research studies.

lectures can be boring because he reads directly off of his powerpoint slides which are put online. 4 exams that are all open note, two optional makeups if you dont like your first grade. must do 5 of the 7 in class assignments, 2 of the 6 personal papers (2-4 double spaced), and 1 group project. possible to earn up to 18 extra points EASY A

This guy is the man. His class is very relaxing and easy which makes for a good learning environment. As long as you study before hand and attend most of the lectures, you will be fine! Plus, he is helpful in showing examples and explaining the material.

Bickford made his lectures fairly easy to understand and used funny, relatable examples. I loved this course and if you miss an assignment here and there you'll be okay! Cheat sheets are allowed for exams, and your highest grades are selected for homework grades! Go to class; it will only benefit you!

Bickford is a really nice teacher and tries to keep the lectures interesting. Very lenient with grading, allows an ample amount of missed assignments. Attendance is important if the material is new to you, he puts his powerpoints online but they are very vague skeleton notes of the actual lecture. Homework done in online textbook, no physical book.
Awesome prof

He cares about his students as well as the subjects he teaches, and gives you numerous opportunities to do well. As long as you put effort in, you will do well in his class. open notecheat sheet exams, no quizzes, response papers and a few other assignments as well as iclicker. If you do poorly in his class, it's your own fault.

Bickford is great. Lectures can be a little boring but he tries to make the best of it. 4 exams, all open-note, no final and option to make up 2 exams for better grade. Couple of easy essays required. Would recommend.

Bickford is great. Lectures can be a little boring but he tries to make the best of it. 4 exams, all open-note, no final and option to make up 2 exams for better grade. A few minor essays required. Definitely not a stressful class

Bickford is great! He truly wants the best for his students. One of my favorite professors at UMass, be in as many classes as you can with him. It is nice to be in a small class with him because you really get to know him, which is nice in a large schoollarge major.

Bickford is hilarious and really wants you to do well. Bring your iClicker and reaction papers every day, and always do your online assignments on time -- he drops your worst grades on them anyways. Do the make up exams, too... even if you just score a few points better, it will improve your final grade by a lot.

His classes are pieces of cake, but don't expect to get A wo doing anything. He's clear, funny and wants his students to succeed. Cheat sheet for exams, but I'd recommend reading the book and study from it. In-class RPs and some assignments, which aren't hard. I'd recommend him, esp. for Psych 100 and non-majors who want an easy GenEdelective.

I've taken Psych 100 and 360 with him. He is incredibly sweet and very understanding. As everyone has said, there are four tests and two make ups and the two make ups can replace tests grades. The one thing I recommend is going to class. The reaction papers he assigns come out of nowhere and if you miss them, you can't make them up.

This is probably one of the easiest classes in the psych department. There are 4 exams and 2 make-ups that are all open-notes. He requires you to do 7 in class assignments that you'll get credit for if you complete them and there are a few very minor papers. If you take this class you can prioritize others over it.

He sets up the syllabus so clear cut, its easy to get 100% in the class if you really want. SO many options for extra credit and his lectures are pretty entertaining and informative for such large classes.  But he isn't very involved in the class, topics, or the students

He's a cool professor. Exams are open note - read the textbook though, there's stuff on exams that he doesn't mention in class. 2 makeup exams to replace your lower exam grades. In-class assignments make attendance mandatory, but they're easy. 2 personal explorations (papers) and 1 group project (paper) but they're really easy.

I took this class and PSYCH370 with Bickford and he is a great teacher. He tries as hard as he can to keep everyone engaged. Tests were open notes. There were some mandatory papers but they were mostly opinion-based. Will get an "A" in his class if you 1) show up to class 2) take good notes 3) utilize the study guide and extra credit
As long as you stay on top of your work, you'll do just dandy
Open note exams . Really sweet guy. Have to buy a textbook but it''s not that bad  Would suggest taking this  Interesting material

Class is pretty boring but you have to go to do the reaction papers. You are allowed to bring notes to the exams but the exam questions are confusing.. I'm not sure where he gets them from. He is a nice and funny professor, but not great at explaining the material.
Pretty easy class! Go to class for the reaction papers and iclicker questions.  Lots of extra credit opportunities and cheats sheets on the exams!

He doesn't care about course material and makes no effort to make it interesting. Nothing on his slides are on the exams, I don't even know where the exam questions come from actually. In addition, the exams are hard despite the cheat sheet. I dreaded going to class.

He's a great professor, lets you use a cheat sheet on your tests so it's difficult to get a bad grade. He's human, he has his off days, so he isn't always working at 100%, but otherwise he's a good teacher. This is my second time having him as a professor, and he's got great spirit. I would definitely recommend him!

I took Bickford's Psych 100 class in Fall 2013 and lemme tell you, I was relieved when I saw that he was teaching Psych 360 for Fall 2014. BEST PROF AT UMASS HANDS DOWN. Cheat sheets, easy tests, assignments clearly laid out for the semester. However, the work may pile up IF you don't have good time management skills cuz it creeps up on you quick

Take this class! This class was by far much easier than half of the classes I took in high school. You are allowed a full cheat sheet front and back for exams. You should go to lecture because of reaction papers, but he's lenient on attendance and assignments (you can miss a couple). Bickford is also funny and pretty chill.
Professor Bickford really just wants his students to do well.

Lectures are straight forward but he doesn't do a great job elaborating to really drive in the concepts. Only used the book to look up terms for exams. Four open notes exams, random in class writing assignments and a couple projects. Overall a very manageable class with high opportunity to get a good grade.

I thought this class was very corrupt. The online hw is ridiculous and does not help you prepare for tests. He only teaches about 30% of what would be on the test and the rest you just have to know from the book. Also he doesn't help and makes the Ta's do all his work they seem to not know what's going on either. Please find a different professor!

Relateable, sensitive to student diversity, approachable, friendly, sense of humor, laid back, yet passionate about his material. Allows notes for tests! TAs also very helpful! Had him for social psyche and psyche of the LGB experience (seminar). DO IT.

Awesome class! Bickford is a awesme guy. you should go to class. Spontaneous in class assignments. He goes slow enough so you can take notes and makes the class laugh. All homework assignment are online, & are through a online text book. You are allowed a cheat sheet for the exams (4 of them &no final only a paper).
Words cannot explain how easy this course is. He lets you take cheat sheets into the exams…buff said

my favorite professor here at umass! all tests are open notes, lots of extra credit, and he cancels classes when appropriate (around holidays) I'm taking another class taught by him just because he is a great teacher and its easy to get an A

hes awesome! I thought this class would bore me to death but it was a class I really looked forward to because of his energy and stories to go along with the material. id recommend his psych101 to anyone.
He's so much fun!! He is very entertaining and really makes the class interesting and engaging despite it being a huge lecture! i would recommend this class in  a second!

AWESOME! He is such a nice guy and truly cares about his students. He makes everything in class easy to understand. You'd have to try to not do well in this class. I'm taking a class next semester just because he's teaching it. Don't buy the book, you don't need it.

Super nice guy who wants students to do well. His tests are all open note so make sure you have thorough notes. He does reaction papers a few times for attendance and iclicker for extra credit. The papers he assigns are super easy and easy to BS. I did all of mine an hour before class and got As or Bs.

He is a very easy teacher. He is funny and makes going to class more tolerable. He lets you use a cheat sheet on tests and even gives two make up tests in case you did bad or missed a test. He really knows what he is talking about.

He's a great professor. Genuinely knows and loves the material he's teaching. All tests are open note, and he has a makeup test every 2 exams. Puts all his slides online, but going to class helps solidify the information. Overall, pretty easy class, interesting stuff, and a fun professor.

He's a very enthusiastic professor, and he knows what he's talking about. The material is really interesting, and the in-class writing assignments can be kind of fun. I took personality psych online and it was extremely easy with bickford. The TA was a way harder grader than he actually was which sucked but it all worked out in the end.
Cool guy

Bickford is fun and engaging. Tons of extra credit, four exams with two optional makeups that substitute your lowest grade. One term paper about a "problem" you have. I-clicker part of grade. Random in class reaction papers so you do to have to go to most classes. Tests are open note. Multiple papers, all pretty easy to do well. A few extra credit opportunities. He really wants students to do well. He's a super nice guy and the course material is interesting too! Overall, recommend!

Super easy professor. attend class and take notes, and you're practically guaranteed an A on every test, as the tests are open note and 95% from lecture. Multiple papers, all easy A's. I clicker and sona extra credit opportunities, as well as 2 test makeup options make it nearly impossible not to get an A in this class. Plus, he's an awesome guy.
Great professor. Easy A if you go to class, take notes and study for tests. Cheat sheet helps a ton! Loved this class.

LOVE this teacher.  Genuinely interested in helping you learn. Class Attendence isn't mandatory. Have to write a couple papers but you get to choose between a variety of topics and they are fairly easy. Open note tests. 4 exams, no final. Would definitely recommend.
Awesome professor, one of my favorites. Go to class and do the studyguides and you'll do fine. Bickford is great!
Pretty good professor. Take good notes from the lectures and look at the book before the exams and you will do just fine. I recommend him.

Don't buy the book. Basically write down all the notes and go to the class before the exam, he reads some things right off of the exam. All tests are open note. Go to class for the in-class writings and iClickers for EC. He's funny and engaging, you have to really not care to do poorly in this class. Great guy.

This class covers many very interesting topics. Exams are all open note and there are 2 make ups if you do poorly on any of the exams. Grading is very fair, but going to class is really only necessary because of the in class assignments. Most of the learning happened for me by reading the book...overall this is a very manageable course..easy A
Attendance was not mandatory though reaction papers and clicker quizzes in class made it necessary to attend.

Bickford is one of the easiest professors I had this semester. He's lectures are interesting & fun and he posts them on Moodle (for you slackers). Online quiz every week - easy. Full page front&back cheat sheet for tests. He is laid back & explains things very well. Take his class!! He is also funny & makes the material more interesting. Easy class

I didnt like this class or the professor at all. He didnt have control over the class and I couldnt hear sometimes because people wouldnt be quiet. I would study hard for the tests even though it was open note and I still had a hard time understanding material on tests. He didnt cover most of material on tests. And he cancelled classes alot.

Easy A class. He allows you to bring a paper to the test and write whatever you want on it. I found the lectures to be interesting, he does a good job of explaining concepts. Online learning modules due every friday were easy and usually took 30 minutes max. write out the review sheets before the tests and this class should be no problem at all

I had him for psych 360 and 370 and I have loved these classes. He's a very entertaining, sometimes funny teacher and his grades are very fair. It helps to go to class but missing a few won't hurt. Open-note tests, many assignments but they aren't hard and it's easy to get a good grade if you just do what's asked. I recommend highly recommend him!

Go to class and read the book and you'll do well! It's as simple as that. There are 4 exams, each only took me 20 minutes to finish. I loved this class! Professor was very respectful and understanding of people's varying schedules and workloads. No final. Easy exams. If you read the book and go to class, you will do fine.
easy class. mostly everything on the exams was covered in class, and he really tried hard to get you to get the material. i did so well then he asked me to TA psych 100 for him! and it was great :)

JB is my all-time favorite professor. He really helped me realized what I wanted to do with my major. Great class, really fair, extremely respectful. Read the book, attempt the work and JB will see the honest effort. He’s easy to talk to and doesn't judge so if you need help ASK!
If you read the book thoroughly, you'll pass the class. Going to class really isn't necessary besides random in-class assignments.

A lazy, boring and unhelpful professor who gives 4 unfair open note tests and 2 make up tests. You'd think open note tests would be easy, but really they're just ridiculous. He asks you terms you've never learned about. Only use the book, his lecture notes are pointless and unhelpful. Avoid taking this class with him, I didn't learn anything at all

Bickford is great guy. If you want an easy A or B take SOCIAL PSYCH 360. Exams are all OPEN NOTE. You can literally bring in the powerpoint presentations. He also has TWO makeup exams that can replace exams you did poorly on. Final is OPTIONAL. Really easy homework! Take this class with him!

Really need the book. The book has about 10X more material than  he teaches. Alot of different graded assignments. Don't really have to go to class, but he does random in class assignments that really affect your grade. You need to read the text book and take good notes because his tests are open note. Bickford seems like a cool guy as a person, but I'm not sure if I would recommend him as a professor. Lectures are boring and online modules are pointless.

I wouldnt say its an easy class, but its not a hard one either.. He doesn't teach a thing in lectures, and to do well on the exams you have to read tons of pages in the book. Bickford is the most mediocre professor I've had. His lectures are extremely boring and unimaginative! It's like he's reading directly from a textbook. There's module on spark due every thursday,some reading but only 8 questions. 4 tests with a 1page cheat sheet. He provides two make up tests where you can also bring a cheat sheet. Bickford is awesome, but his lectures are dull. Easy to get good grades because exams are open-note and notes are unlimited. You can also take makeups to get better grades. There are writing assignments, but they aren't hard. As long as you have an opinion and seem like you put some effort in, you'll get a good grade.

I really like bickford. personality was an easy topic to understand.  if you go to class youll understand all the material much easier.  there were some in class stuff you had to do too. and the projects were really easy. could take make up tests to get a beter grade.  really interesting guy. good lecturer
Bickford is literally the best prof in the world. Hands down. This class is an easy A and also fun! Love him so much. He really is a joy.

Bickford is an awesome professor I definitely recommend him for Psych100. He is fair and not out to get you. As long as you keep up with your work, which really isn't too hard, it's an easy A. Overall I loved his class

There's no reason to not get an A. There are easy extra credit opportunities. You have to attend lecture because he gives out random PRS and reaction papers. You're better off reading the material. Easy A. Plenty of opportunities to bring your grade up between extra credit PRS, reaction papers, a term paper, and multiple choice exams. He does use PRS and he does surprise reaction papers to make you attend lectures. Also, read the book before exams and you're guaranteed a good grade.

His lecture is so stretched out and unbearably boring. You don't learn any concepts you wouldn't have already known - you just learn the names of them. Very nice professor, but you don't retain anything (open note exams). He comes to class seemingly stoned and makes pot jokes and loses his "train of though" a lot. He gives you a chance to get a good grade, but if you need to learn, maybe structure your own study group.

This class is very easy but I didn't feel like I learned anything. All the tests are open notes and it's just vocab taken from the bolded words in the book. Very nice guy though, he really wants to help his students as much as possible.

Pretty interesting guy but not too helpful. Grade is 4 tests and you get a cheat sheet for each one. EASY. You get a cheat sheet for every exam. So there is no way to do bad if you put in the effort. And there are make up exams.   Lecture Is boring, fell asleep every day but you need to go to class PrS and reaction papers

Pretty awesome prof. Tells some pretty funny jokes to break up the dullness of the class. You can make a 2-sided cheat sheet for the exams, so its not too difficult to get a high grade, and for my class, he didnt give a final (just a joke two page paper). Good intro level course/gen ed
Pretty awesome teacher. Class was pretty easy. He lets you use any notes you have taken, handwritten or typed. There's no reason to do good in this class. Bearable for an 8am class.

This class was pointless. I learned absolutely nothing from him or this class but I still got an A. Material has the potential of being interesting but he literally makes this class so dull. Great teacher overall.

This professor makes due with what he has. He is faced with hundreds of university students at 8am and he has learned to put up with chatter, extreme tardiness, students falling asleep, etc. He makes it worthwhile and he gives you an easy opportunity for an A.

Loved this class. Professor is funny and makes the class fly by. He really wants people to succeed, generous with extra credit points, do-able projects. Good spacing with assignment due dates and class time is used well. Browse the text and go to review sessions.

I personally really liked this professor and class.  The material is pretty interesting and the tests are open book, which is really nice. I am going to take 3

Pretty easy for a 300 level class. Have to read a lot but the exams are open note so type out all the definitions while you are reading. Bickford is funny. Easy A.
this class was pretty cool.  I aced every test and when I emailed the professor he responded so quick.  Deifnitely my fave class of first seminar

Easy class. You have to go to class because of random PRS and reaction papers. Powerpoints are posted on Spark. You can use a double sided sheet for the tests. Not challenging info. Easiest psych class compared to any other professors

This is the easiest class i have ever taken. EVER! you will get an A.  and the teacher is awesome. very funny guy. I loved this class, it was very interesting. THere is SOOSO many extra credit options that it is hard not to get an 100% in the class.

I love this professor. He's funny and has a way of explaining things so that anyone can understand them. Although there is not much to explain in psych 100, he still manages to make it interesting. It's an easy A if you go to most classes

So cute & funny! really enjoyed his lectures & did well with minimum effort. Took this class as a requisite for major & never thought much of the subject but his lectures made me think that psychology is not just fluff, he made some sense. Recommended!

Three 50 minute periods a week M, W, F. Mondays were just for videos (credit for coming), exams, makeups. Makes his own weird grade scale but easy and lots of extra credit. Sometimes dry sometimes interesting. You can miss a lot of stuff, but come for reaction papers and PRS and credit. Slides are online and the book has everything you need. gened.

class was so interesting. lecture attendance is not mandatory, but reccommended. random reaction papers are due out of nowhere in class. exams are done with a cheat sheet of notes that he allows you to refer to a guide of what will be on the test. research extra credit helpful. interesting class, easy gened. really learned in the class. :]

He was honestly THE WORST professor I have EVER had. He can't teach. If I had taken his class as a freshman psych major I would have switched majors and even considered transfering to another school. I don't know why he is still part of the UMASS staff.

Social Psychology is one of the best, most useful, classes that I have ever taken in my 2 years at UMASS but I did not take it with Bickford. Why? Cause the class I did take with him(370) was AWFUL! Leave it to Bickford to make an interesting subject terrible. I think this guy has problems. Go somewhere else. I thought that Butz was very good.

John is a pretty cool guy, but not a particularly effective lecturer. Don't buy the book. Lectures are really difficult to get through, mostly because the material itself is boring. Requires in class reaction papers as well as a lot of project work/short papers. If you're not interested in social psych, avoid this class.

I suppose if you are majoring in Psych that you should take this class but be warned that it's really dry. It wasn't at all what I thought it was going to be. Also, this professor is very moody. One day he's friendly and the next he's sarcastic. If you have to take it then go to every class and write pristine papers. Also, study the textbook.

Pumped for psych before.I hate it nowReads directly from paper No help when responds to emails. Have to buy this CPS remote which costs $24 plus 15 to register.Only uses it like 7 times. No other classes uses itExams incl. everything in the book and lecture and i mean EVERYTHING. Had to try really hard to get an A-. I regret ever taking this class.

BICKFORD IS AMAZING. I don't understand how anyone could do poorly. Test questions are based on definitions and studies. Sit in the front of the class if you want to get anything out of it, stupid freshmen sit in the back and talk on their cell phones. Hes enthusiastic and makes the subject fun. Class is not an easy A but its worth the effort.

His class was interesting, but he would often go on too long in talking about an example of a concept. He doesn't require attendance, but he does require in-class reaction papers... so you might as well go. He offers a lot of chances for extra credit, and the tests were open notes. I thought the tests were perfectly reasonable.

Please note the distinctions made between Psych 100 and 370. I did not have Bickford for Psych 100 but did take his Personality class(370). It's awful and I don't recommend it. He's moody and the class is boring. Also, the test questions are difficult in that you don't know what he's asking you. Class averages were in the lower 80s.

If you need everything spoonfed to you, don't take this class. But, if you are mature enough to be able to handle reading outside of class, Bickford is great professor who elaborates and makes it interesting. Lots movies and opportunites for extra credit. Nice guy who wants students to do well, but requires reading.
What are these people talking about?? This is an easy class,so many opportunitiest for extra credit!!! Bickford is the man!

OK, here's the deal.To get an A you need to get no more than 40 pts off the 601 total. Test averages were in the upper 70s so there goes your A. He has extra credit pts but they didn't help me(7 total). There are SONA extra pts but you now need to be asked to participate and I guess I did all experiments last semester and so couldn't get any extra.

Class is extremely boring, hard to stay awake. He reads right off powerpoint slides, and they are online. Only reason I went to class was to get CPS credit and Reaction Papers in class. Reaction paper grades are poor and the exams are ridiculous and difficult. Nothing learned in class, take with a different teacher.

I don't recommend this class at all. He doesn't give you back your tests or go over whats on them. Lectures seem useless but you have to go so that you don't miss reaction papers. No one listens to him. I sit in the back and watch as everyone watches movies or does something else while he's talking.(Yes, it's that bad) Boring and aggravating.

I looked forward to this class and it wasn't what I thought it would be. Papers are not judged harshly but there are a lot of them. Test questions are hard to understand and cryptic. Plus you don't receive your tests back so you can't even see what you got wrong. I wasn't impressed at all with this class and I feel like I worked for nothing

I don't recommend this class at all. It's boring and disappointing. Tests are hard, I don't know what previous reviewers are talking about. I talked with the Professor himself and he told me they were challenging and that averages were in the upper 70s and lower 80s. Lectures are useless and material is very dry. I hope to manage an A- but barely.

It isn't too hard to get a good grade, but his class is annoying. You have to come to class for reaction papers, but the lecture material is useless, as the exams are almost entirely book-based. He also has the tendency to be condescending.

Pretty good teacher. Lectures are very boring but attendance is necessary because he randomly assigns reflection papers in class that make up a significant portion of your grade and can't be made up. All tests allow open notes, but are still not a layup. 3 Take home papers throughout semester is only homework, but graded easily. I reccomend it

he is a good teacher.. very nice.  in class reaction papers and cps questions are easy grade boosters. online quizes are very easy. tests are ok. cheat sheet allowed. offers extra credit for participation in psych research tests

Prof. Bickford's classes are easy IF YOU DO THE WORK. Some people assume that in college you don't have to attend lecture or read. Well, in Bickford's classes you must do both to do well. My only complaint is that his classes are huge, so it is easy to get distracted or bored. Trust me, I took two of his classes and I was a TA.

This class is OK. I was looking forward to this course but now I'm  really disappointed that I took it. Why you ask? Well, it's long and boring, the professor is OK but the tests are not easy. Some of the questions are hard to understand. He even admitted to it. Every time I turn around I have a test or I have to write a 5 page paper. Whatever.

This guy shouldn't be teaching. When he makes tests, he pulls them out of his ass. I thought it would be an easy A. I took this class as a GPA booster, but ended up bringing it down. Avoid this useless cow. You can read the text but most of them time, you get Bs and Cs on the exam. Cheat Sheets are useless. You won't have time to look at those.

Great teacher; he was VERY reasonable (dropping low test scores, etc.) and fair usage of CPS. He reviews the assigned text reading in class, so if you either attend class or read, you'll do fine on the exams.

i LOVED this class. Bickford is awesome and his lectures are actually interesting. There are four multiple choice open note tests and four 1000word papers (only need to do three). He allows extra credit too. All the powerpoints he uses are posted online. I would ABSOLUTELY take this class.

Veryy easy class! wouldn't say its the most interesting but if you're looking for an easy A here it is. You have a chance to replace the grade on your first 2 exams by taking a makeup. All the tests are open note and theres extra credit..If you're looking for an interesting class it's not for you but if you're looking for an easyne this is def it!
If you don't like Bickford, there's something wrong with you.
I thought he was a good teacher. If you read the book and attend class then the exams are really not that hard!

i went into the class excited to learn and i ended up hating the class. Hes sooo boring and does not seem to care about teaching. His exams are all multiple choice and not bad if you read the book and have a good cheat sheet. Class wasnt too hard but hes not a good teacher. i recommend taking it with another professor. NOT JOHN
Lots of ways to do well in this class. Make-up exams, reaction papers, and psych studies can all boost your grade. kinda boring but okay class.

Do not take him for intro; he kinda hates teaching the class, and it shows. However, I also just had him for personality, which was much, much better; he's actually a very good teacher when he cares about the subject matter at hand. By the end of the semester, I really liked the guy; he does care about his students doing well. Just avoid intro.

As you can see in previous comments- READ THE BOOK. There is an overabundance of material to cover.  Bickford knows that, and allows the use of a cheat sheet on the tests (which are also very Difficult).  Do Homeworks ahead of time, and show up for class. I didn't get above a 78 on his tests but still got a B. Just show up for class and do homework

3 WORDS:READ THE BOOK. Mr Bickford is a cool cat. He tends to get frustrated easily, especially when the entire lecture hall lacks focus. He'll throw a little tantrum but its funny. The class is cool though and you do alot of activities during class. Its fairly easy. I found myself applying it to daily life. I recommend it. Attendance is mandatory!
read your book. and you will ace. dont bother with notes..you wont read them if you're like me. hes moody..so dont talk during class..cheatsheets dont really help..JUST READ. but take it! not bad

Not a bad class. However in order to do well all you need to do is  read the book. Therefore going to class was pretty much a waste of time. Most of his lectures didnt correspond to the material on the test. Not a hard class to get a B in.
he's a good guy, not a great teacher, but all his tests are open book and every exam has a make-up exam. soo not a bad class, just boring
He knows his stuff, but sometimes you can tell he was bored with the material which made everyone else really bored.

Good teacher. Tests are kind of hard, but you if you read the book, you should be fine. He's really fair, cheat sheets were allowed in my section. As long as you show up to class, do the CPS sessions, fill in the Reaction papers, easy B.

As a teacher, he's alirght. Kind of boring but he gets the point across. But class is really easy, you don't even need to take notes because he lets you make a cheat sheet for exams and you always have the option of a retake. Just show up for attendence and reaction papers and you've got an A.
He basically lectures straight out of the book, and succeeded at boring me with my favorite subject. Also, he is one of the rudest most condescending teachers I have ever had.

He is rude and unflexible.  I haven't learned anything in lecture, we have open-book tests which me and everyone I've talked to STILL do poorly on.  Mostly in the 50's and 60's range.  I am not a bad student, he is the worst teacher I've ever had at UMass.  HANDS DOWN.

I actually really liked professor bickford as a teacher  social psych was really interesting and his tests were very far make sure to do the reading/go to class and you'll get a good grade   I can see how intro with him would be boring he isnt always the most exciting and intro is kinda boring on its own anyways  good professor tho
He is a great teacher, but his lectures are so boring. I actually fell asleep between nervous systems and brain work. I wouldn't recommend him for anyone.
No Comments
No Comments

You learn a lot. But, it seemed like he cramed the whole book into 4 months. It was hard to do, but he did it. Sometimes it seemed as if he didn't know what he was talking about, he would be looking at his notes. There was a lot of extra credit oppurtunities. He also let everyone use cheat sheets for the exams.
Worst professor i've ever had. he obviously hates his job and won't admit to his mistakes, his lectures are more boring than watching water boil. He made me hate psychology.

Even though I did well in the class I would never reccomend Bickford as a teacher.  You can tell he doesn't want to be teaching, and he HATES when you ask him questions or e-mail him.  All in all, he isn't a nice guy, good teacher, or interesting to listen to. Avoid him if you can.

I did not find the class enjoyable, Professor Bickford was extremely condescending and not a pleasant person to talk to about grades, or any other sort of problems in class. I don't recommend a Psychology class with him.

the class is pretty straight forward as far as expectations and grades but he doesn't make it very interesting and the class can get pretty boring.  the tests are pretty much only from the book, but there are required in class activities.
Bickford is the man. Don't down this guy. SO easy, just read the text book and go to class. The book is really easy and especially clear. Good class. Take it.
No Comments

I'm not one to argue with teachers, but he defined something wrong and I couldn't find his definition anywhere else. When I pointed it out, he refused to admit his mistake and got furious at me for being "pretentious and condescending." At least now I will always remember what delusions of reference really are!

Personally I think he is the worst professor ever. He made psychology awful for me and I am a psych major. I think he should consider a def field in psychology besides teaching. I would NEVER take another course taught by him everrrr!

bickford can get kind of boring. but its the material that is more important. his lectures are very organized and his CPS are easy. the exams are hard because people don't read and study enough. the class itself is easy. and bickford is a decent professor. he tends to like to end class early. one of the easy gen eds there is to take.

such an idiot, he can't keep control of his class because nobody respects him as a teacher. he merely read off his powerpoints and it was apparent that he just didn't know his stuff enough to talk about it freely, powerpoints should only be there to help your point. he came off as a little full of himself too. not my favorite teacher obviously

Best teacher ever. I loved his class, and loved him. My friend and I made it a priority to go to his class because it was fun, even if we were learning. And talking about the Id and Poo parties is quality.

pretty boring lecture, notes are not hepful, exams are really hard. he uses pyramid method with exams, however, which is a plus. not too hard for a gen ed, as long as you keep up with readings and online assignments. plenty of xtra credit... sometimes he makes jokes and they arent that funny, but he tries. hes a good guy, but not helpful
Very boring, but the class is also very easy. Lots of online work, and tons of extra credit stuff. Not a great choice for a gen ed, but you could do a lot worse.

I would recommend taking this class with another teacher. His lectures are boring, but mandatory due to unannounced in class assignments. He doesn't like answering questions, he uses his TA's for all the "dirty work". Questions on the exam can be tricky, and more based on the readings than the notes. You can't sell back the expensive book either.

The guy can be generous with extra credit work, his tests arent too bad, but he doesnt like to help anyone. He'll either send you to a TA or he'll just get annoyed with you. If you are taking it for an easy gen ed, be prepared to have to go to class, no attendance but a lot of your grade is based on cps and reaction papers you have to do in class

Bickford could care less about his students and his exams do not correspond at all with his lectures, which we all have to go to bc/ of CPS ( you must purchase the devise then pay another fee to activate it ).
I thought this class was going to be easy...but I didn't know Bickford was going to be a hard ass.  Other people told me they got As easily in pysch but not me.  Boring class. Notes are not helpful.

The notes are all online, but you have to go to class because he uses CPS and has Reaction papers. Lectures are boring; The tests are pretty easy if you read the book, going to class is kind of pointless except for the CPS and reaction papers
Terrible.  He isn't helpful, gives wicked hard tests without any cheatsheats or anything...Definitely thought that psych 100 was going to be easy! Take it with another teacher.
He is TERRIBLE, all he does it put up notes straight from the book which you could easily find yourself. He doesent like the students and gets mad when you ask for help. he just reads to us. BORING!!

Worst professor I've ever had. He refuses to help people. There were several occassions on which he would simply say "That's not my job, ask a TA". He never seemed prepared. Lectures were just definitions read out of the book. He's a jerk too. Very rude, obnoxious at times. The only positive note is that his class was incredibly easy.
he didn't make the class interesting at all, but it was easy because we could use notecards for the tests
Awful teacher.  He can't teach.  Classes are boring and the is a lot of reading.  Tests are hard.

Everything is pretty much in the book but he lets you use cheat sheets and scales everything. Lots of extra credit points. You watch a lot of movies and he tells you whats on the exams although they can be tricky. Good teacher though, I liked him!

I decided to take the class pass/fail, thinking it would be super easy, but he's horrible at teaching and never comes prepared to class. He does scale tests and lets you use cheat sheets, but thats just because he's doesnt teach us enough so that we can do well on a test.
boring

Adol. Psych. -Nothing he said seemed to be relevant to the material that was in the text and on the test. The tests were online and asked random things. He seemed like he didn't want to be there + let us out 15 minutes early. I pointed out a flaw on a test and he said it was fine and that points from bonus questions would probably cover that.

He was really good with this class. He scaled one test by 20 points, let us use cheats sheets on the tests, and he made the term paper and final optional extra credit to try and help people out.  You have to look at the book to do well, but the tests arent too complicated once you do.  This class is really straightforward and worth taking.
Truly the worst teacher I've had at this school. Lectures are mind-numbing and he seems to be personally annoyed by student questions. Save yourself the trouble and don't take anything with him.

bickford is a huge ****. huge. he gets offended over EVERYTHING. if you're really interested in this subject, don't take this class. he doesn't teach, you have to read/teach yourself the entire textbook. don't do it man!!

Awful class, easy, but i didnt learn a thing, lectures were pointless and 90% of the online exam was from text book. avoid taking this class if your intrested inb psych. take it only if you want an some easy credits

this class sucks. Bickford is a lazy, and rude teacher and doesn't seem to care about his students. Hes not at all flexible with grading, and most of the time its a waste to go to class. The only good thing about this class is the Online exams, but who learns anything from that? Don't count on taking anything away from having him as a teacher.

Horrible class. Prof obviously would rather not be teaching. He runs a lecture hall like a small discussion so you have to listen to all the same people speak repeatedly. The lectures are irrelevant and highly difficult to remember. The exams are easy, but the boring class makes attendance the most difficult component.

interesting, and VERY easy. bickford is nice, and gets mad just as any prof. 5 tests online, if you do half the readings and go to most classes, and take the notes he puts up on slides, you'll be fine.  tests have a 24 hr. window so you can choose time to take it. Open Book and notebook tests. you can use all resources. EASY CLASS, EASY A. TAKE IT

he knows what he's talking about and he wants all of his students to do well in his class. he provides a very fair amount extra credit as well. yeah, lectures aren't exciting, but not other many lectures are! sometimes he may seem a little irritated with people asking him redundant questions. he's puts plenty of effort into his teaching.
This class is awful! He is a rude & nasty professor!! He is unclear, unhelpful, and his class is extremely boring & unorganized! Never ever take personality psych 370 w/this professor!!!!!

I feel bad for this guy. He's incredibly easy (OPEN BOOK tests online + TONS of x-credit)and ppl still complain?  WE'RE IN COLLEGE, what do you expect? I go to class periodically, I don't always read ontime (but I finish least once before exams) but I always manage an A on tests. Bottom line: You either work hard and get an A, or you don't, period

****- WOW.  His lectures suck, but the class is easy as hell.  All the exams are online...  ONLINE.  And those are the only grades.  Take it if you're good at never going to class and reading to learn.

Rediculouslly easy. Basically an online class although he is starting to throw in stuff from his lectures on the test so watch out. I never went to class and got a B+. All you do is take online tests. Gives lots of extra credit. A piece of cake.
He seemed to talk down to the class and when he was asked to explain something in more clarity he would just repeat himself.

When I took the class, I found it rather straightfoward. I took the exams online...sometimes he seemed to get annoyed when students asked him a lot of stuff, but he seems to want all of his students to do well. He gives extra credit, too.
Nice guy and cares how you do in his class... I got a B+ even though I was failing most of my exams!!! even though he does early classes take it I promise you'll still do good!

Mostly teaches out of the book (yawn), but has started to occasionally add in new material, which is always on the test. He has a bad attitude: when he said something wrong in class, I wrote it down that way in my notes. I got the question wrong on the test, but he refused to give back the points.
No Comments

Amazing teacher. Test are all online, Final is optional. You don't have to go to class, but I did and was constantly learning. He is so nice, probably one of the sweetest teachers that teach here. Def. take him, if you have a chance.

AWFUL professor, just gives away A's and makes the class ridiculously easy because he can't teach for his life. I needed to actually learn one thing in this class and I often had to correct him on his errors while presenting information.

He is the nicest guy. All of his test are online and are open book. You don't even have to go to the lectures. He is constantly giving out extra-credit. His final is optional. He is very funny. Very easy A. I never went to one class and did fine.

Had a bit of an attitude, but everything is done over the net, so you dont have to deal with him, just come to lectures. 4 tests all open book, open notebook open everything...online, with a 40 hour window, so you can choose whens best to take it. Material is rather broad, but gives a good intro.

This class was ridiculous, he was never prepared, never did any demonstrations, didn't clarify anything, he was unsure of his own material...he even asked STUDENTS what chapter something was in.  Seriously DON'T take this class unless you want to be annoyed.  You will get an A though, regardless.
Worst professor ever!
Very easy.  Automatic A, Almost impossible to fail.  You'd ahve to want too.  Also seemed to have a certain fixation on one area.  People who take the class know what i'm talking about

he is a good guy,teaches well,gives interesting lectures,shows good material. easy class when you do reading. he is trying hard to make it student friendly too bad people gave him hard time. if you do the reading and attend class,you will easily get an A.
Class was run over the internet. VERRRY easy A.  No need to attend class.  The professor was very rude though.  Told students he didn't have time to answer questions?!!?

Easy class, HORRIBLE teacher. He was rude to students when they emailed or asked questions in class. He changed the syllabus COMPLETELY by the end of the semester. I was really looking forward to this class, and he ruined it. Good for an easy A though.

This is really a joke class. Take it if you're looking for an easy A. There are so many extra credit opportunities, it's ridiculous. If you're interested in learning though, just buy the book and read it on your own. Class was pretty much naptime.

His class was a joke and he wastes lot of time. Was more of an 11th grade high school class than college class. If you want to learn anything or stretch your mind this guy is bad news. Of course if you dont care and want an easy A - this guy is for you.
I noticed that he likes to help students do better. He's not one of those teachers that doesn't care about the students. I can't complain.

It's an easy class, but he's a horrible teacher.  He doesn't know anything.  He supposedly has his PhD, but when we ask him questions in class all he responds is "I don't know, have to look into that", which really doesn't help.
No Comments
Had him for Psych TAP.  Mad easy.  He lets you do unlimited extra credit work to get an A if you don't already ace his exams.

Most boring lectures ever!  He never teaches anything, its all in the book, infact the book is online, the quizes are online, and the test is online.  Never went to class got an A.  Take it if you want a fake class!
Good teacher, not too hard but you learn alot.  There is alot of reading, and all the tests and quizzes are online.  Tons of extra credit opportunities that are worth alot of points.  Cool guy.
pretty much an online class. all the exams and tests are online. if you need this requirement for psych make sure you get him as your teacher.

Social Psych was interesting and graded easily. Lots of quizzes and assignments, but makes it easy to do well in the class.  Lots of extra credit available.  He is nice, understanding, funny and interesting.  Unfortunately, it is a really big class....
Would not recommend taking a class with him to anyone.  Failed tests even with hours of studying and going to all lectures.  Good luck!!!!!!!
No Comments
i had him for psych tap... he is pretty easy, note cards for tests, extra credit assignments... its more like an easy high school class
be honest with him about your concerns and he will help you out a lot, he seems to really care and he tries real hard to help you do well
AWESOME! SO HELPFUL!

It is clear she cares about her students, grading is more than fair, and there is an extremely generous extension policy. Lectures frequently involve discussion and generative writing so you are not sitting and listening for very long at a time, which is good. Definitely take 305 with her.

Great professor, very nice person. She grades the unit assignments fairly strictly, but gives great feedback. So if you try on your first submission, you will be able to easily fix it and get an A. 4 unexcused absences, no final. Definitely take 305 with her if you can.
Goated. Take 305 with her.

She is by far the most humble and down-to-earth professor I have seen in the English department. Prof Butler was always open for deep ethical discussions and never placed a students' view beneath her own's. 
Her feedback for graded assignments is extremely useful. I found it easy to review my work to receive better grades based off her feedback.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Such a sweet lady!! You can tell Professor Butler genuinely wants her students to be successful and is very easy to contact outside class. She always helps me a lot, and I revise my papers based on her feedback. It works! As long as you put full effort into the papers and participate consistently, she will know. And your grade can be paid off.

Great choice for a CICS305 instructor. Professor Butler was a wonderful professor who was very compassionate towards her students and showed high flexibility towards student situations by making herself easy to contact outside office hours and encouraging a judgment-free learning environment in class. Very charismatic, I enjoyed this class a lot.

This woman is a savior for any computer science student who wants to avoid Michelle Trim for 305. If you can take 305 with Professor Butler, please do! Organized course structure, reasonable workload, flexible accessibility outside class and office hours, and welcoming learning environment. I'll take classes with Butler again if I have a chance.

When preparing to take Writing 112 as a gen-ed I was loathing having to write a bunch of useless papers and doing a lot of busy work. However, she does a fantastic job of not trying to make the class something that it is not. This is a very simple writing class that does not require insane amount of work. I would highly recommend taking her class.

She clearly enjoys her job and does a great job meeting people where they are. When we discuss, she makes it really casual and accepting. Be prepared to have writing assignments, reading, and workshops every week. Everything is organized on Google Classroom so you will never be left in the dust. Overall, a really easy class. Just turn in your work.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Bless this woman. Ms. Butler's lessons were driven by the passion of somebody who truly cares about her field of study (which is hard to do in an intro writing course). Feedback was always clear and helpful, resulting in a fairly easy A if you can read, follow instructions, and have a grasp of general grammar.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--So many papers

reviews.comment: Terrible class. I dreaded every single meeting. The deadlines were unrealistic, and we only made progress by scheduling extra meetings outside of class. She constantly fell behind on grading, and the students paid the price for it. Wouldn't recommend this course to anyone.

Took the first ever SPP capstone course with Professor Bushouse and enjoyed it. While there were kinks to be worked out (first ever SPP capstone), she was very accomodating and caring as long as you communicated with her. I would definitely take her again. Show up, get the books, use class time wisely and you will get a lot out of the course.

Professor Bushouse is a nice person who is willing to accommodate students' concerns. Though sometimes the assignment instructions could have been clearer, the class itself is manageable and the content is interesting.

Treats students like high schoolers by looking at our laptop screens during class and banning bathroom use. Does not use rubrics, grades by ear (if she grades at all). Be prepared to not know what to do because Brenda is incompetent at teaching! Will grade drafts after final draft is due, blames TA for her mistakes, and spends class time rambling.

Professor Bushouse is an inconsistent instructor who provides helpless directions and then gives unhelpful responses like "Moodle has everything you need" when in reality there's nothing for use up at all. She overwhelms her TA's in ways that are unacceptable making it so that they hate their job. She also takes ages to grade assignments.

Professor Bushouse is one of the most unprepared, rude, difficult to work with professors I have ever seen at UMass. As a person with high accolades and many years of professional experience, she fails to communicate simple directions/criteria with students. If you can avoid her, save yourself the stress and do not select any of her courses.
She does not give clear grading criteria, expectations are constantly changing. She gets mad when people use the bathroom. Does not answer direct questions clearly. Very passionate though.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Don't take her if you can avoid it. This class was extremely disorganized and we were treated like high school students. It wasn't super work heavy (we spent almost a month on a 1.5 page paper) but it still felt hard to get through. I felt like I was lost so many times in class, just to realize that there was nothing we were supposed to be doing.

Genuinely one of the worst profs I've ever had... disorganized and unclear about everything. Lots of projects and group work but the rubrics/assignment descriptions were never clear. She'd lecture about topics unrelated to our assignments, yelled at us for going to the bathroom, monitored laptop screens, and blamed things on the TA

Her lectures were effectively pointless and made little contribution to learning. Her expectations are rarely, if ever, clear making every assignment 10x harder than it needs to be. She yelled at my class for going to the bathroom too much and said going during her class was rude. Save yourself the headache.

prof bushouse is one of the worst profs Ive ever had. guidelines to assignments are never clear, & her lectures are completely disorganized & all over the place. she acts like a high school teacher, looking over students shoulders to see what they're doing on their computer & monitors students in a stalking way in class. highly do not recommend.
.

Prof Bushouse is one of the most dysfunctional & disorganized professors I have ever had. The class itself is pretty light work and the assignments are easy, but she is super unclear about assignment expectations and doesn't give direct guidelines about what to do. The class also includes a lot of group work and you do a lot of group assignments.

Very unique class and teaching style. Most of the course was centered around group projects and study of current events, which was a nice change of pace. Course is broken up into four modules which all involve some form of group assignment including one big project in the middle of the course. Bit of a challenge but a class worth taking.
Really great experience working under Professor Bushouse in a research team!
No complaints!
I had her for research. She is very helpful when working together and guiding us in the right direction. She knows what she wants and strives for greatness.
just an overall tedious class without structure which is good sometimes because things can be easy but also was confused on the guidelines for pretty much every assignment and so was everyone else
I don't understand how she made it to become a professor. She has no regard for structure and she gets very (negatively) emotionally attached and personal if she doesn't like what she hears :(

The course has to be a joke. She doesn't know how to give valuable lessons. I could have learned what I was taught on Google.   She is also VERY rude. Beware if you are an honest student and questions things. She doesn't seem to have a knack for respect.  She has been unorganized since day one. Like forgetting to UNLOCK the classroom door.

This has been thee worst class I have ever taken. This professor is extremely unorganized and I wish that I read more reviews here on her. If you want an easy class, take it but beware that she doesn't explain herself well. By the way, if you are a 5 College student, you will be held to a higher standard/treated poorly. Please go back to school.

The course was, for the most part, interesting, and it wasn't too difficult. The hardest part was probably the position paper, which even then, wasn't too hard. Other than that, her TAs do most of the grading. She's pretty down-to-earth, and her explanations are very modern, with comparisons that make sense.
Worst teacher I have ever had. She makes horrible comments to students on assignments and is overall a terrible professor. I would strongly advise anyone taking a class with her.

Course itself is a good one. Instructor isn't best suited to teach it although very knowledgeable. What should be easy class content becomes tedious/ambiguous. Students are an afterthought re structure of course content/pace of assignments. No real review for exams/rare use of rubrics. TAs integral to student success. Take PS383 for policy instead.

Hands down the worst teacher/professor I had. She sustained an injury prior to the start of the semester that may have affected her abilities. But, there is no reason for me to try to find excuses for her. She was misleading, confusing and annoying. She also makes snarky comments.

Terrible professor does not give clear answers and is not helpful. Does not answer questions appears to not know the answers. Everything you need is from the readings she does not teach in lecture and her slides are not helpful. avoid if you can

I took a 1 credit class with her. WORST TEACHER. I mean, she's really into her work, but if she doesn't like you, you'll know it...and that will affect your grade. Book was $100+ and hardly used. AVOID BRENDA. Heels on linoleum made us flinch by the end of her class.

Class itself is dealable- just take good notes and do reading. Bushouse, however, not so good. In particular, she won't give extensions, even to those who are sick and have excused absences. Real nice.
Very nice, knowledgeable, test are straight from the class notes, as long as you attend class and study for the 3 tests you will be fine

Hands down the worst class and worst teacher I've had in college. Completely ridiculous grading. Expected to know useless details not covered in class and barely covered in readings. As a Teacher, Very unhelpful and does not take feedback on class well. AVOID THIS TEACHER AT ALL COST! Completely killed my interest in Urban Government and issues.
Great classes. Discussion and paper writing - gives students lots of leeway to pursue own interests.

You get out of her course what you put into it.  There is a lot of reading, and you need to develop your own political theories to do well on the tests.  She is very open to students of various opinions voicing their views when the time is appropriate.  The course is good for students who have an interest in public policy.
well prepared and interesting.  Good class
Not helpful, no feedback, dictates instead of facilitation, high expectations yet no help from her side.
No Comments

Never take this class! a lot of reading, a lot of boring group work, dont even try to contact her b/c she will send you a rude remark back when you ask for help! long class, boring, some topics are pretty interesting but for some reason she tends to make them completely unbearable! horrible...

Give her what she wants specifically. If you talk to her outside of class she'll practically dictate the assignments for you.  Micromanager.  That being said, once you figure her out, she's at least bearable.

Class participation was a big part of class which made it interesting. Was a helpful teacher, taught material well, definitely a good looking lady, probably could show more enthusiasm but a good teacher.
Great professor, cheap textbook, good exams.
Great teacher, very knowledgable
Lots of reading.  Tests extremely easy.  Professor is interesting and good natured.
A ton of reading for each class
She was an amazing professor this semester. She does in class excel exercises and makes sure everyone knows what they're doing and gives help if needed. Highly recommended
Great professor. She wants her students to do well and is super nice. Highly recommend.

A very sweet and patient teacher who takes the time to ensure that her students understand the content. Gives opportunties for extra credit and very flexible with students individual needs. Also she has a great sense of humor.
Laid-Back Class, she cares a lot about students and wants them to learn! Put in the work, and you will do well
Super friendly and wants all of her students to do well. Exams and quizzes are open-note, and they are not that hard.
Very friendly, easy-ish course, recommend for this course
She wants everyone to do well. Sometimes spent too long lecturing, leaving us with only 15-20 minutes to do the quiz of classwork. Overall nice and not a bad experience.

Cool guy but lectures aren't very helpful. He expects you to already know some of the stuff he's talking about. Very easy grading tho. One final and the rest of your grade is made up of easy hws and quizzes. He lets you to drop some of your lower grades. Attendance is graded but you also have 3 free absences. Shouldn't be hard to get a good grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Burleson is a really nice and enthusiastic guy who certainly knows his stuff, but his teaching almost seems like he assumes that we as students already know some of the stuff he's talking about. It is often that what he teaches goes over your head. He mostly read off slides, which is fine, but only if you already know the material.

The first 2/3 of 547 involves reading research papers that Burleson will then just point to keywords from during lecture, not contributing much else. Then the amount of time you get for the final project is way too short, and the project is super rushed. This class is pretty easy, but if you really want to learn about security take CS 390R.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment:
Class was not too bad. He is very knowledgeable for the subject. Post-covid- he is actually very lenient on the grading, reading, and going to class. 

If you put the work and effort in (which is average) because it is a 500 level course, then you will learn a lot.
He is a hypocrite. He can go to any extent to save his grading rubric.

He solely relies on a TA for everything. The TA struggles with English and has a god complex upto the extent where he would call the material taught in the class wrong over his knowledge. They both are baised towards certain students and no matter what you do, the baised students will always get good grades even for every wrong answer they give.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--So many papers--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Class Overall was a mess. The lectures did not have anything to do with the Labs or homework. The grades were never given in a timely fashion, for example the midterm grade came out a week after the withdraw date. No help with accommodations. Puts most of the work on the GTA and the other TAs only helped with lab questions.

Prof. Burleson is a good guy but his lectures are almost useless in terms of what we learn. The labs are interesting and engaging but the instructions are unclear. He puts in a lot of effort but the course isn't very systematic. If he changes the grading and makes the course more streamlined, it'll become one of the most interesting UMASS courses.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Makes you work for the A grade. Gives you a respectful response to homework and cares that you make the grade. A is for effort and worth it.

TAs seemed to run most of the class. Responses to questions were usually pretty slow if the questions were ever answered at all. Info on what to prepare for on exams was vague and sometimes misleading. I was pretty excited for this class but the way it was run did make it a bit disappointing. The topic was still quite interesting though.

Wayne is a cool Professor who has really interactive and fun lectures. He has a lot of knowledge on Security Engineering and is great answering questions. The labs are great fun to do and the TAs were helpful. The exams are sort of a mess: you don't know what you need to study to prep for the exam and he doesn't like to tell you for some reason :/

Hes one of those power points instructor that doesnt bother even to check his own mistakes. Very own efficient teacher. You have to teach everything to yourself And hes just a PowerPoint presenter. On top of that his exams are designed in a way that you almost get no partial credit for anything and you either get it five points or no points/Qu

Well knowledged in VLSI as he works for AMD while being a professor at UMass. Lectures can be dry and confusing as he doesn't give much examples on how to apply the the information being taught. Exams were difficult even for an open book exam. CAD projects are hard but did get easier as the semester passed. In the end, the final grade was fair

He never teaches any concepts in the class. Just skims through the ppt. We have to learn everything on our own from the internet.  I went to him to understand some concepts and he couldn't explain them to me and didn't even bother to look into it afterwards.  He has top level knowledge of the course but not in depth.

dont take the course. very bad grader. doesnt teach at all. if u want to go into vlsi you have to take it,no option. but will lose interest if you took this. attendance not necessary. syllabus is too big. no one can read so much.
Took it because of degree requirement, but really like it
Ok. Knowledgeable.

2 midterms and a final, and weekly online homework. attendance required via tophat. Could be alot worse. She's actually a very nice lady, and appreciates students who sit in the front. she cares about the kids, and while it wasn't a interesting class in my opinion, she does the best job someone could have done.

It is very hard to see the class exam. After grading, you can't have a look on it, and obviously you can't learn from your mistakes. I requested to have a look on my exam and the prof told me to come a month later to see it... 

She is nice, but the lecture is very NOT helpful. Students need more in depth explanation of each concepts and processes.

OIM 301 is not an easy class, but if you try and truly care you will do well. Michele is sweet and cares about her students, and shes funny too. Attend lectures, go to office hours, and watch her echos she posts and you will be fine. It's challenging but doable and she is the best professor out there
Lectures are not very good. Talks about irrelevant stuff. Homework help is not very helpful. Exams are long for the 2 hr window.
She's a great professor who truly cares about her students' success. If you pay attention in class and watch back lectures for parts you don't understand, you'll do well.

Prof Burch is just super nice, clear, and brings good energy to her lectures. The content is really easy if you just pay attention and do the homeworks. She permits a double sided cheat sheet, so make sure to put effort into it, and you'll do just fine on the tests. Provides ample examples and time to prepare. Easy class, great professor!

This class is not hard. While the prof is a nice person, she is definitely not a good teacher. She made things more confusing. There was an instance I did homework myself even before I listen to the lecture and I did it with ease. After listening to her lecture, I don't understand how to do the problem I was able to solve myself.

This class sucks. actually dont take it, i love michele as a prof which is why i took the class, but she does not teach in this class at all. on tuesdays the other students in the class present random projects for the whole class and she does not teach. on thursdays she gives you a reading quiz after you had to read 150 pgs/wk of textbook. it sucks
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Professor Burch was caring, understanding, and funny. I got a bad grade because I struggled with understanding OIM and the material. The professor was amazing and I'd definitely take another course of hers. She gives as much credit as she can. Only downside was in person, long, paper exams.

I would definitely recommend professor Burch. She makes class entertaining and is pretty funny. The homework can be difficult but not impossible. There are three exams that are pretty similar to the exam review that she goes over. You are allowed to use a double sided cheat sheet. You definitely will have to put some effort in to succeed.

All the homework is online and there isn't much. There are a lot of office hours and I highly recommend to attend them. She gives a full page, front and back, as a cheat sheet for the exams, there are three of them. She also gives a practice exam which is fairly similar to the real one. She also gives partial credit on exams, taken on paper.

Professor Burch is one of my favorite professors at Isenberg so far! I am taking her right now for OIM301 and while the material is difficult she includes a lot of good examples. There are 3 exams and you get to bring a double sided cheat sheet w/ notes to help you. Attendance is required through TopHat. I highly recommend taking her for 301.
Professor Burch makes this required class pretty manageable. Exams are straightforward with cheat sheets, but the homework can be a slog. Unstuck ai was a lifesaver for study prep!

Professor Burch is very knowledgeable about OIM and has a clear passion for teaching others about the field. She has a great personality and connects well with students. The class is not the easiest, but if you put in some effort, you will be just fine. There are plenty of office hours as well so the support is there if you need it.

Professor Burch is awesome and teaches this class very well. All homework can be done as many times as needed, so is an easy 100. Exams allow for a two-sided cheat sheet for all notes, so as long as you have good notes on your cheat sheet, it should be pretty straightforward. Attendance is done in TopHat, and you get 2 free absences.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Burch is a great professor and allows students to understand each of the concepts.
