reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: 565 (Mathematical Methods for Signal Processing-Machine Learning-Data Analysis) is a true gem of a course. Duarte gives rigorous explanations of signal processing techniques far beyond transform theory techniques and filter-based applications (introductory DSP). It prepares you for Machine Learning by showing how signal processing evolved into ML.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Puts very little effort into preparing class material. Occasionally condescending when students don't understand the material. His lectures are blitzing fast and unintelligible. Worst handwriting in ECE. Homework solutions and lecture notes are impossible to decipher. Your best bet is to frequent office hours to get clearer explanations.

Homeworks are LONG. Lectures are good, but his handwriting gets pretty messy which can introduce a lot of ambiguity. He has great office hours and is very active on Piazza. His exams are HARD but they're graded very leniently & compensated w/ lots of partial credit. Overall, he's very knowledgeable and highly respected (16k+ citations) in his field

Duarte was a pretty good professor and I feel that I had a solid understanding of the fundamentals of signal processing by the end of the course. Actually listens to student feedback unlike most profs. Exams were fair -- plus the final had a Rick and Morty reference in it! What more could you ask for?

Seems like a nice person who is dedicated to help his students learn. Every class is structured the same where he writes on the sheet of paper that is projected onto the board. Explains the material pretty well. Homework is average length for an engineering class. The exams were graded leniently even when some of the problems were challenging.

I took Dee a while back. She was engaging and passionate about her work. However, she strikes me as a little self-centered, as she would only talk about indigenous people, and neglect other racial/ethnic minorities. She also rejected both myself and two others' LOR requests (too busy?) for grad school apps- again, somewhat selfish and unsupportive.
Dee is an awesome professor!She delves into issues that we see, but have never understood or knew they were they were there before. It's a great class!!

Dee is a wonderful teacher! she really makes sense with her teaching...it is an easy a if you do all your work.  she even says its hard to fail this course.  she's very energetic and i looked forward coming to class even if it was 8am...i got an A! and it was so worth it. i highly recommend it! plus its 2 gen-eds

Dee was great! She may be a little intense about her ethnic background but she means well. She will tell it how it is and is very involved with her students. She will learn your name and who you are. Lots of easy writing and mostly free writes! Topics are inspiring and fun. Grades very fast with helpful comments and emails back quickly. Loved her!

Rachael Dworsky is a sweet woman when she likes you, but definitely has a vicious side if you miss too many classes. Attendance is mandatory. I wasn't too crazy about her book selection but if you read you will do well. Pop quizzes, and a few essays. She gives you the option to choose the prompt you would like to answer in your essays. Fair class.

Worst class that I have taken. It appears as though she has difficulty understanding absences. She gives too much work and not enough time to complete the assignments, which is extremely annoying. Although she is not understanding...Rachael is a push over and you can easily by yourself more time, however.Good luck in not getting her angry.
this is by FAR with no doubt in my mind the worst teacher at all of umass. Take her class and then have the motivation to visit this website just to let people know.
alot of writing but that's expected in college. gave lots of good feedback on my essays. my writing definitely improved. don't procrastinate on the essays.

This class is a Gen Ed for ALL students, yet Rachael grades as if each student is an English major. She is not understanding of attendance issues. It is extraordinarily difficult to predict what your final grade will be, as she uses a mixture of a check and number system, with no updates to where you stand.  Take this class with another teacher.

TERRIBLE TEACHER! There is a lot of writing (to be expected), but it is complete and utter junk writing. She doesn't know what she is talking about and contradicts herself in her teaching. She has severe issues with her teaching style and does not seem to care if her students succeed at all. She is honestly the worst professor at umass.

This was my favorite course at UMass. I loved the interactive nature of everything we did and Jacob's constant encouragement. I found I learned a lot about my own engineering process through the course and the way Jacob focused on practice. Excellent professor, highly recommend taking extra time to do all of the work fully & extra credits!

Jacob is an incredible professor who, despite not being an engineer, has figured out ways to get us (Engin majors from all fields) to describe our mindset, process, lens, and vision for the future.The activities and prompts were so interesting that I wanted to put more time into my writing and communicating. He turned writing into engineering!

Jacob's awesome! As an engineering major, I despise writing. However, I genuinely looked forward to each class, knowing I would be in an interactive and engaging environment. He provides excellent feedback and is extremely supportive, eager to help clarify any points of confusion. If you need to take Engin 351, take it with Jacob!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Really nice guy. He cares a lot about students and will take an interest in pretty much all of the essay topics even with limited technical knowledge. I normally hate writing, but he really made the process as manageable as possible. He also provides really detailed feedback on all of the major assignments you submit.
I was genuinely excited to go to class - not sure I've ever seen a prof put so much time into seeing us all develop as writers and thinkers!

You can tell Jacob loves teaching. He brings a huge energy to the class, builds from everyone's interests & viewpoints, and always makes himself available for clarifications, examples, and feedback. What I liked most is the way the assignments get you practicing writing skills while giving space to be creative with our engineering interests.

Jacob was one of my best professors at umass - he took a potentially boring writing class and made it exciting, creative, and I came out a better writer. Also think I was able to land a job based on the work we did in the first unit. Different way of teaching that gets you to challenge yourself and never felt like the assignments were busy work.

incredibly easy professor. a lot of in class discussion, which i found to be a good time to get assignments done for other classes. very little work. very lenient grading. if you're looking for junior year writing to be easy, take dyer-spiegel. i had so much less work compared to my friends in other sections.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I used to dread writing but this class gave me confidence with both writing and presenting. Jacob is extremely interactive and approachable, super enthusiastic. I ended up learning a lot!
This was one of my favorite courses at UMass - Jacob made writing and communication so interesting and I loved the freedom of the different writing assignments. He really cares about students!

He was one of the best professors I've ever had here at UMass. He makes this course really enjoyable and I learned a lot. He's a very fair grader and I would definitely recommend anyone who has to take this course to take it was Jacob!

I took Jacob's Business Communication 310 course (Junior Year Writing) and it was the best course I have taken at UMass. Jacob has a way of inspiring you to challenge yourself and to find a deep connection to the course materials, to push yourself in team projects, and find ways to solve problems based on inspiring projects.
Jacob creates space for you to customize the course and really learn at a deep level!

Jacob is absolutely here for the students' success above everything else. He waives deadlines all the time to make sure that work is not rushed. He is genuinely interested with anything anyone had to say and would rather build off everyone's ideas instead of just lecturing to the class. Definitely the best professor to take this class with.

Jacob really cares about student success both inside and outside the Business Communication course. He adapts course content to make sure students are engaged and personally interested in the different units. But maybe the best part is the way he helped me build confidence with writing, teamwork, presenting, ways of communicating I never thought of

Jacob is a truly amazing professor! He is extremely kind and really cares about improving student's quality of writing as well as their confidence. He offers amazing, heartfelt feedback, and fosters wonderful classroom discussions! The more you participate in class, the more you will get out of it, but he also makes it a low-stress environment.

Jacob is an amazing professor for English 112. He encourages you to find your own writing style and gives constructive feedback to improve your essays. I don't think you could find a more caring and kind professor at UMass. (Yes, you'll have to read short stories and write essays but the class is super manageable). 10/10 recommend!!

Jacob was one of my favorite professors. Super considerate and understanding during the switch to online learning, and always gives clear, constructive feedback. Put the work into your papers and make the edits he suggests and you'll do fine in the class.

Jacob is easily one of my favorite professors, and the most engaging and caring professor Ive ever had the pleasure of meeting at UMass. The course material is interesting, but his passion for teaching and for the texts we read is what sets this course aside for me; I came out of the course a better reader, writer, and maybe even person haha.
Best english professor at UMass. Truly loves is job and is very passionate. Dr J is the man.
Dr J will make sure that you love writing by the end of the semester. Outstanding class.
Outstanding professor! Things literally came alive during this class.

Jacob is one of the best teachers I've had in a while. He really cares about what he teaches and that's really contagious. I wanted to show up to class so that I could learn. He has a mysterious past that he brings up all the time but really vaguely lol, he should def write a book. Anyways, take his classes, you can only benefit from them!

honestlyyy... iconic. a prof that makes you want to come to class. always upbeat. i didn't want the class to end. mysterious background, perhaps immortal. actually learned stuff too. take any of his classes if you can
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Dr J is one of the best teachers I have ever had. He motivates me to write with meaning.
Aside from being completely gorgeous, which he is, Jacob really is an incredible teacher. Would def recommend him to anyone!

Jacob is the best TA I have had in my four years at UMass. He is energetic and a lot of fun. He gets you to look at a book or an idea from many different angles and gets even quiet people like me to participate.
Hottest teacher at umass...beautiful beautiful man. Very fair grader, easy to talk to..wish I could take every class with him!
I am seriously in love with him. He's the only reason I went to class. His discussions were great because he's funny and engaging. Only thing is he's hot and it makes it hard to concentrate.

Okay so Jacob is now the love of my life. He was the reason i would get out of bed those morning,  i would have hated to miss one of his classes.  He is so enthusiastic that it makes anything interesting, always happy and smiling.  Def take him, the best TA/teacher ever!
Jacob is a great discussion leader, extremely engaging and interested in what students have to say. One of my best, easiest flowing discussions ever.
Hot...with a capital H...only criticism, he made it hard to concentrate in class...
JDS is top notch!
fun and down to earth -- a real person, no b.s., who cares and gets you to do your best and have fun doing it.
A very good teacher who is creative and makes the course interesting
By far the best Portuguese teacher I've had

He showed great enthusiasm in every class.  Very helpful and great on feedback.  Class was mandatory but he was very lienant with passing in late assignments.  I could keep going on but this is sufficient.  I wish he taught more portuguese classes!
JDS!
my hero
He loves arts and music and realy enjoys teaching. But you have to do your work. He can really tell when you do your work and when you dont
A great guy who you can walk into class and talk about anything from popular movies to baseball to just about anything you ask him about. Very easy to work with and respects his students.
Dylan's a really fun guy and you will learn a lot in his class but he's a tough grader and pushes you to be a better writer. Also you don't need any of the books

Dylan is a cool guy, talks a lot interesting stuffs in the class. If you like to talk and share your opinion with him you can become great friends. The grade is tough to get, an A is extremely hard for me.  The best part is his lecture, easy-going, not boring at all and excited, he is funny. The worst part is the grade, again, hard to get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Gives good feedback--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: a few days ago, I thought he was the best teacher I ever had. However, it is not the truth. In fact, as a professor, he is not so serious about some part of teaching, which should be taking serious. sometimes he just like a child and really do not care your homework. He delayed our three essay's grade for nearly tow month. he is unreliable teacher.
Dylan is a very cool and nice person. this class need you pay effort, but Dylan can see you effort!

If there is one teacher you should have for English Writing, it should be Dylan. He has given me an entirely new perspective on writing, and you can tell that he genuinely cares about his students. He allows you to express yourself in your essays, and he is always willing to help you. He's definitely the greatest teacher I have ever had.
Dylan is the man! I actually wanted to attend his class. He never fails to brighten your day while still making you an amazing writer at the end of the semester.

He's a young, enthusiastic teacher who will not only make you interested in the topic, but make you laugh hysterically. Ive never quite had a teacher like Dylan before, depending on your own personality you may not like him. He's outspoken and doesn't censor anything which makes him unlike most professors and also much more interesting to work with

Dylan is the man, it's his first year teaching at UMass and he only teaches one class. He makes class funny and enthralling but actually gets his point across clearly. His assignments are not long and they really help with writing papers, which are not long at all. You can also choose to write about almost anything which makes writing fun.

Brion Dulac's 201H section has the fastest fill rate compared to the other sections, so consider yourself fortunate if you get him. He loves conversation, his expectations and syllabus make it clear that he cares about his students and wants them to succeed, and Brion grades papers a lot easier than the other 201H profs while encouraging to learn.

Brion Dulac is nice, funny, and understanding. His 201H section fills up quickly for a reason: not only does he love making an effort to connect with students on personal and professional levels, but there's barely a lot of work and he's an easier grader on papers than the other professors. If you're lucky enough to get him, GET HIM.

Brion Dulac is a great man. He is caring, forgiving, inspirational, and has a great outlook on life. He truly helps you to see the world in a new light. I recommend him. I wish every one was as caring as him, the world would be a better place.
Brion Dulac is great for 201H-super funny and nice, enlightening, always willing to help students, and very forgiving grader when it comes to writing assignments.

Brion was a great guy and decent professor. This class involved a lot of readings and short papers; however, he is not at all a tough grader. This class was a rather easy A for me and most people in my class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers--Caring

reviews.comment: A really nice guy, although you don't get much feedback from him on your papers. The class is very laid back and if you simply do the work, you will do well.

Professor Dulac is a great teacher for this class. If you're taking 201H, I suggest him. He is very passionate about what he teaches and enjoys engaging with the students, which makes it easier to learn. There can be a lot of reading for hw at times, but class is mostly discussion-based, or you will be watching a film with an assignment after.

Overall, a great guy and a great professor. I highly recommend taking Honors201H with him. As long as you do the homeworks (which are usually just answering a few questions each week about a movie or a reading), you will do good. Very understanding and nice guy.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: If you're lucky enough to get to choose him, do it. You absolutely will not regret it.

Professor Dulac has easily been the best part of this online semester. He is considerate, genuine, and an all-around wonderful human being. The homework is around 1-4 pages of writing per week, but it's very manageable. His feedback is very positive and the class itself is very interesting. Also provided free pdfs of the books we used for us!

A really nice professor. Not very tough or challenging but the class is a good time and you learn about a lot of social issues. I really wish our class was in person because the experience would've been much better. Even then, the online format was fun and enriching. We had some good debates + discussions in class.

He's so kind and you can tell that he genuinely cares about his students. There were papers to write, but it's very manageable and he doesn't grade them harshly at all; his feedback is always positive. Overall, a very enjoyable class.

Definitely, one of the best professors you'll ever meet in your life. There's weekly homework of about 1-4 pages depending on the topic and the homework is more than half of your grade, but they aren't that hard to do. Interesting class, amazing professor, and a very good experience!

Brion is the best. Sure, you get papers every week and there's some readings, but it's worth it. For an honors class it's not bad, and he really makes the course. Brion cares about every one of his students, and it shows. He is interested in everything you have to say, loves conversation, and cares about learning. Nothing bad to say about him.

Just a genuinely great guy, and I really can't imagine any better of a 201H professor. Drives really interesting discussion and leads the class seminar-style which makes it fun to attend and participate in. You watch a lot of great movies in class, and what homework/readings he gives are super interesting and max 2 pages long. 11/10 class and guy

Brion Dulac is one of the best professors the honors college has to offer. Recommend him for any course but this one is a real gem - great movies, occasional snacks provided, and stimulating conversation.
Can't say enough good things about Brion!! Genuine and cares about his students, not a tough grader. As long as you put thought into your discussions and reflections you'll do great
I loved Brion Dulac! He's such a great professor and gives us interesting movies to watch and analyze.
Prof. Dulac is a wonderful man and such a funny professor to be around. His age can get the better of him sometimes, but I would recommend him over any of his peers.

Agree so much w/ other people on here. Brion is so funny, nice, and goofy. Mostly class time is watching movies and having fun discussions. Do the writing (usually a couple pages a week) and you'll get a good grade. Fair warning tho: I think I got 2 grades back the whole semester and we turned in something every week

Really good guy, overall does a great job of keeping the class in check. Thought I'd just be zoning out during this class, as I was only taking it as a requirement, but I actually found myself really interested in the material, mostly because of the professor. Also, he's very casual and as long as you give the class any effort you'll pass.

He is so funny and frequently cancels class/lets you out early/shows fun videos. Most of class is watching films and writing short papers in response. There are some readings - he's late to post things so you dont have too much time to get stuff done, but it's completely doable and an easy A

Brion is a great guy, class was easy but almost never boring. You gotta read some books and write a few pages pretty consistently but its never too hard or overwhelming and it's graded pretty lightly. A wide variety of topics, and we both read books and watched movies. Also just a funny and nice person. Would absolutely recommend.

Brion is by far the best choice for Honors 201H. Brion realizes that this is a mandatory honors class, and so he tailors each class to the interests of the students. Class time was spent either engaging in meaningful discussion, or watching movies. Homework is very manageable. He's very quirky and an interesting guy all around.
A great professor. Gives a ton of response papers, but grades them super easy. Really cares about his students and wants them to do well.

Prof. Dulac does a great job of making the class easy and interesting and inspires great class discussions with every topic. There isn't a ton of work that's time-consuming and he isn't a hard grader if you really put effort in. Overall, if you're looking for a class that's interesting and not all that difficult, this is the one for you.

There's a ton of short papers (1-2 double spaced pages), but he's a super easy grader. Brion clearly cares about his students. He's fairly unorganized and showed up to class at least 10 minutes late most days, but would cancel class a fair amount. He's an amazing person and very interesting to talk to if you get a chance.

Extremely caring and respectable professor, always makes class enjoyable and is really chill overall. As a class, it is very easy even though it's 4 credits since the homework is manageable. We mainly watched movies/videos in class and had discussions, and there was never an overload of work. Dulac is a good teacher and an even better person.

Brion was a very easy professor. He was not always put together and often handed assignments out with short notice, but he was an easy grader. Cancelled class a ton. Very caring and a nice guy; his intentions are good but not a phenomenal teacher.

Definitely the professor to take if you need to take Honors Ideas. The class work is very manageable for a 4 credit course and classes are usually very relaxed. Most classes we just watched movies or videos or had a discussion between the class. He is very understanding and makes an effort to connect with his students personally. He's also funny!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: Literally the best professor you will ever have. The homework is a ton, but very manageable if you email him for an extention. The papers he has you write are very reflective on yourself and on the topics in class. He is very caring and all-in-all the best person to meet in your life.

Brion is an amazing professor, asks for participation but wont push it if you don't want to. Put in some effort and give some feed back and you will probably get and A no problem. He's one of the coolest professors I've had

So many papers but they aren't long and it's just responses. But if you can, definitely read the material because it's great. Sometimes he gets a little weird but he is great professor. Discussion in his class are awesome and have fun!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: Brion Dulac is one of my favorite people. He makes an effort to connect with students on a personal level and goes out of his way to even say hello and ask how you're doing if you see him outside of class. The classes themselves consist of a discussion based on the assigned reading, and contributing just once per class is seen as good participation

If you have the chance, take Honors Ideas with him! He is such an easy grader, and he is hilarious and caring. But, this class requires A LOT of reading and writing every week, so be prepared to work. As long as you participate once in awhile and put a little passion and effort into the writing, you will get an A.

Great guy. Goes off on weird tangents but good option for Ideas. You have to read sometimes a lot and write some papers, but its pretty hard not to get an A if you show up and participate sometimes. He likes when students have some insight. Interesting and worth taking with Brion!!
The most amazing man on earth. Easiest grader in the world. My hero.

Brion is a great teacher, and en even better man. He is often scatter brained but has the best intentions. The perfect combination of smart, funny, and sweet. His Honors 291A uses a lot of movies and inspired me to start towards my film certificate. He sometimes brings in food. His stories are always interesting. He cares about his students.

Brion is a great professor, there is a lot of reading but all of the writing assignments are very opinion-based so it is not hard to do well. The class was very interesting and includes several short papers and a final project that can be about pretty much anything relating to a book we discussed. Great class!
Brion is just amazing. He's super quirky and fun. Class is easy, just participate and do your homework. Really interesting and thought provoking class.

Best professor I ever had. So funny, really into making the class enjoyable for his students. 100% would take again. Completely all over the place, but a great class nonetheless. No exams, no real papers, one final project. The absolute best. You're missing out if you don't take "Ideas" with him.

If you're looking for that movie-quality zany college professor, Brion is it. The semester started out very reading-heavy, but mellowed out immensely about halfway through. Brion is always engaging and it's clear that he cares about his students. I would definitely recommend taking this course with him.

Brion is definitely a pretty funny guy but seems a little off his rocker. I've probably written over 100 pages on papers for this class, he's big on written assignments. Pretty easy grader though all you have to do is talk every now and then in the class and actually do the assignments. He's a little weird and goes on tangents but he's a great guy
Great teacher, was very interested in the course material and making sure that all the students were interested as well and were learning.

Brion was an awesome instructor. He was extremely understanding and we had to write a lot. The best part was seeing the excitement he got when someone said something amazing in class. You should take this class.

I'm really glad I toke this seminar with Dulac.He's a pretty cool guy especially when analyzing movies.There's not much to say but just do all your work with some effort and you should get a good grade especially since he doesn't give that much work compared to other H291A professors.Loved all the movies we watched.

Absolutely loved this class and love him. He's very quirky and hilarious in his own way. He grades very easily, as long as you do the assignments. Overall, I found this class relaxing and enjoyable, it normally brightened my day or sparked my interest.

Loved this class. Provided a nice break from math, science, and engineering courses. A little effort goes a long way with him. Some short papers, movie watching and analysis, and lots of in class discussion. Definiely provoked thought and achieved the goal of Honors Seminar I. Recommended this class to several friends. Think, speak up, and enjoy.

One of the most enjoyable teachers I've ever had, he is an awesome slightly quirky guy who really enjoys involving the class, and is incredibly helpful and nice with anything you could possibly need. As long as you try, the class is easy too.

He is the best professor you can have for this class - easy A if you put the effort in. Classtimes is based on discussions and movies. There are required readings but I seldom did them and still got A's on the papers. Just give the effort and you'll be fine.

He's good, but he's NOT an easy grader. He wants you to think and to participate. He's both serious and sort of amusing, at times. If you text for even 10 seconds in class you are considered absent for that day, even if you say something brilliant later. He's not an unfair grader, but I know of 2 people who have received a C+ and an F, so b serious

Brion is an awesome teacher, and in this class you watch and read interesting things. He's also a really chill guy and is pretty relaxed about homework assignments. HE is the best teacher you could have for this class.

Brion is such a fantastic instructor! He is interested in what his students have to say so most of the class was discussion based. We wrote a few response papers, but it was mostly questions we would use as a starting point in class. Lots of books and you have to read quickly, but also lots of movies and its a really great, easy class!
Brion is the man, he is hilarious and really nice. You'll get a good grade if you write some response papers to various movies/readings that are normally only a few pages.

Although alittle scattered and disorganized sometimes, Brion is quirky and is always trying to make the class laugh. Much better teacher than some other Honors Seminar teachers I have heard of, and as long as you do the work and attend his movie showings he grades easily. Brings in food sometimes. Brion is a great, nice, interesting guy.

Brion is a great guy, a little distracted and disorganized sometimes, but the tangents he goes off on are very entertaining. He is funny in a different quirky sort of way. He is a pretty easy grader and I really enjoyed taking my honors seminar with him.

Very nice guy. If you go to class, participate every once in a while, and put a decent amount of effort into the work which isn't much, should be an easy A/A- class. Let's class out early a lot. Brought his dog in once and gave us food last day.
Great guy. He totally cares about his students. He even asks us to give him input on what kinds of things we as students would be interested in as assignments.
Really nice guy. Very low workload. Low stress.
He's good.

Dulac has interesting class conversation topics, he treats the class well (brought us food!), and he gives you some flexibility on class assignments. I would definitely recommend him for anyone who has to take Dean's Book.

Awesome Prof. for Deans Book. Don't know what the previous guy was saying. Not too much work, good grader, starts interesting conversations, and generally lets class out early when there's nothing left to do. Love him.
